events.coach_claim: Hai Yue has a significant advantage over Diao Chan at level 1; use skill 1 to poke aggressively.
events.gameplay_event: Hai Yue pokes Diao Chan, then uses Flash + Auto Attack to secure First Blood under the enemy tower.
events.evidence: Visual: Skill 1 hits Diao Chan multiple times. Audio: Coach mentions level 1 advantage.
events.recommended_action: Capitalize on level 1 range and damage to force the enemy out of lane or secure an early kill.

events.coach_claim: After a solo kill, immediately push the minion wave into the enemy tower to deny them gold and experience.
events.gameplay_event: Hai Yue clears the mid wave and pushes it into the tower while Diao Chan is dead.
events.evidence: Visual: Minions dying to the tower. Audio: Coach explains the "time difference" advantage.
events.recommended_action: Always prioritize crashing the wave after a successful pick to maximize the economic lead.

events.coach_claim: Roaming is good, but "stealing" farm from other lanes can hinder teammates; be mindful of team economy.
events.gameplay_event: Hai Yue roams bot, finds no opening, then takes a minion from the top lane (Li Xin's lane) on the way back.
events.evidence: Visual: Hai Yue clearing a top lane minion. Audio: Coach calls it "dirty hands" (stealing farm).
events.recommended_action: Roam to assist, but avoid taking solo lane farm unless the teammate is absent and the wave would otherwise be lost.

events.coach_claim: Use "fake vision" to mislead the enemy about your rotation path.
events.gameplay_event: Hai Yue moves toward the river, then doubles back through the jungle to hide her true destination.
events.evidence: Visual: Hai Yue's movement pattern on the minimap. Audio: Coach highlights the "fake vision" technique.
events.recommended_action: Regularly use brush and pathing to bait enemies into thinking you are roaming to a different lane.

events.coach_claim: Be cautious when engaging in the enemy jungle if your own jungler is busy farming elsewhere; you may be outnumbered.
events.gameplay_event: Hai Yue pulls Diao Chan into her ultimate realm in the jungle but is nearly collapsed upon by Yuan Ge.
events.evidence: Visual: Minimap shows friendly jungler at the opposite camp. Audio: Coach warns about the "frontline being outnumbered."
events.recommended_action: Check jungler position before deep invades to ensure backup is available if a skirmish breaks out.

events.coach_claim: When your ultimate is on cooldown, play defensively like a standard mage; don't overextend.
events.gameplay_event: Hai Yue stays near her tower and clears waves cautiously while her ultimate is down.
events.evidence: Visual: Hai Yue's positioning near the mid tower. Audio: Coach compares her to "Xiao Qiao" (playing safe).
events.recommended_action: Respect ultimate cooldowns; Hai Yue's threat level drops significantly without her realm.

events.coach_claim: In lower-tier matches, prioritize your own economy to carry; don't rely on teammates to farm efficiently.
events.gameplay_event: Hai Yue focuses on clearing mid waves and taking small jungle monsters to reach her "Sunset" item spike.
events.evidence: Visual: Hai Yue's gold lead and item purchase. Audio: Coach advises "eating more economy."
events.recommended_action: Actively seek farm across the map to reach core item power spikes faster than the enemy.

events.coach_claim: Failing to secure a kill inside the realm or having the ultimate interrupted can lead to a team collapse.
events.gameplay_event: Hai Yue pulls the marksman, but the ultimate is interrupted/fails, and she is killed upon exiting the realm.
events.evidence: Visual: Hai Yue dying after the realm ends. Audio: Coach notes the "lack of backup" and mechanical failure.
events.recommended_action: Ensure the target can be finished within the realm and watch for CC that can cancel the ultimate cast.

events.coach_claim: Be aware of enemy active items like "Golden Body" (Stasis) which can negate your ultimate's burst damage.
events.gameplay_event: Hai Yue pulls Diao Chan, but Diao Chan uses Golden Body to dodge the killing blow inside the realm.
events.evidence: Visual: Diao Chan turning gold inside the realm. Audio: Coach mentions "Golden Body" countering the play.
events.recommended_action: Bait out enemy defensive actives (Stasis, Purify) before committing the ultimate for a kill.

events.coach_claim: Split-pushing without map awareness is fatal; Li Xin's death to the turret symbolizes the team's lack of coordination.
events.gameplay_event: Li Xin is seen dying to a turret while the rest of the team is dead or out of position.
events.evidence: Visual: Li Xin's death notification. Audio: Coach expresses disbelief at Li Xin dying to a tower.
events.recommended_action: Coordinate split-pushes with team pressure to ensure the enemy cannot easily collapse or that the death isn't for nothing.

events.coach_claim: Greed for minions with low health led to an early death against Hai Yue.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao stays in lane with sliver of health.
events.evidence: Audio: "Still won't give up the minions." Visual: Hai Yue pokes her down.
events.recommended_action: Recall immediately when health is too low to survive a single spell.

events.coach_claim: Avoid standing directly inside the minion wave when laning against Hai Yue.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao stands next to minions while clearing.
events.evidence: Audio: "Don't stand with the minions." Visual: Hai Yue's skill hits both minions and Xiao Qiao.
events.recommended_action: Position to the side of the wave to force the opponent to choose between poking or clearing.

events.coach_claim: Choose rotations that support the jungler's tempo rather than leeching from the marksman.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao rotates bot to take minions while jungler is at red.
events.evidence: Audio: "Instead of going bot to take minions... help the jungler." Visual: Xiao Qiao takes bot farm.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize helping the jungler clear or invade when laning phase transitions.

events.coach_claim: Using skills in the river revealed her position to Sima Yi's passive, leading to a death.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao uses Skill 1 in brush, then gets jumped by Sima Yi.
events.evidence: Audio: "Triggered Sima Yi's passive." Visual: Sima Yi follows the skill trail to the brush.
events.recommended_action: Avoid using abilities when hiding if the enemy has vision-based passives (like Sima Yi).

events.coach_claim: Failure to watch the mini-map resulted in being caught by a rotating Yuan Ge.
events.gameplay_event: Yuan Ge moves from top to mid; Xiao Qiao ignores it and dies.
events.evidence: Audio: "Didn't see the mini-map at all." Visual: Yuan Ge is visible on map before the kill.
events.recommended_action: Develop a habit of checking the mini-map every 3-5 seconds.

events.coach_claim: The teleport to bot lane was wasted as there were no minions and allies were retreating.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao teleports to a bot tower with no wave.
events.evidence: Audio: "Teleport choice was wrong... no minions." Visual: Teleport ends with no objective to take.
events.recommended_action: Only use global teleports when there is a clear objective or a winnable fight.

events.coach_claim: Ignoring the jungler's "Gather" signal to solo-push led to another isolated death.
events.gameplay_event: Jungler pings to group; Xiao Qiao stays bot alone.
events.evidence: Audio: "Jungler pinged to gather... you insisted on bot." Visual: Xiao Qiao dies alone bot.
events.recommended_action: Follow team pings, especially from the primary playmaker (jungler).

events.coach_claim: Front-lining as a squishy mage without Flash is a guaranteed death.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao walks ahead of the tank into 3 enemies.
events.evidence: Audio: "Walking in front of 3-4 people." Visual: Xiao Qiao is the first to be targeted.
events.recommended_action: Stay behind the frontline/tanks and wait for enemy CC to be spent.

events.coach_claim: Rotating to a lane where minions are already cleared is a waste of time and tempo.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao rotates mid after the wave is already gone.
events.evidence: Audio: "Why come mid? To throw one skill?" Visual: Teammates already cleared the wave.
events.recommended_action: Check wave status on the map before committing to a rotation.

events.coach_claim: Overstaying with no cooldowns and low health allowed Sima Yi an easy cleanup.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao stays near a fight with all skills on CD.
events.evidence: Audio: "No big, no flash... still want to watch the show." Visual: Sima Yi kills her instantly.
events.recommended_action: Retreat immediately once your burst combo is spent and you have no escape tools.

events.coach_claim: Face-checking brushes as a mage is extremely dangerous and led to the final death.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao walks into an un-warded brush and gets CC'd.
events.evidence: Audio: "Face-checking the brush." Visual: Yuan Ge is waiting in the brush.
events.recommended_action: Use Skill 1 to scout brushes from a distance before entering.

events.coach_claim: Invading the enemy jungle alone without vision or support is high risk and leads to unnecessary early deaths.
events.gameplay_event: Level 2 Haiyue invades the enemy blue buff area alone, gets caught, burns flash, and dies.
events.evidence: Visual: Haiyue enters enemy jungle at 00:35. Audio: Coach criticizes the solo invade.
events.recommended_action: Avoid invading the enemy jungle without lane priority or teammate backup.

events.coach_claim: Haiyue must utilize her ultimate's displacement to kite and dodge skillshots while inside the illusion realm.
events.gameplay_event: Haiyue pulls the enemy mid into her realm but stands relatively still, taking significant unnecessary damage.
events.evidence: Visual: Haiyue's static movement in the realm at 01:18. Audio: Coach mentions using ult displacement to kite.
events.recommended_action: Actively use the ultimate's repositioning feature to avoid damage while in the realm.

events.coach_claim: Do not wander into contested areas like the river when low on health and lacking escape tools (flash/ultimate).
events.gameplay_event: A low-HP Haiyue enters the river without flash, is easily caught by the enemy, and dies again.
events.evidence: Visual: Haiyue enters river at 01:48 with low HP. Audio: Coach notes the lack of flash/ult.
events.recommended_action: Recall to base or stay safely under the tower when vulnerable and lacking escape tools.

events.coach_claim: Avoid pulling enemies into the illusion realm if teammates are not positioned to follow up once the realm ends.
events.gameplay_event: Haiyue pulls the enemy jungler in their own jungle while her teammates are too far away to assist.
events.evidence: Visual: Haiyue ults alone at 02:18. Audio: Coach highlights the lack of teammate follow-up.
events.recommended_action: Check teammate proximity and map state before committing to an ultimate pull.

events.coach_claim: Prioritize clearing minion waves (especially cannons) over aimless rotations, and avoid wasting ultimates on low-value supports.
events.gameplay_event: Haiyue abandons a mid-lane cannon minion to rotate bot, where she pulls the enemy support and eventually dies.
events.evidence: Visual: Haiyue leaves mid at 03:12. Audio: Coach criticizes leaving the cannon and pulling the support.
events.recommended_action: Clear waves fully before rotating; prioritize targeting enemy carries with the ultimate.

events.coach_claim: Maintain situational awareness and safe positioning when utilizing teammate utility, such as recall circles.
events.gameplay_event: Haiyue attempts to use a Da Qiao recall circle in an exposed position, gets interrupted by an enemy, and dies.
events.evidence: Visual: Haiyue dies while standing in the recall circle at 05:27. Audio: Coach mentions the "Da Qiao elevator" mistake.
events.recommended_action: Position safely within utility zones and stay aware of enemy crowd control that can interrupt recalls.

events.coach_claim: Angela takes unnecessary damage by standing in Chang'e's Skill 2.
events.gameplay_event: Early laning phase against Chang'e.
events.evidence: Angela walks directly into the center of Chang'e's circular AoE skill.
events.recommended_action: Maintain distance and avoid standing inside enemy persistent AoE zones.

events.coach_claim: Inefficient wave clearing leads to low health and lost lane priority.
events.gameplay_event: Angela uses three skills to clear a single wave.
events.evidence: The player uses Skill 1 multiple times and takes minion/hero damage, leaving them at critical HP.
events.recommended_action: Practice skill placement to clear waves with two skills (Skill 2 + Skill 1) to conserve mana and health.

events.coach_claim: Poor rotation pathing results in an easy kill for the enemy marksman.
events.gameplay_event: Angela rotates to bottom lane through the river without vision.
events.evidence: Angela is intercepted and killed by Garo in the river area.
events.recommended_action: Use safer paths through the jungle when missing vision on enemy damage dealers.

events.coach_claim: Failure to assist the jungler with wave/camp clear reduces team efficiency.
events.gameplay_event: Angela walks past Han Xin without using a skill to help him clear.
events.evidence: Angela ignores the nearby jungle camp while rotating back to lane.
events.recommended_action: Use Skill 1 to help the jungler clear faster when passing by; it builds passive stacks and speeds up team gold.

events.coach_claim: Unnecessary rotation to top lane leads to mid-tower damage and lost farm.
events.gameplay_event: Angela rotates to support a lane where the enemy is not vulnerable.
events.evidence: Angela spends time in the top bush while Chang'e pushes mid and the mid tower takes damage.
events.recommended_action: Only rotate when there is a high probability of a kill or to defend; otherwise, prioritize mid-lane farm and tower health.

events.coach_claim: Face-checking a bush while distracted by the shop results in death.
events.gameplay_event: Angela enters a bush without vision or using skills to check it.
events.evidence: Angela's character walks into a bush and is immediately jumped by multiple enemies while the shop menu is likely open.
events.recommended_action: Use Skill 1 to check bushes before entering and avoid browsing the shop in contested areas.

events.coach_claim: Repetitive pathing errors lead to being caught by the same enemy.
events.gameplay_event: Angela takes a predictable path and gets hit by Garo's Skill 2 again.
events.evidence: Angela walks in a straight line and is hit by Garo's long-range silence/slow.
events.recommended_action: Incorporate erratic movement (dodging) and avoid predictable rotation paths.

events.coach_claim: Poor skill sequencing during an ambush prevents a confirmed kill.
events.gameplay_event: The 2-1-3 skill combo is executed poorly, missing key damage.
events.evidence: Angela misses Skill 1 after landing Skill 2, failing to burst the target.
events.recommended_action: Practice the 2-1-3 combo timing to ensure all projectiles land while the target is stunned.

events.coach_claim: Overstaying after a kill leads to a revenge kill by the enemy.
events.gameplay_event: Angela fails to retreat after Li Bai secures a kill, taking unnecessary damage.
events.evidence: Angela lingers in the river with low HP and is finished off by Shao Siming.
events.recommended_action: Retreat immediately after a successful pick-off if health is low or enemy reinforcements are near.

events.coach_claim: Successful use of Flash to reposition and secure a kill.
events.gameplay_event: Angela uses Flash to adjust the angle of her Ultimate.
events.evidence: Angela Flashes during her Skill 3 to track and kill Shao Siming.
events.recommended_action: Continue practicing Flash-Ult repositioning to secure kills on mobile targets.

events.coach_claim: Disorganized skill usage in a chaotic teamfight.
events.gameplay_event: Skills are fired in multiple directions without a clear target.
events.evidence: Angela's Skill 1, 2, and 3 are aimed at different enemies/directions in rapid succession.
events.recommended_action: Focus fire on a single high-priority target to ensure a kill rather than spreading damage.

events.coach_claim: Final positioning error leads to the game-ending death.
events.gameplay_event: Angela walks into the enemy's face and fails to use Flash defensively.
events.evidence: Angela is caught by Mulan and dies without using her available Flash to escape.
events.recommended_action: Maintain maximum range during late-game sieges and use Flash proactively to avoid hard CC.

events.coach_claim: Buying boots first for movement speed is a vital habit for top-tier mid-laners.
events.gameplay_event: Initial item purchase.
events.evidence: Visible item shop and movement.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize early mobility to enable faster rotations.

events.coach_claim: Using skills to clear the wave quickly secures mid-lane priority.
events.gameplay_event: Clearing the first mid wave.
events.evidence: Audio commentary; visible skill usage.
events.recommended_action: Use abilities to clear waves instantly to roam first.

events.coach_claim: Overextending for vision when the enemy jungler's position is known (red start) is high risk.
events.gameplay_event: Scouting enemy blue area at 55s.
events.evidence: Audio warning; visible enemy jungle timers.
events.recommended_action: Avoid deep vision checks without backup when enemy gank potential is high.

events.coach_claim: Roam to the clash lane to utilize the teleportation array for faster returns.
events.gameplay_event: Roaming after clearing mid.
events.evidence: Audio suggestion; visible map layout.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize roaming to lanes with teleport support to minimize missed farm.

events.coach_claim: Use the ultimate's damage mitigation property immediately to survive dives.
events.gameplay_event: Nezha dives Hai Yue (1st death).
events.evidence: Visible ult usage; player death inside realm.
events.recommended_action: Activate ultimate early during a dive to absorb burst damage.

events.coach_claim: Use Flash early to escape catch-heavy heroes like Nezha rather than relying solely on the ult.
events.gameplay_event: Caught in river by Nezha (2nd death).
events.evidence: Visible death; coach critique of Flash usage.
events.recommended_action: Use Flash to break distance before the enemy CC/damage connects.

events.coach_claim: Pulling an enemy into the illusion realm without teammates nearby leads to being surrounded upon exit.
events.gameplay_event: Pulling Sun Ce into ult (5th death).
events.evidence: Visible exit from realm into 4 enemies.
events.recommended_action: Coordinate ultimate usage with team positioning to ensure a safe exit.

events.coach_claim: Maintain distance inside the illusion realm, especially against high-damage melee heroes when low on HP.
events.gameplay_event: Pulling Nezha while low (6th death).
events.evidence: Visible melee combat inside the realm.
events.recommended_action: Use the realm's space and movement speed to kite melee threats.

events.coach_claim: Do not let a poor KDA (1-8) cause mental tilt; focus on the review and adjusting strategy.
events.gameplay_event: Post-game summary.
events.evidence: Audio encouragement; visible end-game stats.
events.recommended_action: Focus on objective review and mechanical adjustments over scoreboard numbers.

events.coach_claim: Xiao Qiao is stronger at Lv1 than Mao Mi; good restraint not to flash for a kill.
events.gameplay_event: Laning phase; Mao Mi is low HP but Xiao Qiao retreats.
events.evidence: Lan Ling Wang (enemy jungle) is missing; Luna started red buff.
events.recommended_action: Maintain map awareness of enemy jungle paths before committing summoner spells.

events.coach_claim: Poor damage calculation; death was avoidable.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao attempts a trade but miscalculates burst, leading to death.
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao's HP drops to zero during an ill-advised engagement.
events.recommended_action: Practice hero damage thresholds to avoid "sending" kills.

events.coach_claim: Do not path through the river without Flash or Ultimate when the enemy jungle is on that side.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao respawns and moves toward bot lane through the unwarded river.
events.evidence: Enemy Luna is red-side; Xiao Qiao has no defensive tools available.
events.recommended_action: Path safely through own jungle when vision is unavailable and cooldowns are down.

events.coach_claim: Skillshot accuracy was non-existent ("dreaming").
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao attempts to engage Lan Ling Wang but misses both S1 and S2.
events.evidence: Visual confirmation of skills missing the target entirely.
events.recommended_action: Improve skillshot leading and wait for CC setup from teammates.

events.coach_claim: Typing during active gameplay leads to unnecessary deaths.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao opens the chat to type "666" and is immediately caught and killed.
events.evidence: Chat interface is visible on screen as Xiao Qiao is attacked.
events.recommended_action: Disable chat or only type when safely inside the fountain.

events.coach_claim: Target prioritization was incorrect; should have focused Mo Zi.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao kills Lu Ban but allows the higher-threat Mo Zi to escape.
events.evidence: Mo Zi escapes with low HP while Xiao Qiao focuses the marksman.
events.recommended_action: Use Xiao Qiao's lock-on Ultimate to secure kills on high-mobility/high-threat targets first.

events.coach_claim: Walking through "dark" bushes alone is a high-risk, low-reward play.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao face-checks mid-river bushes without backup.
events.evidence: No vision provided by teammates or wards in the river area.
events.recommended_action: Use S1 to check bushes from a distance or rotate with the support.

events.coach_claim: Staying on the map with low HP was a good "greedy" play enabled by the support.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao stays at low HP to farm and eventually secures a kill on Kuang Tie.
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao's HP bar is critical, but she stays tethered to the support.
events.recommended_action: Recognize when it is safe to stay and farm versus when a recall is mandatory.

events.coach_claim: Repeated death due to typing; lost mid-lane towers as a result.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao types a long message, walks into Mo Zi, and dies again.
events.evidence: Mid T1 and T2 towers are lost shortly after this death.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize wave defense over social interaction; typing cost the team map control.

events.coach_claim: The game was lost due to teammate mentality (Hou Yi AFK/trolling).
events.gameplay_event: The marksman (Hou Yi) stands still in base and then feeds the enemy team.
events.evidence: Hou Yi's erratic movement and lack of participation in the final defense.
events.recommended_action: Focus on personal performance; report players who intentionally grief.

events.coach_claim: Lane priority was secured early, but the player failed to coordinate an invade with the jungler.
events.gameplay_event: Early laning phase; Xiao Qiao clears wave faster than Wang Zhaojun.
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao clears wave and pokes instead of moving to enemy jungle with Da Si Ming.
events.recommended_action: Coordinate with jungler to leverage lane priority for invades.

events.coach_claim: Mechanical failure on a Flash combo followed by an unnecessary death due to overstaying at low health.
events.gameplay_event: Skirmish in river; failed Flash-Skill 1 combo. Player walks into enemy Wang Zhaojun at low HP.
events.evidence: Visible missed Flash combo; player walks towards enemy after a kill instead of retreating.
events.recommended_action: Practice combo timing; prioritize safety and reset after securing kills when low on resources.

events.coach_claim: Poor map awareness and panic resource usage; player stayed in lane at critical HP after wasting Flash.
events.gameplay_event: Invading red jungle; player gets poked by Ma Chao, panics Flash, and stays to clear waves.
events.evidence: Player uses Flash defensively against minor poke and refuses to recall despite being one-shot.
events.recommended_action: Improve map awareness to avoid panic; recall immediately when resources are spent and HP is low.

events.coach_claim: Neglecting wave management and consistently getting caught by predictable enemy crowd control.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao misses multiple minion waves and gets frozen by Wang Zhaojun's Skill 2.
events.evidence: Minions die to tower while player is absent; visible death to Wang Zhaojun's freeze.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize wave collection for gold/exp; track enemy CC cooldowns and maintain safe distance.

events.coach_claim: Severe overextension during base defense followed by a reckless re-engagement without spells.
events.gameplay_event: Defense of mid tower; player walks into three enemies, wastes Ult/Flash to escape, then returns to die.
events.evidence: Player overextends, panics all spells, then walks back into a lost fight at low HP.
events.recommended_action: Maintain defensive positioning; do not re-engage in fights when ultimate and mobility spells are on cooldown.

events.coach_claim: Disastrous use of the teleport portal and failure to prioritize survival during the final base defense.
events.gameplay_event: Player teleports into the enemy team and dies; final team wipe at the crystal.
events.evidence: Visible teleport into enemy frontline; final death while defending the crystal.
events.recommended_action: Verify landing zone safety before using teleports; prioritize staying alive to clear waves during high-ground defense.

events.coach_claim: Junglers should clear the mid-lane wave if the mage rotates away and the enemy jungler is elsewhere.
events.gameplay_event: Mid-lane mage rotates to gank bot; Da Siming stays in the jungle.
events.evidence: Audio: "Mid line is right there, why not take it?" Visual: Mage is bot, wave dies to tower.
events.recommended_action: Clear mid waves when teammates rotate to maximize gold and pressure.

events.coach_claim: Use a "formulaic" pathing sequence (Red -> Pigs -> Bird) to align with the 2:10 mid-wave spawn.
events.gameplay_event: Da Siming clears jungle out of order, missing the mid-wave timing.
events.evidence: Audio: "Formulaic thinking... Red to Pigs to Bird." Visual: Da Siming is far from mid when wave arrives.
events.recommended_action: Optimize jungle clear sequence to be near mid-lane for every wave spawn.

events.coach_claim: Prioritize the Tyrant objective at the 4-minute mark instead of small jungle creeps.
events.gameplay_event: Tyrant spawns; Da Siming continues farming small camps.
events.evidence: Audio: "There's a dragon, you don't open it?" Visual: Tyrant is up, Da Siming is at small camps.
events.recommended_action: Secure major objectives immediately upon spawn if the map state allows.

events.coach_claim: Avoid diving towers for kills when playing a utility-focused "blue collar" jungler.
events.gameplay_event: Da Siming dives bot tower, takes massive damage, and dies.
events.evidence: Audio: "Blue collar jungler... why are you diving?" Visual: Da Siming dies under the enemy bot tower.
events.recommended_action: Focus on disruption and objective control rather than risky tower dives.

events.coach_claim: In low-to-mid ranks, play "Carry" junglers (Ye He) because teammates are often unreliable.
events.gameplay_event: Coach discusses the player's low gold and reliance on teammates.
events.evidence: Audio: "At 1200 points, who will help you? Play carry junglers."
events.recommended_action: Switch from utility/tank junglers to high-damage carry junglers for solo queue.

events.coach_claim: Do not use mobility skills (Da Siming S2) predictably into enemy CC zones.
events.gameplay_event: Da Siming uses S2 into Wang Zhaojun's freeze and dies.
events.evidence: Audio: "Don't rush S2 before Zhaojun uses her CC." Visual: Da Siming is frozen and bursted.
events.recommended_action: Wait for enemy key CC abilities to be on cooldown before committing mobility.

events.coach_claim: Player initially headed toward the wrong lane.
events.gameplay_event: Mulan walks toward the development lane (bottom) at start.
events.evidence: Visual: Mulan pathing toward bottom before turning back.
events.recommended_action: Check lane assignments immediately upon spawning.

events.coach_claim: Level 1 Mulan is weak; shouldn't contest the wave directly or ignore jungle creeps.
events.gameplay_event: Mulan uses 2nd skill to clear minions early instead of taking the bird creep.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach notes level 1 weakness. Visual: Mulan uses skill on wave, taking poke.
events.recommended_action: Start with jungle creeps (bird) or play safe under tower until level 2.

events.coach_claim: The player failed to execute the silence combo during a mid-lane rotation.
events.gameplay_event: Mulan engages but fails to trigger silence on the target.
events.evidence: Visual: Skill sequence fails to apply the silence mark.
events.recommended_action: Practice the 2nd-1st-1st skill sequence for reliable silence.

events.coach_claim: Ignored enemy jungler's position on map while at low HP.
events.gameplay_event: Mulan stays in jungle at low health while Ake is visible nearby on minimap.
events.evidence: Visual: Ake appears on minimap in red buff area; Mulan moves toward her.
events.recommended_action: Recall immediately or stay behind the inner tower when low and enemy is near.

events.coach_claim: Failed to capitalize on a level 4 power spike against a target without Flash.
events.gameplay_event: Mulan misses Heavy Sword 2nd skill, allowing Irene to escape.
events.evidence: Visual: Heavy Sword push misses the target entirely.
events.recommended_action: Confirm silence before transitioning to Heavy Sword for guaranteed CC.

events.coach_claim: Teleporting to mid without managing the side lane wave first.
events.gameplay_event: Mulan uses teleport while her own lane minions are still pushing in.
events.evidence: Visual: Mulan teleports away while top minions are uncollected.
events.recommended_action: Clear the immediate wave before rotating or using global teleports.

events.coach_claim: Reckless aggression leading to a 1-for-1 trade and a tower dive death.
events.gameplay_event: Mulan trades kills with Irene, then later dives a tower and dies.
events.evidence: Visual: Mulan dies under tower after failing a kill attempt.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize survival and wave pressure over risky, low-reward kills.

events.coach_claim: Poor rotation choice; teleported to bottom instead of helping mid-tower push.
events.gameplay_event: Mulan teleports to the development lane despite a team advantage in mid.
events.evidence: Visual: Mulan teleports away from a grouping team.
events.recommended_action: Identify the most valuable objective (mid tower) and group accordingly.

events.coach_claim: Chasing kills instead of defending the jungle or pushing towers.
events.gameplay_event: Mulan chases Yixing, leading to her death and loss of team buffs.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach critiques "thirst for kills." Visual: Mulan dies in enemy jungle.
events.recommended_action: Focus on map control and buff protection when the enemy jungler is alive.

events.coach_claim: Hypocritical play; told team not to feed, then engaged alone and died.
events.gameplay_event: Mulan types a warning to team, then immediately dies in a 1vN scenario.
events.evidence: Visual: Chat log vs. Mulan's immediate death.
events.recommended_action: Wait for teammates to respawn/group before contesting territory.

events.coach_claim: Lingering in a teamfight with no cooldowns or health.
events.gameplay_event: Mulan stays in the fray after using all skills, dying to an invisible Ake.
events.evidence: Visual: Mulan stays at low HP with skills on CD; Ake cleans up.
events.recommended_action: Disengage to the backline or bush once primary burst combo is spent.

events.coach_claim: Total mechanical breakdown during the final base defense.
events.gameplay_event: Mulan misses all skills while the enemy pushes the crystal.
events.evidence: Visual: Mulan's skills miss all targets during the final stand.
events.recommended_action: Maintain composure; aim skills at high-priority targets (minions/carries).

events.coach_claim: Check mid-lane priority before invading.
events.gameplay_event: Pei Qinhu attempts a level 1 invade while his mid-laner (Mimi) is pressured under tower.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach notes Mimi's weak early combat power vs. minions.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize lane state over blind invades; wait for mid to push.

events.coach_claim: Learning the wrong skill at Level 1 ruins early tempo.
events.gameplay_event: Player learns Skill 1 instead of Skill 2, losing wall-hop mobility and clear speed.
events.evidence: Visible: Pei Qinhu walking around walls instead of jumping; Audio: Coach mentions "low mobility."
events.recommended_action: Always learn Skill 2 first on Pei Qinhu for jungle clearing and mobility.

events.coach_claim: Avoid "Pokemon" behavior (blindly chasing low-HP targets).
events.gameplay_event: Pei Qinhu dives deep into the enemy tower to chase a low-health enemy, ignoring the risk.
events.evidence: Visible: Pei Qinhu diving under tower; Audio: Coach calls it "Pokemon" behavior.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize survival and objective control over risky kills.

events.coach_claim: Do not invade without support or vision of the enemy jungler.
events.gameplay_event: Pei Qinhu enters the enemy jungle while his support is top; he is ambushed by Han Xin.
events.evidence: Visible: Han Xin appearing from a bush to burst Pei Qinhu.
events.recommended_action: Track enemy jungler position and ensure numerical advantage before invading.

events.coach_claim: Manage health and resources efficiently before contesting waves.
events.gameplay_event: At critical HP, Pei Qinhu takes the mid wave instead of clearing his own jungle to heal/lifesteal.
events.evidence: Visible: Pei Qinhu at <10% HP hitting minions in mid lane.
events.recommended_action: Use jungle camps to lifesteal and reset before appearing on the map.

events.coach_claim: Overextending for kills leads to being counter-ganked.
events.gameplay_event: Pei Qinhu chases Han Xin past the mid tower and gets CC-chained by Guiguzi and Wang Zhaojun.
events.evidence: Visible: Pei Qinhu caught in Wang Zhaojun's freeze after a long chase.
events.recommended_action: Respect enemy CC and avoid chasing past safe zones without backup.

events.coach_claim: Prioritize defending high-value towers (Mid Tier 1) over side-lane farm.
events.gameplay_event: Pei Qinhu clears top wave while the enemy team pushes and destroys the mid-lane tower.
events.evidence: Visible: Mid tower falling while Pei Qinhu is in the top lane.
events.recommended_action: Rotate to mid immediately when the enemy group pushes, as mid tower is the most strategic.

events.coach_claim: Avoid ganking high-mobility targets when you are visible on the map.
events.gameplay_event: Pei Qinhu attempts to gank a Red-buffed Marco Polo while walking through vision; he is easily killed.
events.evidence: Visible: Pei Qinhu walking directly at Marco Polo and dying to poke.
events.recommended_action: Use fog of war and bushes to initiate; do not force ganks on fed marksmen.

events.coach_claim: Stay active and focused even when behind.
events.gameplay_event: Player stands still in the fountain "thinking" while teammates are dying in a defense.
events.evidence: Visible: Pei Qinhu idle in base for several seconds.
events.recommended_action: Minimize downtime; always be moving toward an objective or defending.

events.coach_claim: Do not clear waves alone in deep territory when the enemy is missing.
events.gameplay_event: Pei Qinhu tries to clear the bottom wave and is instantly caught and killed by Han Xin.
events.evidence: Visible: Han Xin killing Pei Qinhu in the bottom lane.
events.recommended_action: Group with the team or stay near towers when the enemy jungler is unaccounted for.

events.coach_claim: "Xiao Qiao is unbeatable at level 1 if she hits her fans, but greed leads to death."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao attempts to kill a low-HP Hai Yue but misses Skill 1 and Flashes into tower range.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach critiques the Flash + Skill 1 combo. Visual: Xiao Qiao dies under the enemy tower.
events.recommended_action: Practice the Skill 1 + Flash buffering; don't dive without guaranteed kill.

events.coach_claim: "Chasing without Flash is suicide, especially into the enemy jungle."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao chases Hai Yue into the river/jungle without Flash and is intercepted by Han Xin.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach notes lack of Flash. Visual: Han Xin appears from the fog to kill Xiao Qiao.
events.recommended_action: Monitor enemy jungler position; do not overextend without escape tools.

events.coach_claim: "You must stay under the tower when Flash is down, especially against Hai Yue."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao stands near the river entrance without Flash and gets pulled into Hai Yue's ultimate domain.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach advises "playing cowardly" under the tower. Visual: Xiao Qiao is caught far from safety.
events.recommended_action: Respect the enemy's ultimate range when your defensive spells are on cooldown.

events.coach_claim: "You need to know where the next objective is; support the lane that needs help."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao clears mid but hesitates. Coach suggests supporting the bot lane skirmish for the red buff.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach analyzes the map state (safe jungle, winning top). Visual: Skirmish happening at the bottom red buff.
events.recommended_action: Improve map awareness to identify where numerical advantages can be created.

events.coach_claim: "Getting a kill is good, but dying immediately after negates the advantage."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao kills Hai Yue with Flash + Skill 1 but is immediately killed by Lan Ling Wang.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach notes the trade is "not a loss" but critiques the follow-up death. Visual: Lan Ling Wang appears post-kill.
events.recommended_action: Retreat immediately after using key cooldowns for a pick-off.

events.coach_claim: "Recalling in plain sight is an invitation for the enemy to engage."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao attempts to recall in the lane brush while visible to Hai Yue, who pulls her into the domain.
events.evidence: Audio: "Can't you walk two more steps?" Visual: Recalling animation visible to the enemy.
events.recommended_action: Move further back into the fog of war or under a tier-2 tower to recall safely.

events.coach_claim: "Bush checking without vision or teammates is how you feed."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao enters a bush near the mid-river and is instantly caught by Lao Fu Zi's ultimate.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach mentions a WeChat notification distraction. Visual: Lao Fu Zi waiting in the bush.
events.recommended_action: Use Skill 1 to scout bushes from a distance; do not face-check.

events.coach_claim: "Standing with the minion wave makes you an easy target for splash damage."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao stands inside her own minion wave and takes poke damage from Hai Yue, leading to a death.
events.evidence: Audio: "You just have to stand with the minions." Visual: Hai Yue's skills hitting both minions and Xiao Qiao.
events.recommended_action: Position yourself away from the minion wave to force the enemy to choose between poking or clearing.

events.coach_claim: "Blindly supporting a lost fight just adds to the death count."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao Flashes into a chaotic river fight without vision of the full enemy team and dies to Hai Yue.
events.evidence: Audio: "Magical Girl will always support, no matter what." Visual: Xiao Qiao Flashes into a 1v3 scenario.
events.recommended_action: Evaluate the likelihood of success before committing Flash to a skirmish.

events.coach_claim: "Contesting the Overlord alone against a fed Han Xin is a mistake."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao approaches the Overlord pit without teammates and is deleted by Han Xin.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach critiques the decision to go to the pit. Visual: Han Xin kills Xiao Qiao in two hits.
events.recommended_action: Only contest major objectives with team backup and vision of the enemy jungler.

events.coach_claim: "Fixed builds are for beginners; adapt your items to the enemy threats."
events.gameplay_event: Coach critiques the player for building "Scholar's Rage" instead of "Zhuan Shen" (Golden Body) against Hai Yue.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach explains the need for Zhuan Shen to counter the ultimate. Visual: Shop menu showing fixed build path.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize defensive items (Zhuan Shen) when an enemy has a point-and-click suppression ultimate.

events.coach_claim: "Hiding in a bush and waiting for the enemy to commit is the correct way to play."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao waits in a side bush, lets the enemy engage her team, then cleans up the backline.
events.evidence: Audio: "Hiding vision makes it easy to squat people." Visual: Xiao Qiao gets a double kill from a bush.
events.recommended_action: Maintain "fog of war" presence to surprise high-priority targets.

events.coach_claim: Player ignored multiple "Follow Me" signals and text messages from Chang'e.
events.gameplay_event: Dolia goes to the farm lane instead of following the mid-laner.
events.evidence: Three visible "Follow Me" signals and a voice-to-text message from Chang'e.
events.recommended_action: Pay closer attention to teammate signals and prioritize following the core playmaker.

events.coach_claim: Using Skill 1 to hit minions is a mistake as it can lead to the enemy freezing the wave.
events.gameplay_event: Dolia uses her first skill on a full-health minion wave.
events.evidence: Visual of Dolia's Skill 1 hitting three minions simultaneously.
events.recommended_action: Save skills to poke enemies or help clear only when necessary to avoid unintended wave pushing.

events.coach_claim: Player lacks anti-gank awareness despite the enemy jungler's position being unknown.
events.gameplay_event: Dolia plays aggressively in the river without vision of the enemy jungler.
events.evidence: Mini-map shows the enemy jungler is not visible while Dolia is overextended.
events.recommended_action: Play more cautiously when the enemy jungler is missing from the map.

events.coach_claim: Face-checking a bush with Skill 2 is dangerous; Skill 1 should be used for vision instead.
events.gameplay_event: Dolia uses her jump (Skill 2) directly into a river bush.
events.evidence: Visual of Dolia using Skill 2 to enter a bush without prior scouting.
events.recommended_action: Use Skill 1's sound waves to check bushes from a safe distance before entering.

events.coach_claim: Again, the player fails to use Skill 1 to scout the river while rotating.
events.gameplay_event: Dolia walks through the river to mid-lane without checking bushes.
events.evidence: Dolia moves through high-risk areas without using her vision-granting Skill 1.
events.recommended_action: Consistently use Skill 1 to scout bushes during rotations to avoid ambushes.

events.coach_claim: Player's reaction to the mid-laner's invade signal was too slow.
events.gameplay_event: Chang'e signals to invade the blue buff, but Dolia stays in lane too long.
events.evidence: Visible "Attack" signals on the enemy blue buff while Dolia remains near the tower.
events.recommended_action: React immediately to invade calls when your team has a clear advantage.

events.coach_claim: Another instance of a delayed response to the mid-laner's gathering signal.
events.gameplay_event: Chang'e signals to gather, but Dolia is slow to rotate from the farm lane.
events.evidence: Multiple gathering signals from Chang'e while Dolia is preoccupied with minions.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize team movements and rotations over minor lane resources in the early-mid game.

events.coach_claim: Recalling to base was unnecessary and slowed down the tempo; buying a support item would suffice.
events.gameplay_event: Dolia recalls to base despite having enough gold for a new item.
events.evidence: Dolia's health/mana are decent, and she has enough gold to purchase 'Spring'.
events.recommended_action: Buy 'Spring' (support item) to sustain in the field and maintain map pressure instead of recalling.

events.coach_claim: Jumping into three enemies under a tower resulted in a needless death.
events.gameplay_event: Dolia uses Skill 2 to dive deep into the enemy tower against multiple foes.
events.evidence: Visual of Dolia jumping into the tower and getting hit by Di Renjie's yellow card.
events.recommended_action: Avoid aggressive dives into multiple enemies under their tower, especially as a support.

events.coach_claim: Player is repeatedly taking unnecessary tower damage for no clear objective.
events.gameplay_event: Dolia walks in and out of tower range, absorbing multiple shots.
events.evidence: Dolia takes three consecutive tower shots while her team is not actively diving.
events.recommended_action: Stay outside of tower range unless actively participating in a coordinated dive or push.

events.coach_claim: Poor positioning and ignoring the enemy support led to another death under the tower.
events.gameplay_event: Dolia stands near Da Qiao under the tower and dies to tower fire.
events.evidence: Dolia fails to dodge Da Qiao's skills and continues to draw tower aggro until death.
events.recommended_action: Maintain better spacing from enemy CC and exit tower range immediately after taking aggro.

events.coach_claim: Player died again under the enemy tower during the final push due to over-aggression.
events.gameplay_event: Dolia dives the fountain/tower area during the final push and dies.
events.evidence: Dolia uses her skills to enter the enemy's deep base area and is killed by the tower.
events.recommended_action: Focus on the objective (the crystal) during the final push rather than chasing kills into the fountain.

events.coach_claim: Arriving at lane late (26s) loses early priority and wave control.
events.gameplay_event: Angela reaches the mid lane significantly after the first wave meets.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela is still walking from the fountain at 26s.
events.recommended_action: Move to the lane immediately at the start to contest the first wave.

events.coach_claim: Flashing for a kill without vision of the enemy jungler leads to an avoidable death.
events.gameplay_event: Angela flashes to chase Xiao Qiao and is immediately killed by Li Bai.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach notes Li Bai was "blue-starting." Visual: Li Bai appears from fog.
events.recommended_action: Track the enemy jungler's pathing; do not use Flash aggressively without info.

events.coach_claim: Poor skill accuracy and unnecessary tower diving waste resources and health.
events.gameplay_event: Angela misses skills on Lanling Wang and takes multiple tower shots for no gain.
events.evidence: Visual: Skill indicators miss; Angela takes "unforced" tower damage.
events.recommended_action: Practice leading targets with skill shots and stay out of tower range.

events.coach_claim: Missing the full 2-1-3 combo makes the hero a vulnerable target for counters.
events.gameplay_event: Angela misses her entire burst combo on Xiao Qiao and is killed in return.
events.evidence: Visual: Skill 2 (stun) misses, followed by wasted Skill 1 and Ultimate.
events.recommended_action: Ensure the stun (Skill 2) lands before committing the full burst combo.

events.coach_claim: Ignoring a 4-minute dragon fight to farm minor jungle creeps is a major macro error.
events.gameplay_event: Angela farms raptors while a teamfight occurs at the dragon pit.
events.evidence: Visual: Minimap shows a cluster of icons at the dragon while Angela is at a camp.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize team objectives (Dragon/Tyrant) over minor jungle camps.

events.coach_claim: Attempting to defend a tower solo against a group is a "free gift" to the enemy.
events.gameplay_event: Angela stands under the mid tower solo against three enemies and dies.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela is surrounded and dived under her own tower.
events.recommended_action: Abandon the tower if outnumbered and no teammates are nearby to assist.

events.coach_claim: Ambushing a full-health tank (Lian Po) alone is a waste of a burst mage's cooldowns.
events.gameplay_event: Angela uses her full combo on Lian Po, who survives easily and kills her.
events.evidence: Visual: Lian Po's health remains high after taking the full combo.
events.recommended_action: Target squishy carries (Mage/Marksman) rather than high-health tanks.

events.coach_claim: Poor spacing causes death from splash damage intended for a teammate.
events.gameplay_event: Angela dies to Li Bai's skill while standing too close to Han Xin.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach explains the "chain damage" effect from the Tyrant buff.
events.recommended_action: Maintain distance from teammates who are being targeted by enemy assassins.

events.coach_claim: Lack of magic penetration items makes the player ineffective against tanks.
events.gameplay_event: Angela deals negligible damage to Lian Po despite having high AP items.
events.evidence: Visual: Item shop shows pure AP items but no Void Staff or penetration.
events.recommended_action: Build magic penetration (Void Staff) earlier when facing high-defense tanks.

events.coach_claim: The victory was achieved by teammates carrying a poorly performing player.
events.gameplay_event: The team wins the final fight and the game despite Angela's 4-15 score.
events.evidence: Visual: Victory screen shows Angela's 4-15-5 KDA and a 5.2 rating.
events.recommended_action: Acknowledge mistakes and focus on reducing deaths to avoid being a burden.

events.coach_claim: Invading at level 1 with an 88 magic penetration build provides explosive early damage.
events.gameplay_event: Zhang Liang invades the enemy red buff area at level 1.
events.evidence: Zhang Liang uses Skill 2 three times, then Flash + Basic Attack to kill Han Xin.
events.recommended_action: Leverage early power spikes to disrupt enemy jungler's pathing.

events.coach_claim: Predicting the enemy jungler's return to their buff allows for successful counter-jungling.
events.gameplay_event: Zhang Liang waits in the bush and steals the enemy red buff.
events.evidence: Zhang Liang waits in the bush behind the red buff pit for Han Xin to return.
events.recommended_action: Track enemy buff timers to plan high-value invades.

events.coach_claim: Coordinating hard CC with high-damage teammates secures early picks.
events.gameplay_event: Zhang Liang ganks mid and ults Jin Chan.
events.evidence: Zhang Liang uses his ultimate on Jin Chan; Nuwa follows up with damage for the kill.
events.recommended_action: Communicate ultimate availability to teammates for coordinated ganks.

events.coach_claim: Invading deep into enemy territory without teammate proximity is a high-risk error.
events.gameplay_event: Zhang Liang attempts a solo red buff steal and dies.
events.evidence: Teammates (Nuwa, Zhao Yun) are in the top lane while Zhang Liang is caught alone.
events.recommended_action: Check the minimap for teammate positions before crossing the river.

events.coach_claim: Contesting buffs while at a numerical disadvantage leads to snowballing losses.
events.gameplay_event: The team attempts to contest red buff; marksman and jungler are killed.
events.evidence: The marksman is dove under the tower; the jungler dies shortly after.
events.recommended_action: Concede minor objectives when outnumbered to prevent further deaths.

events.coach_claim: Diving without clear coordination or focus fire wastes resources and results in deaths.
events.gameplay_event: Zhang Liang, Nuwa, and Nezha attempt a top lane dive that fails.
events.evidence: Skills are expended without securing a kill; Zhang Liang is left behind and dies.
events.recommended_action: Set clear targets before diving and ensure an exit path is available.

events.coach_claim: Engaging in a fight while teammates are split-pushing is risky despite successful outcomes.
events.gameplay_event: The team engages in a skirmish while shorthanded; Nuwa teleports to assist.
events.evidence: Zhang Liang ults Xiang Yu while two teammates are clearing other lanes.
events.recommended_action: Avoid initiating teamfights when the team is not grouped unless it's a guaranteed pick.

events.coach_claim: Clearing waves deep in enemy territory without vision is a primary cause of being picked off.
events.gameplay_event: The marksman (Alessio) is solo killed while clearing the top lane wave.
events.evidence: Alessio is positioned deep in the lane without vision of Sun Shangxiang.
events.recommended_action: Only push past the river when enemy positions are confirmed on the map.

events.coach_claim: Flashing into multiple enemies to use a single-target ultimate is a suicidal play.
events.gameplay_event: Zhang Liang flashes into the enemy team to ult and dies instantly.
events.evidence: Zhang Liang flashes into 3-4 enemies; he is immediately CC'd and killed.
events.recommended_action: Save Flash for defensive repositioning or to secure an isolated, high-value target.

events.coach_claim: Failing to convert a successful defense into a neutral objective cedes map control.
events.gameplay_event: The team wins a skirmish but fails to take the Dark Tyrant.
events.evidence: The team pushes mid instead of rotating to the available Tyrant objective.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize neutral objectives (Dragons/Tyrants) immediately after winning a fight.

events.coach_claim: Overstaying at the enemy high ground after taking an inhibitor leads to unnecessary team wipes.
events.gameplay_event: The team lingers at the enemy base and gets wiped by respawning enemies.
events.evidence: The team remains near the enemy crystal after taking the mid inhibitor and is engaged.
events.recommended_action: Retreat and reset for the next wave or objective after taking a high-ground tower.

events.coach_claim: Hesitating to use escape tools until the last moment often results in a "death flash."
events.gameplay_event: Zhang Liang is caught and uses Flash too late to survive.
events.evidence: Zhang Liang is CC'd, waits several seconds, then flashes right before dying.
events.recommended_action: Use Flash proactively to avoid CC rather than reactively after taking fatal damage.

events.coach_claim: Prioritize poking the enemy at level 1 to gain lane priority.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao uses Skill 1 twice to deplete Angela's HP.
events.evidence: Angela's HP bar drops significantly; Xiao Qiao clears the wave first.
events.recommended_action: Continue aggressive poking to maintain lane control.

events.coach_claim: Do not blindly chase low-HP enemies into dangerous territory (turret diving).
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao chases Angela past the inner turret to the high ground and dies.
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao dies to turret damage/Angela; coach mentions "desire for residual blood."
events.recommended_action: Retreat after forcing the enemy back; prioritize safety over a risky kill.

events.coach_claim: Pre-order items to optimize gold usage and reaction time.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao opens the shop and pre-orders Echo's Scepter.
events.evidence: Item shop UI shows the pre-order selection.
events.recommended_action: Maintain this habit for efficient item progression.

events.coach_claim: Be cautious when roaming through the river; avoid "face-checking" bushes.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao walks directly into the river bush without using skills to check first.
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao enters the bush blindly; coach calls it "carefree like a fool."
events.recommended_action: Use Skill 1 to check bushes from a distance before entering.

events.coach_claim: Clear waves efficiently before rotating to ensure objective pressure.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao attempts to rotate and catch Luban but arrives late/ineffectively.
events.evidence: Luban escapes; coach notes the "train of thought was slow."
events.recommended_action: Optimize wave clear speed and choose more direct rotation paths.

events.coach_claim: Skill-checking bushes is only effective if you wait for feedback or maintain distance.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao throws a skill into a bush but immediately walks in anyway.
events.evidence: Coach states: "If someone was in there, they'd have dumped skills on your face."
events.recommended_action: Wait for the skill to hit/miss before committing to the path.

events.coach_claim: Maintain map awareness; don't return to areas where enemies were recently spotted.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao retreats toward the blue buff area where Kai was just seen and dies.
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao dies to Kai; coach asks "Did you forget Kai was there?"
events.recommended_action: Track enemy jungler movements on the minimap to choose safe retreat paths.

events.coach_claim: Prioritize wave management in the late game to create numerical advantages.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao pushes the mid wave, forcing an enemy to defend, creating a 5v4.
events.evidence: The mid wave reaches the enemy tower; coach highlights the "5-on-4 state."
events.recommended_action: Focus on wave pressure to force enemy splits before engaging.

events.coach_claim: Position behind the frontline in late-game teamfights to maximize damage output.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao stays near the shooter (Huang Zhong) and uses skills to peel/damage.
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao secures a quadra kill; coach praises the "perfect position."
events.recommended_action: Stay behind tanks/initiators; focus on high-value targets while staying safe.

events.coach_claim: Hooked the wrong target after a flash play.
events.gameplay_event: Zhong Kui flashes to hook the blue buff but hits Lanling Wang instead.
events.evidence: Visual: Hook misses the buff and grabs a hero.
events.recommended_action: Improve hook precision when aiming for specific non-hero targets.

events.coach_claim: Neglected the ADC to attempt a low-value jungle invade.
events.gameplay_event: Zhong Kui leaves Hou Yi alone to try hooking the enemy red buff.
events.evidence: Visual: Hou Yi is pressured while Zhong Kui is in the enemy jungle.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize lane protection for the ADC over risky buff steals.

events.coach_claim: Created a numerical disadvantage through poor map presence.
events.gameplay_event: Zhong Kui stays in the clash lane while the enemy support rotates to mid.
events.evidence: Visual: Mini-map shows Zhong Kui out of position relative to the enemy support.
events.recommended_action: Match enemy support rotations to prevent the team from being outnumbered.

events.coach_claim: Hooked an enemy without having the Ultimate ready for follow-up.
events.gameplay_event: Zhong Kui hooks Wu Zetian under the tower but has no Ult to secure the kill.
events.evidence: Visual: Hook lands, but the player is unable to follow up with CC.
events.recommended_action: Always check skill cooldowns before initiating a hook.

events.coach_claim: Initiated a fight when the team was in no condition to follow up.
events.gameplay_event: Zhong Kui hooks an enemy while nearby teammates are at critically low health.
events.evidence: Visual: Teammates' HP bars are low during the initiation.
events.recommended_action: Assess teammate health and readiness before engaging.

events.coach_claim: Wasted high-impact abilities on a minion.
events.gameplay_event: Zhong Kui hooks a minion and immediately follows up with his Ultimate.
events.evidence: Visual: Hook hits a minion; Ultimate is wasted on the same spot.
events.recommended_action: Improve target acquisition and avoid panic-using the Ultimate.

events.coach_claim: Hooked a dangerous threat directly into himself.
events.gameplay_event: Zhong Kui hooks Di Renjie, who then proceeds to kill him instantly.
events.evidence: Visual: Di Renjie is pulled in and bursts down Zhong Kui.
events.recommended_action: Avoid hooking high-damage threats that can kill you at close range.

events.coach_claim: Unusual early-game rotations by the enemy went unnoticed.
events.gameplay_event: Player dies to a 3-man gank at level 2.
events.evidence: Hainuo roams mid at level 1; Diaochan teleports to the top lane.
events.recommended_action: Monitor the minimap for unusual lane swaps or early teleports.

events.coach_claim: The player had zero map awareness despite enemies being visible.
events.gameplay_event: Caught by Sangqi and Xuance while attacking a Space Spirit.
events.evidence: Enemy icons are clearly moving toward the player on the minimap.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize map information over minor neutral objectives when overextended.

events.coach_claim: The player wasted a personal teleport on a fight that was already lost.
events.gameplay_event: Teleporting into an unfavorable dragon pit skirmish.
events.evidence: Player uses the teleport skill instead of the lane array; arrives late.
events.recommended_action: Use lane teleport arrays for general rotations; save skills for strategic flanks.

events.coach_claim: Pushing towers while the team distracts the enemy is the player's only contribution.
events.gameplay_event: Successfully taking the T1 and T2 towers.
events.evidence: Towers are destroyed while the enemy team is occupied in mid/jungle.
events.recommended_action: When behind in gold/KDA, focus on split-pushing to create map pressure.

events.coach_claim: The player engages "blindly" without checking teammate positioning.
events.gameplay_event: Solo 1v5 ultimate dive into the enemy team.
events.evidence: Player activates ultimate and dives while teammates are out of range.
events.recommended_action: Wait for the team's primary engage or follow-up before committing an ultimate.

events.coach_claim: The player lacks basic tactical thinking during retreats.
events.gameplay_event: Dying to Xuance after a failed buff steal.
events.evidence: Player fails to dodge Xuance's hook despite knowing his position.
events.recommended_action: Respect the reach of enemy crowd control when retreating through the jungle.

events.coach_claim: The team's morale is suffering due to the player's repeated feeding.
events.gameplay_event: The friendly jungler pleads with the player in chat.
events.evidence: Audio/Text: "Brother, don't do this." (Referring to the 15th death).
events.recommended_action: Adopt a strictly defensive posture and stay near teammates when 0-10+.

events.coach_claim: Xiao Qiao gains lane priority because the opposing Angela was slow to reach the lane.
events.gameplay_event: Early laning phase; Xiao Qiao hits Level 2 first.
events.evidence: Visible level advantage and faster wave clear.
events.recommended_action: Use early priority to scout the enemy jungle or pressure other lanes.

events.coach_claim: Players must be more vigilant about vision when facing junglers like Wukong who can easily steal buffs.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao's red buff is stolen by Wukong while she focuses on a solo kill.
events.evidence: Audio commentary on the stolen buff; visible empty buff camp.
events.recommended_action: Check jungle camps more frequently when the enemy has high steal potential.

events.coach_claim: Counter-jungling was too arrogant; respawn timers are short in the early game.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao attempts to steal red buff but is chased down and eventually traded 1-for-1.
events.evidence: Wukong respawns and immediately punishes the overstay.
events.recommended_action: Do not overstay for counter-jungling without knowing enemy respawn timers.

events.coach_claim: Against high-sustain heroes like Cai Wenji, anti-heal items are mandatory and should not be delayed.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao changes her build order mid-way to include Nightmare's Fang.
events.evidence: Coach points out Cai Wenji's presence; Xiao Qiao's item shop interface is visible.
events.recommended_action: Build anti-heal earlier against sustain comps; finish major items before switching.

events.coach_claim: The team failed to coordinate a final push ("Yi Bo"), leading to a failed objective conversion.
events.gameplay_event: Team wins a fight but splits up; Sima Yi fails to finish the crystal.
events.evidence: Visible sliver of health remaining on the enemy crystal.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize the crystal over farming or chasing when an opening to end exists.

events.coach_claim: Over-eagerness to end the game led to unnecessary risks and a final throw.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao flashes into a 4v5 situation during a base defense/push and dies.
events.evidence: "Defeat" screen; Xiao Qiao's aggressive flash leads to a team wipe.
events.recommended_action: Maintain composure; prioritize safe wave clear to preserve the lead instead of forcing a finish.

events.coach_claim: Lineup analysis is essential for establishing early-game rhythm.
events.gameplay_event: Initial lineup review.
events.evidence: Audio commentary regarding mid/top matchups.
events.recommended_action: Evaluate lane priority based on hero power spikes.

events.coach_claim: Ganking for a pre-level 4 Li Xin against a Da Si Ming is a waste of time.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao ganks top lane.
events.evidence: Visual of failed gank; audio critique of Li Xin's early weakness.
events.recommended_action: Avoid ganking lanes where teammates lack CC or early damage.

events.coach_claim: Prioritize catching side lane waves when the shooter is dead.
events.gameplay_event: Shooter dies; Xiao Qiao clears mid.
events.evidence: Visual of wave entering top tower; audio advice.
events.recommended_action: Rotate to cover high-value waves when teammates are absent.

events.coach_claim: Pull jungle monsters out to avoid the "jungle protection" damage reduction buff.
events.gameplay_event: Invading enemy red buff.
events.evidence: Visual of slow clear; audio explanation of the protection mechanic.
events.recommended_action: Pull monsters out of their spawn zone to clear faster and stay safe.

events.coach_claim: Do not abandon the mid tower after 4 minutes as it becomes highly vulnerable.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao rotates away from mid.
events.evidence: Visual of mid tower under pressure; audio warning.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize mid tower defense over low-probability rotations.

events.coach_claim: Wasting flash on a target that is already certain to die is a critical error.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao flashes to kill Gan Jiang.
events.evidence: Visual of Gan Jiang at near-zero health; audio critique.
events.recommended_action: Save mobility spells for survival or securing contested kills.

events.coach_claim: Poor positioning allows Miyamoto to easily lock you down with his ultimate.
events.gameplay_event: Teamfight near blue buff.
events.evidence: Visual of Miyamoto ulting Xiao Qiao; audio critique of "standing position."
events.recommended_action: Stay at max range and track enemy dive hero cooldowns.

events.coach_claim: Walking directly into the enemy jungler's face as a squishy mage is fatal.
events.gameplay_event: Final teamfight near base.
events.evidence: Visual of Xiao Qiao walking into Da Si Ming; audio "walking into face."
events.recommended_action: Maintain distance; use the edge of abilities to deal damage.

events.coach_claim: Stealing the jungler's red buff prevents them from reaching level 4 on time.
events.gameplay_event: Hainuo attacks the allied red buff after clearing enemy jungle creeps.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach questions what the player is thinking. Visual: Hainuo hits the buff while the jungler is nearby.
events.recommended_action: Leave primary buffs for the jungler to ensure they hit their level 4 power spike.

events.coach_claim: Failed to switch to melee form with the second skill, leading to unnecessary damage.
events.gameplay_event: Hainuo attempts an engage near the mid tower but stays in ranged form.
events.evidence: Visual: Hainuo uses Skill 2 but doesn't hit an enemy to trigger the form switch, taking hits for free.
events.recommended_action: Ensure Skill 2 connects with an enemy hero to gain the defensive melee form when diving.

events.coach_claim: Engaging alone when the entire team is retreating leads to a "free" death.
events.gameplay_event: Hainuo dives into a 4-minute teamfight while teammates (Monkey, Garo) ping retreat.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach notes Monkey is retreating and Arthur is absent. Visual: Hainuo dies after being CC'd alone.
events.recommended_action: Respect teammate pings and positioning; do not engage if the frontline is retreating.

events.coach_claim: Showing vision in a side lane forces teammates into a disadvantaged 4v5 fight elsewhere.
events.gameplay_event: Hainuo clears the bottom wave while the enemy team pressures mid.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach explains that showing vision bot causes the 4v5 mid. Visual: Teammates are dove mid while Hainuo is bot.
events.recommended_action: Group with the team when the enemy is grouping; avoid revealing position if it leaves the team vulnerable.

events.coach_claim: Prioritizing minor jungle creeps over tower defense and wasting Ultimates is inefficient.
events.gameplay_event: Hainuo uses Ult on a tower he can't take, then farms a small bird instead of defending top.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach calls him a "big stomach" for eating resources while towers fall. Visual: Top tower is lost while farming.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize lane defense and tower health over low-value jungle camps. Save Ultimate for survival/teamfights.

events.coach_claim: Playing too passively during a teamfight results in teammates dying without support.
events.gameplay_event: Hainuo stays behind the mid tower, clearing minions while a 4v5 fight happens nearby.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach notes he just watches teammates die. Visual: Hainuo throws one Skill 1 then retreats to clear waves.
events.recommended_action: Use Hainuo's sustain and poke to actively disrupt the enemy engage on teammates.

events.coach_claim: Attempting to cut waves without an Ultimate or Teleport available is a high-risk mistake.
events.gameplay_event: Hainuo tries to intercept the mid wave solo and is caught by Pangu.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach notes he has no Ult or Teleport. Visual: Pangu uses Sprint to catch and kill Hainuo quickly.
events.recommended_action: Do not overextend to cut waves if escape tools (Ultimate/Teleport) are on cooldown.

events.coach_claim: Start with boots then swap to a spellbook for a free movement speed boost.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao buys boots, moves toward lane, then sells/swaps for spellbook.
events.evidence: Visible item shop interface and character movement speed increase.
events.recommended_action: Use the "boots start" trick to reach the mid-lane bush faster before swapping to AP items.

events.coach_claim: When a side-laner dies, the mid-laner should prioritize clearing the empty lane's wave over aimless roaming.
events.gameplay_event: Mi Yue dies; Xiao Qiao chases Zhang Fei instead of catching the top wave.
events.evidence: Audio commentary explicitly mentions losing a whole wave of gold/XP.
events.recommended_action: Rotate immediately to cover lanes where teammates have died to prevent gold loss.

events.coach_claim: Avoid revealing your rotation path by sticking close to the walls when moving through the river.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao walks through the center of the river and is spotted by Zhang Fei.
events.evidence: Minimap shows Xiao Qiao's icon overlapping with the enemy support's vision range.
events.recommended_action: Hug the terrain/walls to minimize the radius in which you are visible to enemy wards or heroes.

events.coach_claim: Always track the enemy solo-laner's (Guan Yu) position; if they are missing, expect a flank.
events.gameplay_event: Guan Yu disappears from the map; Xiao Qiao continues to push without caution.
events.evidence: Minimap shows Guan Yu's icon vanishing from the top lane.
events.recommended_action: Ping "Enemy Missing" and play toward the safe side of the lane when the enemy flanker is unaccounted for.

events.coach_claim: Mid-laners should not take side-lane waves that are designated for the split-pusher during the mid-game.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao clears a bottom wave that Mi Yue was rotating toward.
events.evidence: Visible conflict in rotation paths; Mi Yue is left with nothing to farm.
events.recommended_action: Leave side-lane farm for the solo-laner to maintain their level/gold lead while you group for objectives.

events.coach_claim: Do not initiate a disadvantaged fight (3v5) just because an enemy appears to be low health.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao uses Flash + Skill 2 to engage on a target while outnumbered.
events.evidence: Kill feed shows a 3v5 situation; Xiao Qiao and Taiyi die shortly after.
events.recommended_action: Check the minimap for teammate proximity before committing high-cooldown spells like Flash.

events.coach_claim: Mentality and communication are as important as mechanical skill for winning high-rank games.
events.gameplay_event: Post-game screen shows Xiao Qiao had high stats but lost the game.
events.evidence: Audio commentary discusses the "controversial" nature of the player's complaints.
events.recommended_action: Focus on self-correction and positive pings rather than blaming teammates for late-game losses.

events.coach_claim: Avoid touching the front minion line in a 1v2 to prevent being cut off or tower-dived.
events.gameplay_event: Marco Polo stays back while facing two enemies.
events.evidence: Visible: Marco Polo prioritizes safety over aggressive clearing.
events.recommended_action: Continue prioritizing safety when outnumbered in lane.

events.coach_claim: Starting with the red armor (Skill 2) is better for early-game survival as Marco Polo is weak early.
events.gameplay_event: Marco Polo and Zhao Yun lose an early skirmish.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach notes Marco's early weakness. Visible: Marco takes heavy damage.
events.recommended_action: Start with Skill 2 for defensive options in the first few levels.

events.coach_claim: Getting hit by Hou Yi's skill interrupted the health pack regeneration.
events.gameplay_event: Marco Polo moves into Hou Yi's range while healing and gets hit.
events.evidence: Visible: Health bar stops regenerating after being hit by Hou Yi's S2.
events.recommended_action: Stay out of enemy skill range while health pack is active.

events.coach_claim: Xiao Qiao was busy checking the red buff area and could not support immediately.
events.gameplay_event: Player complains about Xiao Qiao; coach shows her position.
events.evidence: Visible: Mini-map shows Xiao Qiao moving towards the red buff area.
events.recommended_action: Improve map awareness to understand teammate actions before blaming.

events.coach_claim: Skill 2 could have been used to dash through the enemy/wall to a better position.
events.gameplay_event: Marco Polo walks through a dangerous area and loses half HP.
events.evidence: Visible: Marco Polo walks instead of using his dash ability.
events.recommended_action: Use Skill 2 more effectively for positioning and damage avoidance.

events.coach_claim: Going to the middle lane to take farm from the mage is unnecessary and harmful.
events.gameplay_event: Marco Polo clears the mid-lane wave.
events.evidence: Visible: Marco Polo clearing mid while Xiao Qiao is present.
events.recommended_action: Stick to the assigned lane unless rotating for a specific objective.

events.coach_claim: Using the ultimate directly into Hou Yi's face was a major mistake.
events.gameplay_event: Marco Polo ults Hou Yi, gets stunned, and dies.
events.evidence: Visible: Ult animation followed immediately by Marco Polo's death.
events.recommended_action: Use ultimate only when enemy CC is down or from a safe angle.

events.coach_claim: Trying to 1v1 a higher-level Charlotte was a bad idea; use irregular movement to dodge global ults.
events.gameplay_event: Marco Polo fights Charlotte, retreats, then dies to Nuwa's global ult.
events.evidence: Visible: Level difference (8 vs 9); Nuwa's ult beam hits Marco.
events.recommended_action: Avoid fighting when under-leveled; use zig-zag movement to dodge global ults.

events.coach_claim: Using Skill 1 while in a bush revealed the player's position to the enemy.
events.gameplay_event: Marco Polo fires S1 from a bush; Hou Yi ults the bush.
events.evidence: Visible: S1 projectiles reveal position; Hou Yi's ult hits the bush.
events.recommended_action: Do not use skills that reveal position when attempting to hide.

events.coach_claim: The player continues to blame the support despite their own poor performance and inconsistent mentality.
events.gameplay_event: Final teamfight and loss; player complains about Zhao Yun.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach critiques the player's habit of "throwing the pot" (blaming others).
events.recommended_action: Focus on self-improvement and maintain a consistent, positive mentality.

events.coach_claim: Securing neutral resources like the red armor provides more value than low-impact poke.
events.gameplay_event: Angela uses Skill 1 to poke the enemy instead of finishing the red armor.
events.evidence: Coach: "There's no gain at all."
events.recommended_action: Prioritize securing gold/XP from neutral monsters over non-lethal poke.

events.coach_claim: Angela is vulnerable in the right mid-bush because the enemy jungler started red.
events.gameplay_event: Angela squats in the bush and is easily caught by Liu Bei.
events.evidence: Coach: "Opposite jungler is red-starting... you can't stand there."
events.recommended_action: Track the enemy jungler's starting buff to avoid dangerous bushes on their strong side.

events.coach_claim: If a burst attempt fails, cancel the ultimate immediately to escape.
events.gameplay_event: Angela remains stationary in her ultimate against Mozi, failing to kill and getting caught.
events.evidence: Coach: "Cancel the big move and run away... why drive it like a block of wood?"
events.recommended_action: Use the ultimate for burst; if the target survives, prioritize repositioning.

events.coach_claim: Avoid blindly rotating to a disadvantageous fight (2v3) when the team is winning elsewhere.
events.gameplay_event: Angela rotates top into a 3-man enemy group and dies despite her team winning bot.
events.evidence: Coach: "Blindly support... 2 on 3 in the top half."
events.recommended_action: Monitor map numbers; don't rotate into a numerical disadvantage if other lanes are winning.

events.coach_claim: Stay with the team's main rotation instead of attempting solo plays in the side lanes.
events.gameplay_event: Angela goes to the bottom lane alone to squat Mozi and is killed by Liu Bei.
events.evidence: Coach: "Follow your teammates to the top half... why come down alone?"
events.recommended_action: Group with the team during mid-game to avoid being picked off by the enemy jungler.

events.coach_claim: Chasing kills while at low health often leads to being counter-killed.
events.gameplay_event: Angela attempts to chase Liu Bei while at critical health and is killed.
events.evidence: Coach: "You can go up and check the fun... killed by Liu Bei."
