events.recommended_action: Prioritize survival and backing to heal over risky kills when low on HP.

events.coach_claim: Itemize defensively against heavy control/burst compositions.
events.gameplay_event: Angela buys Bloodthirsty Tome (lifesteal) instead of a defensive item.
events.evidence: Coach: "Opposite has Mozi and Xi Shi... why choose a vampire book?"
events.recommended_action: Purchase Ardent Dominator (Blazing Stargate) for the shield to survive CC chains.

events.coach_claim: Wave management is critical to preventing high-ground tower losses.
events.gameplay_event: Angela fails to clear the mid-wave before the enemy pushes the high ground.
events.evidence: Coach: "Cut the center line... you come back, it's useless."
events.recommended_action: Prioritize clearing minion waves to stall enemy sieges and protect the base.

events.coach_claim: Health management is crucial for early rotations against strong laners like Wang Zhaojun.
events.gameplay_event: Early laning phase vs. Wang Zhaojun.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach warns about Wang Zhaojun's level 1 strength.
events.recommended_action: Avoid unnecessary trades to preserve HP for side-lane support.

events.coach_claim: Greed for a small jungle creep while ignoring lane priority and enemy rotations leads to death.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao rotates bot, tries to steal a creep, and gets collapsed on.
events.evidence: Visual: Enemy Wang Zhaojun and Lu Bu rotate while Xiao Qiao stays in the river.
events.recommended_action: Check map for enemy rotations before committing to deep jungle creeps.

events.coach_claim: Prioritize helping the jungler defend the blue zone when the jungler starts red.
events.gameplay_event: Jungler is invaded at blue; Xiao Qiao clears mid instead of helping.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach notes the "brand-name" information of the jungler's red start.
events.recommended_action: Rotate to the blue buff immediately after clearing the first wave to prevent theft.

events.coach_claim: Use skills to check bushes (utilizing passive movement speed) to avoid being ambushed.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao walks near red-side bushes without using her 1st skill to check.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach explains Xiao Qiao's passive grants speed on hit; Visual: She walks blindly.
events.recommended_action: Throw a fan (Skill 1) into every bush before approaching to trigger the passive.

events.coach_claim: Do not waste Flash when skill range is already sufficient to secure a kill.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao uses Flash + Skill 1 on a low-HP Wang Zhaojun.
events.evidence: Visual: The Skill 1 range indicator clearly reached the target before the Flash.
events.recommended_action: Save Flash for defensive maneuvers or harder-to-reach targets.

events.coach_claim: Roles are reversed; the mage should clear while the marksman/support scout, not vice versa.
events.gameplay_event: Marksman is scouting river while Xiao Qiao and Support clear the wave.
events.evidence: Visual: Yu Ji (ADC) is in the river while Xiao Qiao stays under tower.
events.recommended_action: Mage should use skills to safely scout or follow the tank's lead.

events.coach_claim: A failed mechanical combo (Flash-Skill 1 miss) can turn a winning skirmish into a team wipe.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao misses a Flash-Skill 1 combo, leading to a counter-collapse.
events.evidence: Visual: Flash is used but the fan misses the target entirely.
events.recommended_action: Practice the timing of Flash-combos to ensure hit confirmation.

events.coach_claim: Defending 1v5 is suicide; wait for teammates to respawn to have a chance at a successful defense.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao attempts to defend the high ground alone and dies instantly.
events.evidence: Visual: Xiao Qiao engages 4-5 enemies while 3 teammates are still dead.
events.recommended_action: Retreat to the fountain and wait for the team to respawn before engaging.

events.coach_claim: Clear waves under tower instead of trading HP.
events.gameplay_event: Player steps out to trade with Mai Shiranui and Zhang Liang, losing half HP.
events.evidence: Player at 50% HP; minions at tower.
events.recommended_action: Stay under tower to safely clear minions when outnumbered.

events.coach_claim: Ping missing enemies to protect teammates.
events.gameplay_event: Mai Shiranui roams bot; player stays mid without signaling.
events.evidence: Enemy mid icon disappears from minimap; no pings sent.
events.recommended_action: Use the "Enemy Missing" signal immediately when the laner roams.

events.coach_claim: Prioritize the next wave over late roams.
events.gameplay_event: Player tries to follow a roam without priority, arriving late.
events.evidence: Player walking through river while a new wave arrives mid.
events.recommended_action: Stay mid to secure the next wave and gain a gold/XP lead.

events.coach_claim: Avoid standing in the river without vision.
events.gameplay_event: Player stands in river brush and gets caught by enemy mid/support.
events.evidence: Player is caught in the river and killed.
events.recommended_action: Stay near tower or use safe paths when enemies are missing.

events.coach_claim: Use safe pathing through the jungle.
events.gameplay_event: Player walks through the river to return to mid lane.
events.evidence: Player is caught by Kai in the river.
events.recommended_action: Path through your own jungle when returning to lane.

events.coach_claim: Don't overextend to save doomed teammates.
events.gameplay_event: Player dives into multiple enemies to "save" a teammate and dies.
events.evidence: Player dies while teammate was already effectively dead.
events.recommended_action: Assess the situation; don't turn one death into two.

events.coach_claim: Maintain max range as a long-range mage.
events.gameplay_event: Player walks into Kai's melee range to cast skills.
events.evidence: Player is hit by Kai's melee attacks.
events.recommended_action: Use the edge of skill indicators to poke from safety.

events.coach_claim: Do not face-check bushes while visible.
events.gameplay_event: Player walks into a bush while the enemy knows their location.
events.evidence: Player is immediately killed by Kai in the bush.
events.recommended_action: Use skills to scout bushes or avoid them entirely.

events.coach_claim: Stop blaming teammates when underperforming.
events.gameplay_event: Player pings Marco Polo's ultimate while having a 1-9 score.
events.evidence: Scoreboard shows player at 1-9-2; pings teammate.
events.recommended_action: Focus on personal survival and positioning instead of chat.

events.coach_claim: Low economy renders the hero ineffective.
events.gameplay_event: Player's gold is lower than the enemy support's gold.
events.evidence: Scoreboard: Player (4912g) vs. Enemy Support (5796g).
events.recommended_action: Prioritize safe farming; avoid deaths to stay gold-relevant.

events.coach_claim: "Flash missed, killed by tower... a bit out of place."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao attempts a flash-kill on Daji under tower, misses skill, and dies to tower shots.
events.evidence: Visual: Flash into tower range, missed skill, death. Audio: Coach critiquing the failed dive.
events.recommended_action: Avoid high-risk dives without guaranteed skill hits or enough health to tank tower.

events.coach_claim: "This wave of waste caused you to miss two lines of arms."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao misses two minion waves due to the unnecessary death under tower.
events.evidence: Visual: Minions dying to tower while player is dead. Audio: Coach mentioning missed gold/XP.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize wave management and staying alive to ensure consistent income.

events.coach_claim: "Don't stand with the military line... make the enemy choose."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao stands inside her own minion wave, allowing Daji's skills to hit both her and the minions.
events.evidence: Visual: Xiao Qiao standing in the wave, getting hit by Daji's S1. Audio: Coach explaining positioning.
events.recommended_action: Position away from the minion wave to force the opponent to choose between poke or farm.

events.coach_claim: "Early stage missed two soldiers... no level 4."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao roams top but lacks her Ultimate (Level 4) to secure a kill on Liu Bei.
events.evidence: Visual: Level 3 Xiao Qiao roaming, failing to kill low-HP Liu Bei. Audio: Coach linking missed minions to level disadvantage.
events.recommended_action: Ensure level milestones (like Level 4) are met before committing to roams.

events.coach_claim: "How can you kill someone without a big move? Handled by Lian Po."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao attempts to kill a tanky Lian Po under tower without her Ultimate and dies.
events.evidence: Visual: Death to Lian Po under tower. Audio: Coach questioning the lack of Ultimate for the dive.
events.recommended_action: Do not attempt to dive tanky targets without full skill rotation availability.

events.coach_claim: "Not a game against the road... completely incapable of independent thinking?"
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao repeatedly roams to the top lane against two tanks (Xiang Yu/Lian Po) instead of the squishier bot lane.
events.evidence: Visual: Repeated roams to top lane. Audio: Coach suggesting roaming to the ADC lane instead.
events.recommended_action: Analyze enemy team composition and roam toward lanes with higher kill potential (squishy targets).

events.coach_claim: "Ability to calculate damage is like a full-grown brick."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao attempts another kill on Lian Po, fails to secure it, and dies again.
events.evidence: Visual: Score becomes 0-5 after another failed kill attempt. Audio: Coach mocking the damage calculation.
events.recommended_action: Improve damage foresight; don't commit to a fight you cannot win based on current items/levels.

events.coach_claim: "Help fight the wild... then open the tyrant... why are you running down again?"
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao roams top again to chase Lian Po instead of securing objectives like the Tyrant or helping the jungler.
events.evidence: Visual: Roaming top while Tyrant is available. Audio: Coach suggesting objective focus.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize neutral objectives (Tyrant/Overlord) over low-probability kills on tanks.

events.coach_claim: "Even more outrageous... last wave you had a big move."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao roams top *without* her Ultimate to catch Lian Po again.
events.evidence: Visual: Roaming without Ult, failing to secure kill. Audio: Coach comparing this roam to previous failed ones.
events.recommended_action: Wait for Ultimate cooldown before initiating roams or ganks.

events.coach_claim: "Caught by Daji... record comes to a luxurious 0-5."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao is caught out in the river by Daji and killed instantly.
events.evidence: Visual: Death in the river. Audio: Coach announcing the 0-5 score.
events.recommended_action: Use bushes and avoid face-checking the river when enemy burst mages are missing.

events.coach_claim: "Chasing Lian Po again... record comes to 0-6."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao uses Ultimate to chase Lian Po, gets counter-attacked and dies.
events.evidence: Visual: Chasing Lian Po, death. Audio: Coach noting the repetitive mistake.
events.recommended_action: Stop fixating on a single target, especially one that is difficult to kill (tanks).

events.coach_claim: "1-7 Xiao Qiao played with 7-1 momentum."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao plays overly aggressive (arrogant) near the enemy fountain despite a poor personal score, relying on teammates.
events.evidence: Visual: Xiao Qiao standing near enemy fountain. Audio: Coach commenting on the "arrogant" playstyle.
events.recommended_action: Maintain a disciplined playstyle regardless of the team's overall lead to avoid giving away shutdowns.

events.coach_claim: The player is stuck at 1,400 points despite submitting "random kill" highlights.
events.gameplay_event: Player showcases stats (44% win rate) and a 1v1 kill on the enemy jungler.
events.evidence: Audio: "Peak game is stuck at 1,400 points... all four materials are random kill."
events.recommended_action: Focus on identifying consistent mistakes rather than just reviewing highlights.

events.coach_claim: Muting teammates blindly is a "drama test" that can hinder coordination at this rank.
events.gameplay_event: Player mutes all teammates immediately upon entering the match.
events.evidence: Visual: Scoreboard shows the player clicking the mute icon for all allies.
events.recommended_action: Keep communication open to facilitate better team rotations and objective calls.

events.coach_claim: The player treats the game like a "turn-based strategy," failing to pressure when ahead.
events.gameplay_event: Player secures a kill but then stands idle or clears minions slowly instead of pushing.
events.evidence: Audio: "Turn-based strategy game... wait for the enemy to come up."
events.recommended_action: Use kill windows to aggressively pressure towers or invade the enemy jungle.

events.coach_claim: The player misses rotation windows by failing to clear waves efficiently.
events.gameplay_event: Player stays in lane while minions die to the tower, ignoring a nearby Red Buff.
events.evidence: Visual: Minions are lost to the tower while the player is stationary; Red Buff is up.
events.recommended_action: Instantly clear waves to create "dead time" for farming jungle or rotating to mid.

events.coach_claim: The player ignores crucial team objectives like the Tyrant.
events.gameplay_event: Teammates contest the 4-minute Tyrant while the player stays in lane for minor farm.
events.evidence: Minimap: Allies are clustered at the Tyrant pit; Player is isolated in the bot lane.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize joining team objectives over marginal lane gold when the team is contesting.

events.coach_claim: The player suffers from "ultimate hoarding," rarely using their most powerful skill.
events.gameplay_event: Several skirmishes occur where the player's ultimate remains available but unused.
events.evidence: Visual: The ultimate skill icon is highlighted (available) throughout multiple fights.
events.recommended_action: Use the ultimate proactively to secure kills or force enemies out of position.

events.coach_claim: Passive positioning leads to a base collapse despite the player having a high KDA.
events.gameplay_event: Enemy pushes high ground; player retreats prematurely instead of defending.
events.evidence: Visual: The base is lost while the player is alive and positioned far behind the core.
events.recommended_action: Commit to high-ground defense or execute a decisive counter-engage to protect the base.

events.coach_claim: "Peak scores don't lie"; the player's static habits are the primary barrier to climbing.
events.gameplay_event: The match ends in defeat; coach provides a final summary of the player's flaws.
events.evidence: Audio: "Peak scores don't lie... fix one thing a day."
events.recommended_action: Systematically address passive laning and poor objective priority to break the 1,400-point ceiling.

events.coach_claim: Flash early to avoid displacement and preserve HP/lane presence.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi is caught by Guiguzi's S2; flashes late after taking heavy damage.
events.evidence: Guiguzi pulls Xishi; Xishi flashes post-damage; misses 2 minions while retreating.
events.recommended_action: Use Flash immediately upon being caught by CC to maintain HP for lane priority.

events.coach_claim: Midlaners must assist in tracking stealth junglers like Lanling Wang.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi stays in lane without checking the red zone while the enemy jungler is missing.
events.evidence: Lanling Wang is invisible; Xishi lacks lane priority to scout the jungle.
events.recommended_action: Rotate to provide vision/security for your jungler when facing stealth threats.

events.coach_claim: Prioritize last-hitting and avoid risky river pathing without Flash.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi misses 3 minions in two waves and wanders into the river without escape tools.
events.evidence: Minions die to tower; Xishi enters river bush without vision or Flash available.
events.recommended_action: Focus on wave efficiency; stay near tower safety when Flash is on cooldown.

events.coach_claim: Roaming is ineffective if skill shots are missed or timing is poor.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi roams bot and mid-jungle, missing multiple S1 pulls on low-HP targets.
events.evidence: Xiang Yu escapes with sliver of HP; Xishi's S1 misses twice during roams.
events.recommended_action: Practice skill shot leading; wait for CC setup from teammates before using S1.

events.coach_claim: Improper rotation pathing leads to avoidable deaths.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi is intercepted and killed by Lanling Wang and Ying Zheng in the jungle.
events.evidence: Xishi takes a direct path through the jungle; Lanling Wang ambushes her.
events.recommended_action: Use safer rotation paths (through base or behind towers) when enemies are off-map.

events.coach_claim: Against mobile heroes, use slows before attempting pulls.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi misses S1 on Marco Polo because he has his dash available.
events.evidence: Marco Polo dashes away; Xishi's S1 misses.
events.recommended_action: Use S2 first to force a dash or slow the target before committing the S1 pull.

events.coach_claim: Pulling enemies without nearby teammate follow-up is a waste of resources.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi successfully pulls Xiang Yu twice, but no teammates are close enough to kill him.
events.evidence: Xiang Yu is pulled; Xishi lacks damage to solo kill; teammates are out of range.
events.recommended_action: Coordinate pulls with teammate positioning to ensure successful pick-offs.

events.coach_claim: Building defensive actives (Golden Body) is crucial when behind.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi uses Golden Body to survive a dive, allowing teammates to counter-attack.
events.evidence: Xishi activates Golden Body; survives focus fire; team wins a 0-for-3 trade.
events.recommended_action: Continue building situational defensive items to mitigate frequent targeting.

events.coach_claim: Late-game face-checking leads to team-wiping CC.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi is caught by a Guiguzi flash-pull in the river, leading to her death.
events.evidence: Guiguzi flashes and pulls 4 players; Xishi is deleted instantly.
events.recommended_action: Maintain better spacing and use skills to check bushes during the late game.

events.coach_claim: Team collapse and AFKs make the game unrecoverable.
events.gameplay_event: Teammates begin to AFK and the surrender vote passes after a final lost fight.
events.evidence: Surrender UI appears; "Defeat" screen shown; coach notes two AFKs.
events.recommended_action: Focus on your own play, but recognize when team morale has completely shattered.

events.coach_claim: Unnecessary use of Skill 1 for poking instead of wave clear.
events.gameplay_event: Laning phase against Zhou Yu.
events.evidence: Audio: "No need to use skill to hit state." Visible: Nuwa hits Zhou Yu while minions are ignored.
events.recommended_action: Use Skill 1 to push the wave back to the tower to secure farm.

events.coach_claim: Failure to body-block minions for perfect last hits.
events.gameplay_event: Nuwa clearing under tower.
events.evidence: Audio: Body-block rear platoon. Visible: Nuwa misses last hits while auto-attacking.
events.recommended_action: Position the character to stall the rear minions, timing Skill 1 for 4 last hits.

events.coach_claim: Nuwa's early game must prioritize development and numbers advantage.
events.gameplay_event: General early game flow.
events.evidence: Audio: "Nuwa's early stage must be based on development."
events.recommended_action: Focus on farming; use Skill 3 only to create a numbers advantage in skirmishes.

events.coach_claim: Over-aggressive positioning at Level 2 leads to near-death by minions.
events.gameplay_event: Skirmish near mid-river.
events.evidence: Visible: Nuwa health drops to critical levels from minion aggro and Zhou Yu poke.
events.recommended_action: Stay back; do not attempt to "lane bully" early when clear speed is inferior.

events.coach_claim: Dangerous river pathing with low HP without vision.
events.gameplay_event: Nuwa walking through river to side lane.
events.evidence: Audio: "Sleepwalking?" Visible: Nuwa crosses river with <20% HP; enemy jungler missing.
events.recommended_action: Return to base or take the safe path through the jungle when low on health.

events.coach_claim: Poor Skill 3 teleport into enemy CC and wasted Flash.
events.gameplay_event: Teleporting to "support" a safe marksman.
events.evidence: Visible: Nuwa teleports directly into Hou Yi and Xia Hou Dun's ultimates.
events.recommended_action: Assess enemy CC before teleporting; do not waste Flash when death is certain.

events.coach_claim: Inefficient farming pathing after mid-lane is cleared by teammates.
events.gameplay_event: Ma Chao clears mid; Nuwa wanders to enemy blue.
events.evidence: Audio: "Waste of time." Visible: Nuwa enters enemy jungle with no objective.
events.recommended_action: Farm friendly jungle or the confrontation lane (Spirit of Road) to maintain gold.

events.coach_claim: Ignoring wave pressure to join a distant, unnecessary skirmish.
events.gameplay_event: Nuwa leaves mid-wave to throw a single skill near the purple buff.
events.evidence: Audio: "Clear the line... completely unnecessary."
events.recommended_action: Prioritize clearing the mid-wave into the tower to pressure the map.

events.coach_claim: Greed for a cannon minion leads to death by environmental damage.
events.gameplay_event: Nuwa stands in Zhou Yu's fire to last-hit a minion.
events.evidence: Audio: "Look at your cravings." Visible: Nuwa dies to fire while trying to hit the gun car.
events.recommended_action: Abandon low-value farm if it requires standing in lethal AOE damage.

events.coach_claim: Game-losing teleport into the center of the enemy team.
events.gameplay_event: Late-game teamfight defense.
events.evidence: Visible: Nuwa teleports into 4 enemies, misses Skill 1, and is instantly deleted.
events.recommended_action: Maintain distance; use Nuwa's long-range poke rather than jumping into melee range.

events.coach_claim: Missing Skill 2 on Jiang Ziya due to slow reaction/bad prediction.
events.gameplay_event: Angela misses her stun (Skill 2) on an enemy Jiang Ziya in lane.
events.evidence: Visual: Skill 2 projectile misses target. Audio: Coach mentions "reaction is a bit slow."
events.recommended_action: Practice leading targets or wait for teammates' CC before using Skill 2.

events.coach_claim: Stealing enemy jungle "pigs" is a valid resource-denial strategy.
events.gameplay_event: Angela clears the enemy's small jungle camp (pigs) quickly.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela uses skills to clear the enemy camp. Audio: Coach says "this idea is okay."
events.recommended_action: Continue to pressure enemy resources when lane is pushed and it's safe.

events.coach_claim: Don't recall early if health packs are available under the tower.
events.gameplay_event: Angela stays in lane at mid-HP, utilizing the tower's healing pack.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela picks up the green health pack. Audio: Coach advises against "shooting back" (recalling).
events.recommended_action: Prioritize lane presence and XP over unnecessary recalls by using map resources.

events.coach_claim: Good initial peel, but followed by a reckless chase without skills.
events.gameplay_event: Angela peels Wukong with Skill 2 but then walks into Jiang Ziya's damage.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela uses Skill 2 to escape Wukong, then turns back and takes heavy damage.
events.recommended_action: After successful self-peel, retreat to safety if major cooldowns or Flash are unavailable.

events.coach_claim: Face-checking bushes without lane priority is dangerous.
events.gameplay_event: Angela walks into the river bush without vision while the enemy has lane control.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela enters unlit bush. Audio: Coach discusses "line rights" (priority).
events.recommended_action: Use Skill 1 or 2 to scout bushes from a distance when lane priority is lost.

events.coach_claim: Standing still during Ult makes you an easy target for divers.
events.gameplay_event: Angela misses Skill 2 and then stands stationary while using her Ultimate.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela is stationary in Ult; Wukong jumps on her. Audio: Coach compares her to "wood."
events.recommended_action: Reposition the shield or cancel the Ultimate early if a diver like Wukong approaches.

events.coach_claim: Ultimate positioning was nonsensical/ineffective.
events.gameplay_event: Angela uses her Ultimate in a direction where no enemies are standing.
events.evidence: Visual: Ult beam is fired into empty space/tower. Audio: Coach mocks the "30-year" operation.
events.recommended_action: Improve aim and situational awareness before committing to the long Ultimate animation.

events.coach_claim: Angela lacks burst potential if Skill 2 is not landed.
events.gameplay_event: Angela fails to secure a kill because Skill 2 missed.
events.evidence: Visual: Skill 2 misses; enemy survives the rest of the combo. Audio: Coach mentions "Skill 2 missed."
events.recommended_action: Focus on landing the stun first to ensure the full damage of Skill 1 and Ult connects.

events.coach_claim: Maintaining confidence despite a poor score (2-5) is a positive trait.
events.gameplay_event: Player continues to attempt aggressive plays despite being behind.
events.evidence: Visual: Scoreboard shows 2-5. Audio: Coach notes the player "dares to operate with confidence."
events.recommended_action: Balance confidence with caution; avoid "ego-challenging" when significantly behind in gold.

events.coach_claim: Poor gold efficiency; core items not finished by 10 minutes.
events.gameplay_event: The shop screen shows Angela has not completed major power-spike items.
events.evidence: Visual: Shop UI shows unfinished items at 10:25. Audio: Coach mentions "even the uncle hasn't made half."
events.recommended_action: Focus on consistent farming and lane rotations to reach item power spikes faster.

events.coach_claim: Failure to secure own Blue Buff against enemy poke.
events.gameplay_event: Jiang Ziya steals Angela's Blue Buff with a long-range skill.
events.evidence: Visual: Blue buff dies to Jiang Ziya's skill. Audio: Coach says "stolen by Jiang Ziya."
events.recommended_action: Use the burst of Skill 1/Ult to "last hit" buffs to prevent enemy steals.

events.coach_claim: Overstaying with residual health leads to unnecessary deaths.
events.gameplay_event: A low-HP Angela tries to clear a wave and is picked off by Wukong.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela dies to Wukong's jump. Audio: Coach mentions "residual blood turned back to grab the line."
events.recommended_action: Respect the enemy's gap-closers; recall immediately when HP is below the execution threshold.

events.coach_claim: Placing the mini-map in the center of the screen forces vision awareness.
events.gameplay_event: UI Customization
events.evidence: Map overlay shown in the center of the player's screen.
events.recommended_action: Use UI settings to place critical info in your primary field of view if you struggle with map awareness.

events.coach_claim: Early jungle resource sharing accelerates reaching Level 4.
events.gameplay_event: Clearing Red Bamboo/Armor
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao assists teammates in taking side jungle creeps.
events.recommended_action: Coordinate with the jungler to share early neutral resources to hit power spikes (Level 4) faster.

events.coach_claim: Holding the mid-lane bush provides vision and safety.
events.gameplay_event: Bush Camping
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao stands still in the left mid bush.
events.recommended_action: Occupy mid-lane bushes to track enemy rotations and provide a safety buffer for side-lane teammates.

events.coach_claim: Roaming is most effective when the enemy jungler is occupied elsewhere.
events.gameplay_event: Gank on Marco Polo
events.evidence: Enemy Lan is seen clearing blue while Xiao Qiao ganks top.
events.recommended_action: Time roams based on the enemy jungler's visible location or predicted pathing.

events.coach_claim: Use the "Voice-to-Text" input as a persistent on-screen reminder for cooldowns.
events.gameplay_event: Typing "Yang Yuhuan no flash"
events.evidence: The text box is left open on the screen without being sent.
events.recommended_action: Keep track of enemy summoner spells by typing them in the chat box but not sending it, using it as a sticky note.

events.coach_claim: Discipline in resetting after a low-HP wave clear prevents unnecessary deaths.
events.gameplay_event: Recalling with low HP
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao clears a wave and immediately returns to base.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize survival and health status over greedy farming when enemy positions are unknown.

events.coach_claim: Predicting enemy rotation paths allows for successful ambushes.
events.gameplay_event: Bush camp for Marco Polo
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao waits in a bush on the path to the bot lane.
events.recommended_action: Analyze enemy movement patterns to set up traps in high-traffic rotation corridors.

events.coach_claim: High-value defensive Flashing is better than saving it for a death.
events.gameplay_event: Flash escape from Lan
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao Flashes immediately when Lan appears.
events.recommended_action: Do not hesitate to use Flash defensively to maintain a kill streak or economic lead.

events.coach_claim: Update psychological reminders as the game state changes.
events.gameplay_event: Updating text to "Lan no vision"
events.evidence: Player changes the unsent chat text to reflect new dangers.
events.recommended_action: Continuously update your "mental notes" (or UI notes) to stay focused on the current biggest threat.

events.coach_claim: Use Teleport/Rotations to avoid un-warded areas when enemies are missing.
events.gameplay_event: Teleporting to top lane
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao uses a teleport portal instead of walking through the river.
events.recommended_action: Avoid "face-checking" bushes during rotations by using safe travel methods like portals or wider pathing.

events.coach_claim: Aggressive Flash-initiations can end games when an economic lead is established.
events.gameplay_event: Flash-S2 on two enemies
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao initiates the final fight with a Flash combo.
events.recommended_action: When ahead, look for decisive initiation opportunities on key carries to force a game-ending push.

events.coach_claim: Trading kills is a net loss if you miss multiple minion waves.
events.gameplay_event: Yixing aggressively flashes for a kill on Zhuge Liang but dies to minion damage, resulting in a 1-for-1 trade.
events.evidence: Audio: "You have two lines of soldiers that you didn't eat." Visual: Minions dying to the tower while Yixing is dead.
events.recommended_action: Avoid high-risk trades that result in death when large waves are approaching your tower.

events.coach_claim: Walking into Zhuge Liang's burst range without skills or Flash is a fatal mistake.
events.gameplay_event: Yixing respawns, uses all skills on the wave, and walks directly into Zhuge Liang's melee range.
events.evidence: Audio: "So easily given to the opposite Zhuge Liang... Your chance?" Visual: Zhuge Liang bursts Yixing down instantly.
events.recommended_action: Respect the opponent's kill pressure; maintain distance when your defensive tools are on cooldown.

events.coach_claim: Walking blindly into high-probability ambush bushes indicates poor map awareness.
events.gameplay_event: Yixing walks straight into the river bush where Zhuge Liang is waiting to ambush him.
events.evidence: Audio: "Completely unconscious... Zhuge Liang is squatting for you here." Visual: Yixing enters the bush without scouting.
events.recommended_action: Use the hero's skills (like Yixing's stones) to scout bushes before entering them.

events.coach_claim: Choosing a vulnerable recall position leads to unnecessary "feeding."
events.gameplay_event: Yixing attempts to recall in a river bush while low on health, despite enemies being nearby.
events.evidence: Audio: "Choose the middle way... you won't be back." Visual: Xiang Yu pushes Yixing out of his recall and kills him.
events.recommended_action: Retreat further back into the jungle or under a secondary tower to recall safely when low.

events.coach_claim: Attempting to defend a low-health tower alone against multiple enemies while at low HP is a macro error.
events.gameplay_event: Yixing stays to defend the bottom lane outer tower with very low health against three full-health enemies.
events.evidence: Audio: "The state of such a little blood... how did you rush to guard this wave?" Visual: Enemies dive and kill Yixing under tower.
events.recommended_action: Abandon the tower when it is no longer defensable to avoid giving the enemy an extra kill.

events.coach_claim: Wasting a high-impact ultimate on a small minion wave reduces teamfight effectiveness.
events.gameplay_event: Yixing uses his "Decomposition" ultimate to clear a standard wave of three minions.
events.evidence: Audio: "Big move box to three minions... The soldier walked into your big move." Visual: Ultimate goes on cooldown for minimal gain.
events.recommended_action: Save high-cooldown, high-impact CC ultimates for teamfights or to stop enemy dives.

events.coach_claim: High risk, low reward to invade the enemy blue buff.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao invades enemy jungle and dies.
events.evidence: Visual of death in enemy jungle; Audio: "High risk, low reward choice."
events.recommended_action: Prioritize neutral river creeps and own jungle farm.

events.coach_claim: Missing a front-row minion loses significant gold.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao misses a minion last-hit after respawn.
events.evidence: Visual of minion dying to friendly fire; Audio: "Resurrected and missed a front row soldier."
events.recommended_action: Focus on last-hitting to maintain economic parity.

events.coach_claim: No need to rotate to side lanes without ultimate or flash.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao rotates while mid-lane wave is incoming.
events.evidence: Visual of rotation without key cooldowns; Audio: "No big move, no flash... no need to go to the side."
events.recommended_action: Stay in mid-lane to clear waves and protect the tower.

events.coach_claim: Trading 1-for-1 is a loss when holding a blue buff.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao dives Doria, trading kills 1-for-1.
events.evidence: Visual of dive and death; Audio: "It's still a loss... you have blue buff on you."
events.recommended_action: Prioritize survival to utilize the buff for faster farming.

events.coach_claim: Never chase a mobile enemy with only basic attacks.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao chases Xuance with skills on cooldown and dies.
events.evidence: Visual of basic attack chasing; Audio: "No more skills... how dare you chase."
events.recommended_action: Retreat and wait for cooldowns before re-engaging.

events.coach_claim: Neglecting the mid-lane wave leads to tower loss.
events.gameplay_event: Mid-lane tower is destroyed by enemy minions.
events.evidence: Visual of tower falling to creeps; Audio: "Middle Road Army Line entered the tower."
events.recommended_action: Ensure mid-lane waves are cleared before rotating.

events.coach_claim: Standing alone in the river without vision is suicidal.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao is caught alone in the river by four enemies.
events.evidence: Visual of isolation in river; Audio: "Foolishly occupying the river... teammates are thousands of miles away."
events.recommended_action: Maintain proximity to teammates or stay in safe zones.

events.coach_claim: Returning to a lost fight out of "righteousness" is a mistake.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao runs back into danger to help Marco and dies.
events.evidence: Visual of Xiao Qiao turning back into enemies; Audio: "Already run to a safe position... rushed to support."
events.recommended_action: Abandon lost teammates to preserve your own life and defense.

events.coach_claim: Overextending to clear a wave without flash is fatal.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao runs into five enemies to clear mid and dies.
events.evidence: Visual of death during wave clear; Audio: "No flash... just run out to clear line."
events.recommended_action: Clear waves from a safe distance or wait for team backup.

events.coach_claim: Misjudging burst potential against mages like Wan'er.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao uses ultimate aggressively on Wan'er and is bursted down.
events.evidence: Visual of death to Wan'er's burst; Audio: "Open another big one... not suitable for playing small town."
events.recommended_action: Respect enemy burst windows and avoid face-tanking damage.

events.coach_claim: Standing too "arrogant" and failing to analyze hero strength at level 1.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao takes massive poke damage immediately.
events.evidence: Mai Shiranui and Shao Siyuan burst Xiao Qiao to 10% HP near the river bush.
events.recommended_action: Respect the enemy duo's level 1 burst; stay closer to the turret.

events.coach_claim: Ignoring the jungler's desperate pings for assistance.
events.gameplay_event: Han Xin pings "Gather" while being invaded at the blue buff.
events.evidence: Han Xin pings repeatedly; Xiao Qiao continues clearing minions in the mid lane.
events.recommended_action: Rotate immediately to support the jungler when lane priority is established.

events.coach_claim: Chasing blindly without Flash or skills available.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao face-checks the river bush while low on resources.
events.evidence: Mai Shiranui ambushes Xiao Qiao from the bush after Xiao Qiao uses S2 on another target.
events.recommended_action: Use S1 to scout bushes or take the safer path through the jungle when vulnerable.

events.coach_claim: Refusing to recall at critical health leads to "free" kills for the enemy.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao stays in lane with sliver HP to clear minions.
events.evidence: Di Renjie uses Flash and ultimate to easily execute Xiao Qiao under her turret.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize survival over a single wave when HP is within the enemy's execute range.

events.coach_claim: Poor map awareness leads to running directly into the enemy jungler.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao rotates bot and walks into Liu Bei's face.
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao walks through the river without vision; Liu Bei bursts her down instantly.
events.recommended_action: Check the mini-map for the enemy jungler's last known position before rotating.

events.coach_claim: Attempting a solo flank against full-HP carries is a "free gift."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao tries to flank Liu Bei and Di Renjie alone during a standoff.
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao walks behind the enemy team without backup and is deleted in one second.
events.recommended_action: Coordinate flanks with the team's engage or wait for the enemy to commit their CC.

events.coach_claim: Winning despite poor performance due to "professional" teammates.
events.gameplay_event: Team wins the game while Xiao Qiao is 3-8-X.
events.evidence: The victory screen shows a win despite Xiao Qiao's repeated fundamental errors.
events.recommended_action: Focus on reducing "feeder" deaths to avoid being a burden even when carried.

events.coach_claim: The player failed to use Flash to escape the enemy jungler but used it unnecessarily later.
events.gameplay_event: Player dies to enemy jungler after holding Flash; later flashes into a bush with no enemies.
events.evidence: Audio: "This flash was meant for the New Year." Visual: Holding flash during gank.
events.recommended_action: Use defensive summoner spells proactively to avoid early deaths.

events.coach_claim: One person chasing two enemies is inefficient; rotating late due to indecision.
events.gameplay_event: Player chases two enemies unsuccessfully, delaying rotation to the bottom lane.
events.evidence: Audio: "Why is one person chasing two people?" Visual: Delayed rotation to bot.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize lane pressure and rotations over low-probability kills.

events.coach_claim: Wasting time in the mid-lane caused the player to miss a crucial fight in the bot lane.
events.gameplay_event: Player lingers in mid-lane; by the time they reach bot, the engagement is over.
events.evidence: Audio: "Don't underestimate these few seconds." Visual: Arriving late to bot fight.
events.recommended_action: Improve rotation speed and minimize "empty" movement time between lanes.

events.coach_claim: The player missed four consecutive 2nd skills (freezes), leading to a death.
events.gameplay_event: Player misses multiple Skill 2 casts on Sima Yi and is subsequently killed.
events.evidence: Audio: "Let's count how many skills Ms. Wang missed." Visual: 4 missed freezes.
events.recommended_action: Practice skill shot prediction and wait for teammate CC before casting Skill 2.

events.coach_claim: Returning to mid to share waves with the jungler is inefficient for a "tool-man" mage.
events.gameplay_event: Player rotates back to mid to clear a wave already being handled by the jungler.
events.evidence: Audio: "No need to go back to the middle road." Visual: Sharing gold/XP with jungler.
events.recommended_action: Stay in side lanes to apply pressure or scout enemy jungle when mid is covered.

events.coach_claim: Improper skill sequencing allowed the enemy to survive a CC chain.
events.gameplay_event: Player uses Ult/Skill 1 before Skill 2 on a CC'd target, missing the follow-up freeze.
events.evidence: Audio: "You don't pick up 2 skills... throw a big move first." Visual: Failed CC follow-up.
events.recommended_action: Always chain Skill 2 immediately after a teammate's hard CC to secure kills.

events.coach_claim: Rotating to top to fight two tanks is a waste of resources for Wang Zhaojun.
events.gameplay_event: Player rotates top to engage Bai Qi and Xiahou Dun, failing to deal significant damage.
events.evidence: Audio: "This is not a game to hit the road... two tanks." Visual: Ineffective poke on tanks.
events.recommended_action: Focus on squishy targets; avoid wasting high-cooldown skills on enemy tanks.

events.coach_claim: Greed for health packs while at low HP led to an unnecessary death.
events.gameplay_event: Player lingers near the enemy to grab a health pack and is caught by the enemy team.
events.evidence: Audio: "Gluttony wants to eat blood packs." Visual: Death while pathing to health pack.
events.recommended_action: Recall immediately when at low health if the map is dark or enemies are nearby.

events.coach_claim: Attempting to defend a tier-2 tower alone without an Ultimate is suicidal.
events.gameplay_event: Player tries to hold a tower solo against multiple enemies without their Ultimate available.
events.evidence: Audio: "Don't even look at the second tower... no big trick." Visual: Solo defense failure.
events.recommended_action: Abandon low-priority objectives if they cannot be defended safely; regroup with the team.

events.coach_claim: The team lost by dumping all resources into a single tank instead of focusing carries.
events.gameplay_event: The entire team uses all ultimates on Xiahou Dun, who survives; the team is then wiped.
events.evidence: Audio: "Give all your skills to a Xiahou Dun." Visual: Team dump on tank, resulting in DEFEAT.
events.recommended_action: Coordinate focus fire on enemy damage dealers rather than the front-line tank.

events.coach_claim: Jungler location was predictable based on timing and lane presence.
events.gameplay_event: Bianque caught in river by enemy Ukyo Tachibana.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach notes jungler was not on development lane at 1:24.
events.recommended_action: Track enemy jungler starting buff to predict gank windows; play conservatively when jungler is MIA.

events.coach_claim: Always help teammates crash the wave after a gank to prevent a freeze.
events.gameplay_event: Bianque assists Lu Bu in clearing the wave before using the portal.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach explains the risk of the wave being stuck in front of the enemy tower.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize crashing waves into the enemy tower after successful skirmishes to deny gold/exp.

events.coach_claim: The mid-lane tower's importance is above all else.
events.gameplay_event: Bianque shows on the bottom lane while enemy groups mid; mid tower is lost.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach states mid tower is "above everything" (高於一切的).
events.recommended_action: Prioritize mid-lane wave clear and defense over low-impact roaming in the early-mid game.

events.coach_claim: Poor escape routing led to an avoidable death.
events.gameplay_event: Bianque runs into the river away from teammates and is chased down by Di Renjie.
events.evidence: Visual: Bianque is isolated; Audio: Coach mentions a "disconnect" (脫節) from the team.
events.recommended_action: Flash toward teammates for protection; avoid isolated paths when enemy carries are nearby.

events.coach_claim: Position more cautiously when facing a hook-based hero like Zhong Kui.
events.gameplay_event: Bianque is hooked by Zhong Kui due to aggressive positioning.
events.evidence: Visual: Bianque stands in the open within hook range.
events.recommended_action: Respect the threat range of enemy CC; position behind minions or tanks when flash is on cooldown.

events.coach_claim: Failure to manage side-lane waves led to a backdoor loss.
events.gameplay_event: Enemy Ukyo Tachibana split-pushes to the crystal while the team is distracted mid.
events.evidence: Visual: Ukyo taking the crystal; Audio: Coach critiques lack of wave defense.
events.recommended_action: Assign a teammate to clear side waves before committing to full-team mid-lane standoffs in late game.

events.coach_claim: "Starting with a center-left defensive vision is a good thing."
events.gameplay_event: Shao Siyuan provides early vision in the river brush.
events.evidence: Visual: Support enters river brush; Audio: Coach praises the opening move.
events.recommended_action: Maintain early vision habits to track enemy jungle starts.

events.coach_claim: "Chang'e has strong wave clear; coordinate to match her rotation."
events.gameplay_event: Mid-lane wave clear contest against enemy Chang'e.
events.evidence: Visual: Chang'e clearing mid quickly; Audio: Coach notes 2v1 parity.
events.recommended_action: Coordinate mid-clear with the mage to enable faster rotations.

events.coach_claim: "Support's absence in top lane led to a disadvantageous 2v2."
events.gameplay_event: Top lane teammates lose a fight while support is stuck bottom.
events.evidence: Visual: Top lane death icons; Audio: Coach notes the lack of auxiliary help.
events.recommended_action: Improve map awareness; rotate to lanes where numbers are equal/disadvantageous.

events.coach_claim: "Shao Siyuan is stronger before level 3; XP distribution was inefficient."
events.gameplay_event: Discussion on leveling spikes and teammate Su Lie taking XP.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach explains Shao Siyuan's early power spike vs. Su Lie's.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize support XP early to hit level 3 power spikes faster.

events.coach_claim: "Secure vision before the jungler enters the area."
events.gameplay_event: Dian Wei (jungler) enters the red/blue zones.
events.evidence: Visual: Support checking brushes ahead of Dian Wei.
events.recommended_action: Always lead with vision when the jungler is invading or rotating through river.

events.coach_claim: "Shao Siyuan's single-point control is more terrifying than Guiguzi's early."
events.gameplay_event: Teamfight near the Tyrant pit involving Shao Siyuan's CC.
events.evidence: Audio: Comparison between Shao Siyuan and Guiguzi's CC types.
events.recommended_action: Leverage single-point CC to pick off high-priority targets early.

events.coach_claim: "Beware of enemies camping in brushes; don't face-check."
events.gameplay_event: Dian Wei ambushes Shao Siyuan from a brush.
events.evidence: Visual: Dian Wei jumps out of a bush; Audio: Coach notes the "fake vision."
events.recommended_action: Use abilities to scout brushes before entering, especially against burst junglers.

events.coach_claim: "In the late game, protecting the ADC is the absolute priority."
events.gameplay_event: Final teamfight leading to defeat; ADC (Sun Quan) is exposed.
events.evidence: Visual: ADC dying in the final push; Audio: Coach emphasizes late-game protection.
events.recommended_action: Transition from initiation to peel-heavy playstyle in the late game to protect the carry.

events.coach_claim: "Maintain good output and protection in the mid-to-late stages."
events.gameplay_event: Post-game defeat screen and stats analysis.
events.evidence: Visual: Defeat screen, 9.7 score; Audio: Final summary of the match.
events.recommended_action: Review positioning in late-game sieges to ensure the main damage source survives.

events.coach_claim: Prioritize supporting active skirmishes over low-value jungle steals.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao attempts to steal a small jungle monster while a fight occurs in the bot lane.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach critiques the choice to steal "Ono" instead of helping bot.
events.recommended_action: Rotate to support teammates during early-game skirmishes to secure kills/assists.

events.coach_claim: Avoid siphoning resources from your own jungler during the laning phase.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao clears jungle camps while the jungler (Zhao Yun) is nearby.
events.evidence: Visible: Xiao Qiao uses skills on jungle monsters while Zhao Yun is clearing.
events.recommended_action: Return to lane to clear waves; leave jungle camps for the jungler to maintain their level.

events.coach_claim: Use "fake vision" and map positioning to ambush roaming enemies.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao hides in a bush to intercept the enemy jungler.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach explains the "hang the edge" strategy to catch the opponent off guard.
events.recommended_action: Clear the wave quickly then move out of enemy vision to create pressure or set up an ambush.

events.coach_claim: Deny enemy economy by letting Dragon Minions clear waves when safe.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao clears a bot lane wave that was already being handled by advanced minions.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach notes that letting the minions clear would have cost the enemy ~200 gold.
events.recommended_action: Allow advanced minions to clear waves to deny the enemy the opportunity to farm under tower.

events.coach_claim: Do not blindly follow teammates into areas where enemies were recently spotted.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao follows Nezha into the river and is ambushed by Zhen Ji.
events.evidence: Visible: Zhen Ji was previously spotted on the minimap in the lower river area.
events.recommended_action: Check the minimap for enemy positions before rotating through un-warded river sections.

events.coach_claim: Maintain safe positioning and avoid wandering alone in the late game.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao wanders into the river alone and is caught by three enemies.
events.evidence: Visible: Xiao Qiao is isolated in the river without backup, leading to a team wipe.
events.recommended_action: Group with teammates and avoid entering high-risk zones without vision or support.

events.coach_claim: A single mage cannot defend a tier-2 tower against a full team push.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao attempts to defend the mid tier-2 tower alone and dies.
events.evidence: Visible: Xiao Qiao is overwhelmed by multiple enemies under her own tower.
events.recommended_action: Concede the tower and retreat to the high ground to defend with the full team.

events.coach_claim: "Don't keep saying it was an accident; the more you say it, the more it seems like your true skill."
events.gameplay_event: Introduction showing a 1-12-7 Angela score.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach mocking the player's excuses. Visual: Match summary screen.
events.recommended_action: Focus on identifying patterns of failure rather than dismissing them as accidents.

events.coach_claim: Angela is "clumsy" for taking unnecessary tower damage during the first wave.
events.gameplay_event: Angela walks into enemy tower range while clearing minions.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela takes a turret shot at level 1.
events.recommended_action: Better spacing; clear waves from the edge of the turret range.

events.coach_claim: Angela missed an opportunity to invade or rotate despite knowing the enemy jungler's start.
events.gameplay_event: Angela stays in lane after clearing, while the enemy jungler is spotted at blue.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach notes enemy jungler is "blue-starting." Visual: Angela idling in mid.
events.recommended_action: Use level 2 priority to steal enemy jungle (pigs) or rotate to support side lanes.

events.coach_claim: Angela ignores the map and rotates poorly, leading to unnecessary deaths.
events.gameplay_event: Angela invades alone, burns Flash, then dies to a Sun Ce rotation she should have seen.
events.evidence: Visual: Sun Ce is visible on the minimap before the kill. Audio: "You completely treated the minimap as decoration."
events.recommended_action: Check the minimap every 3-5 seconds; do not invade without support or vision of the enemy.

events.coach_claim: "You have an idea to grab the blue/red buff but no skill to execute."
events.gameplay_event: Angela repeatedly attempts to steal jungle buffs but misses all skills on Kai.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela's 2-1 skill combo misses the target entirely.
events.recommended_action: Practice skill shot leading; don't commit to invades if key abilities are on cooldown.

events.coach_claim: Angela joins a fight without her Ultimate or Flash, leading to a double kill for the enemy.
events.gameplay_event: Angela and Guan Yu engage Kai in the river and both die.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela has no Ultimate icon available. Audio: "No Ult, no Flash, and you still want to fight."
events.recommended_action: Do not force river skirmishes when major cooldowns are unavailable.

events.coach_claim: Angela is caught by the same Sun Ce rotation twice because she won't look at the map.
events.gameplay_event: Sun Ce rotates mid with vision; Angela stays pushed up and dies.
events.evidence: Visual: Sun Ce's boat is visible on the map long before impact.
events.recommended_action: Retreat to the turret immediately when a high-mobility threat like Sun Ce is missing or spotted rotating.

events.coach_claim: Angela prioritizes a side-lane kill over the crucial Mid Tier-1 Tower.
events.gameplay_event: Angela rotates bottom for a kill while the enemy clears mid and takes the tower.
events.evidence: Audio: "The Mid Tier-1 tower is more important than the jungle or a kill." Visual: Mid tower falls.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize defending the Mid Tier-1 tower as it is the most important strategic point on the map.

events.coach_claim: Angela "walks into Kai's face" repeatedly while he is ahead.
events.gameplay_event: Angela face-checks bushes or walks directly into a fed Kai, dying instantly.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela's death count rises to 0-9. Audio: "I think this Angela is really drunk."
events.recommended_action: Respect the enemy's gold lead; avoid face-checking bushes when the enemy jungler is missing.

events.coach_claim: Angela fails multiple ambushes due to poor skill accuracy.
events.gameplay_event: Angela hides in bushes but misses her stun (Skill 2) on Sun Ce and Da Qiao.
events.evidence: Visual: Skill 2 misses, followed by Angela being counter-killed.
events.recommended_action: Wait for the enemy to be in the center of the bush or use a teammate's CC to setup your combo.

events.coach_claim: Angela's split-pushing results in her death because she doesn't account for the enemy's mobility.
events.gameplay_event: Angela pushes top lane alone and is chased down by Kai.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela is caught far from her team. Audio: "Eat two knock-ups and give one for free."
events.recommended_action: Only split-push if you have vision of the primary threats or have an escape route (Flash) ready.

events.coach_claim: Angela stands still like a "block of wood" during the final base defense.
events.gameplay_event: Angela uses her Ultimate in a fixed direction while the enemy Sun Quan moves behind her.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela dies in base; "Defeat" screen appears. Audio: "The final score is as high as 5.5."
events.recommended_action: Reposition during the Ultimate if the hero allows, or cancel it early to avoid being a stationary target.

events.coach_claim: Invading the enemy blue zone while the enemy jungler invades yours is a viable trade.
events.gameplay_event: Angela follows Cheng Yaojin to invade the enemy blue buff.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach confirms this thinking is fine as defending own jungle might not yield kills.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize high-value trades when your own jungle is compromised.

events.coach_claim: Leaving small jungle camps for the jungler is a good detail.
events.gameplay_event: Angela helps the jungler clear but refrains from taking the final hit on small camps.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela moves away from low-HP camps to let the jungler finish.
events.recommended_action: Optimize team economy by letting the jungler recover lost gold/exp.

events.coach_claim: Surviving a catch due to enemy level disadvantage.
events.gameplay_event: Angela is caught out of position but survives because the enemy Monkey hasn't reached level 4.
events.evidence: Visual: Monkey fails to secure the kill; Angela uses Flash to escape.
events.recommended_action: Be more aware of enemy jungler rotations when Flash is down.

events.coach_claim: Using the Ultimate to clear waves when low HP is a necessary sacrifice.
events.gameplay_event: Angela uses her Ult to clear a wave pushed by Jiang Ziya under the tower.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela clears the wave; Jiang Ziya flashes in and dies to the tower/Ult.
events.recommended_action: Use Ultimates defensively to prevent tower damage if a recall is impossible.

events.coach_claim: Angela's bush-camping (ambushing) is effective early on.
events.gameplay_event: Angela repeatedly catches Jiang Ziya from bushes using the 2-1-3 combo.
events.evidence: Visual: Multiple successful ambushes on the enemy mid-laner.
events.recommended_action: Continue leveraging Angela's burst from fog of war.

events.coach_claim: Standing still during the Ultimate makes you an easy target.
events.gameplay_event: Angela stands stationary during her Ult against Yuan Ge and is killed.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela remains fixed in place while Yuan Ge maneuvers and kills her.
events.recommended_action: Cancel the Ultimate early or reposition if the target is no longer in the beam.

events.coach_claim: Obsessive bush-camping leads to team disconnection.
events.gameplay_event: Angela waits in a bush for over a minute, ignoring the rest of the map.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach notes Angela is "out of touch" with the team for a full minute.
events.recommended_action: Balance ambush attempts with active map presence and wave clearing.

events.coach_claim: Ignoring teammates' fights to stay in a bush is detrimental.
events.gameplay_event: Teammates fight 4v5 nearby while Angela remains hidden in a bush.
events.evidence: Visual: Mini-map shows teammates engaged while Angela stays stationary.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize supporting active teamfights over waiting for a perfect ambush.

events.coach_claim: Poor map awareness leads to high ground loss.
events.gameplay_event: Angela fails to notice Monkey pushing the top high ground until it's too late.
events.evidence: Visual: Monkey destroys the high ground tower while Angela is distracted.
events.recommended_action: Frequently check the mini-map to track split-pushers.

events.coach_claim: The game is lost due to a failure to defend the crystal.
events.gameplay_event: The enemy team destroys the crystal shortly after Angela leaves the fountain.
events.evidence: Visual: Crystal explosion and "Defeat" screen.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize base defense over chasing kills in the late game.

events.coach_claim: Tracking the enemy jungler's starting path is crucial for early safety.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao checks the enemy red buff area.
events.evidence: Red buff is missing at 1:00, indicating a blue-side start.
events.recommended_action: Ping the enemy jungler's likely location for side lanes.

events.coach_claim: Avoid standing directly inside the minion wave when laning against Milady.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao takes unnecessary poke from Milady's skills.
events.evidence: Player stands near minions, getting hit by Milady's S1/S2.
events.recommended_action: Position away from the wave to force Milady to choose between poke and clear.

events.coach_claim: Mages in mid-low tiers should aggressively take side lane farm to carry.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao clears Ma Chao's top lane wave.
events.evidence: Gold lead increases; "Echo" item completed very early at 3:20.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize high-value farm over aimless roaming if teammates are failing.

events.coach_claim: Maintaining high HP during sieges is vital to prevent global ultimate executions.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao dies to Nezha's ultimate after taking Milady poke.
events.evidence: HP drops to ~30% due to poor positioning before Nezha dives.
events.recommended_action: Stay out of Milady's skill range while waiting for the wave to enter the tower.

events.coach_claim: Rotations must be guided by mini-map information to avoid being collapsed upon.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao pushes mid without noticing enemy rotations.
events.evidence: Enemy Sang Qi and Ying are visible moving toward mid on the map.
events.recommended_action: Retreat immediately when enemies disappear from side lanes toward your position.

events.coach_claim: Committing to an objective without vision or numbers advantage is a throw.
events.gameplay_event: Team attempts Tyrant and gets wiped.
events.evidence: Team starts Tyrant while enemies are up and nearby; no zone control.
events.recommended_action: Concede the objective if the enemy team has better positioning and health.

events.coach_claim: Defensive actives must be timed to dodge burst, not just used reactively.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao uses Golden Body but still dies to Nezha/Monkey.
events.evidence: Golden Body is used too late to mitigate the primary burst damage.
events.recommended_action: Anticipate the dive and use Golden Body/Flash to reposition before the CC lands.

events.coach_claim: Flaming teammates distracts from win conditions and worsens performance.
events.gameplay_event: Player opens mic to criticize Ma Chao's play.
events.evidence: Audio of player complaining; focus shifts from map to chat.
events.recommended_action: Mute struggling teammates and focus on personal positioning and farm.

events.coach_claim: "Monkey's ability to steal the overlord is very strong... you have to pay attention."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao clears the first wave against Xishi.
events.evidence: Audio commentary warns about enemy jungler (Monkey) buff stealing.
events.recommended_action: Spend a few seconds scouting the jungle area early to prevent buff steals.

events.coach_claim: "Why do you still want to go to the wild area to grab it?"
events.gameplay_event: Player ignores bot lane support to invade enemy wolves; gets caught in blue zone.
events.evidence: Player is seen pathing deep into enemy jungle without vision; Monkey catches them.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize lane support and safe resource control over high-risk invades against high-burst junglers.

events.coach_claim: "Why are you thinking about flashing and running to the left?"
events.gameplay_event: Player flashes directly into Xishi's pull range while trying to escape.
events.evidence: Visual of Xiao Qiao flashing towards the enemy Xishi instead of away.
events.recommended_action: Practice flash-direction under pressure; always flash away from CC threats.

events.coach_claim: "No game awareness... Xishi is a person planting grass [hiding] in the mid road."
events.gameplay_event: Player walks straight into a bush where Xishi is visible/expected; gets pulled and killed.
events.evidence: Audio notes lack of awareness; visual shows player pathing blindly into a threat.
events.recommended_action: Use skills to check bushes or take wider pathing when enemy CC is off-map.

events.coach_claim: "With the coil, you can test the fried river first."
events.gameplay_event: Player uses lane priority to scout the river and forces Xishi to flash.
events.evidence: Visual shows Xiao Qiao using skill 1 to check river and engaging Xishi successfully.
events.recommended_action: Maintain river vision when you have lane priority to secure the first-move advantage.

events.coach_claim: "Why do you keep walking towards Xishi's face?"
events.gameplay_event: Player paths through river and gets caught by Xishi again despite knowing the threat.
events.evidence: Visual shows player repeating the same pathing mistake; audio expresses frustration.
events.recommended_action: Avoid high-traffic river paths when enemy CC heroes are missing from the map.

events.coach_claim: "Control the gravity resources down the road... team-mates are still comparable to Tongtian Belt."
events.gameplay_event: Player ignores bot lane gold/buffs, gets caught by Xishi again; team carries the fight.
events.evidence: Visual shows player dying while team wins a 4v4 elsewhere.
events.recommended_action: Focus on securing safe side-lane resources to catch up in economy when behind.

events.coach_claim: "Finally, there is no Pokémon hardcover... this is a nightmare."
events.gameplay_event: Player builds "Nightmare" item; coach notes improvement in itemization.
events.evidence: Item shop UI shows the player selecting Nightmare.
events.recommended_action: Continue adapting builds to counter enemy healing or specific compositions.

events.coach_claim: "One set of skills cooperate with Guan Yu to accept [kill]."
events.gameplay_event: Player assists Guan Yu in killing Monkey and invades enemy blue zone.
events.evidence: Visual shows successful kill and subsequent jungle invasion.
events.recommended_action: Coordinate with high-mobility teammates to punish enemy jungler deaths.

events.coach_claim: "Are you so soft-hearted? Reluctant to start."
events.gameplay_event: Player ambushes Sikong in a bush but fails to commit or follow up aggressively.
events.evidence: Visual shows Xiao Qiao hitting skill 2 but not following up with a full combo.
events.recommended_action: Commit to full combos during successful ambushes to secure kills.

events.coach_claim: "Want to find the princess [Gongsun Li] opposite to jump... set of skills is not lost in seconds."
events.gameplay_event: Player tries to solo Gongsun Li in river; fails to kill and wastes flash.
events.evidence: Visual shows failed solo kill attempt and defensive flash usage.
events.recommended_action: Avoid solo-dueling high-mobility marksmen unless they are significantly behind in gold.

events.coach_claim: "I'm not on the same channel as my teammates... then he was pulled into his hand."
events.gameplay_event: Player overextends to push mid tower without flash; gets caught by Xishi.
events.evidence: Visual shows player isolated at enemy tower; audio notes lack of team synchronization.
events.recommended_action: Play more conservatively when flash is on cooldown, especially during tower sieges.

events.coach_claim: "Look carefully... how many skills are empty?"
events.gameplay_event: Player misses multiple skill 1 and skill 2 casts during a chaotic teamfight.
events.evidence: Visual shows several missed skill shots during the mid-lane engagement.
events.recommended_action: Improve skill-shot leading and wait for teammate CC before committing high-impact spells.

events.coach_claim: "Look carefully at the monkey... 2 skills are empty."
events.gameplay_event: Player misses skill 2 on Monkey while invading; gets countered and killed.
events.evidence: Visual shows missed CC leading to a death from the enemy jungler.
events.recommended_action: Hold CC skills for self-defense when invading areas without full vision.

events.coach_claim: "You are alone on the opposite side... must be away from the river."
events.gameplay_event: Player clears bot lane alone while team is at Overlord; paths through river and dies to Monkey.
events.evidence: Visual shows poor pathing choice; audio suggests pathing through the second tower instead.
events.recommended_action: Use safe pathing (behind towers) when rotating alone while the enemy team is unaccounted for.

events.coach_claim: "Next second the monkey comes from the right... this wave really doesn't work."
events.gameplay_event: Player gets caught by Monkey and Gongsun Li while trying to regroup.
events.evidence: Visual shows player pinched between two high-damage enemies.
events.recommended_action: Group earlier and avoid isolated rotations in the late game.

events.coach_claim: Damage is dependent on economy, not just the hero.
events.gameplay_event: Diaochan trades aggressively but lacks burst.
events.evidence: Audio: "If you know how to brush economy, it can't be harmless."
events.recommended_action: Focus on farming to reach core item power spikes before forced trades.

events.coach_claim: Diaochan's first power spike is Holy Grail and CD shoes.
events.gameplay_event: Player engages in high-risk tower dives at level 2.
events.evidence: Audio: "Before the Holy Grail comes out... don't let yourself drop [HP]."
events.recommended_action: Play defensively and preserve HP until reaching 40% CDR and mana sustain.

events.coach_claim: Staying at low HP near the enemy tower invites ganks.
events.gameplay_event: Player lingers at 10% HP; enemy jungler (Liu Bei) kills them.
events.evidence: Visual: Diaochan stays in lane with sliver of health; Audio: "He must have found time to come and mess with you."
events.recommended_action: Recall immediately when HP is low and enemy jungler's position is unknown.

events.coach_claim: Walking in the river without Flash or Ult is suicide.
events.gameplay_event: Diaochan face-checks river brush without escape tools.
events.evidence: Visual: No flash/ult icons available; Audio: "Definitely can't stand this river vision."
events.recommended_action: Avoid high-risk rotations through un-warded areas when escape spells are on cooldown.

events.coach_claim: Poor Ultimate placement "evacuates" the enemy instead of trapping them.
events.gameplay_event: Enemies simply walk out of the Ult circle during skirmishes.
events.evidence: Visual: Ult placed too early/casually; Audio: "The big move to evacuate the crowd... too well."
events.recommended_action: Wait for enemy hard CC to be used or for them to commit to a location before dropping Ult.

events.coach_claim: Prioritize objectives (Tyrant) over low-probability ganks.
events.gameplay_event: Player ignores 4-minute Tyrant to chase a mobile Sikong Zhen top.
events.evidence: Visual: Tyrant is up; Diaochan is in top lane; Audio: "How could he possibly catch a Sikong Town?"
events.recommended_action: Rotate to dragon pit at 4 minutes; Diaochan excels at early objective teamfights.

events.coach_claim: Bad mentality leads to "tool man" complaints and feeding.
events.gameplay_event: Player dies again while arguing about wave gold.
events.evidence: Audio: "I'm not a tool man... your current mindset is no longer suitable."
events.recommended_action: Mute chat and focus on personal positioning rather than teammate gold intake.

events.coach_claim: Teamfights are won when enemies are forced to group in the Ult.
events.gameplay_event: Diaochan gets a double kill as enemies teleport into her circle.
events.evidence: Visual: Enemy Da Qiao teleports team into Diaochan's Ult; Audio: "This wave of big moves is very invincible."
events.recommended_action: Capitalize on enemy grouping; look for chokepoints where the Ult covers the entire path.

events.coach_claim: Don't challenge fed enemies when you are 0-6.
events.gameplay_event: Diaochan jumps into a fed Sikong Zhen and is deleted instantly.
events.evidence: Visual: Scoreboard shows 0-6; Audio: "You still want to hurt... how is that possible?"
events.recommended_action: Play for peel and cleanup in teamfights when behind; avoid 1v1s against fed carries.

events.coach_claim: Lack of crowd control makes it impossible to hold enemies.
events.gameplay_event: Diaochan tries to chase but enemies just walk away.
events.evidence: Audio: "Wanted to run out and keep people, but I really can't control it."
events.recommended_action: Acknowledge Diaochan's lack of hard CC; rely on teammates for setup or use Frosty's Revenge.

events.coach_claim: "Sticking to the line at level 1 is really rare."
events.gameplay_event: Zhen Ji freezes the first wave near her tower instead of hard clearing.
events.evidence: Video shows Zhen Ji standing back, only last-hitting minions.
events.recommended_action: Continue this practice to deny enemy XP/Gold early.

events.coach_claim: "These two lines of arms don't need to be cleared... let them stay in front of your tower."
events.gameplay_event: Player clears the mid-wave while the enemy mid-laner is missing.
events.evidence: Analyst notes the enemy mid-laner (Gan Jiang) is roaming; clearing pushes the wave into unsafe territory.
events.recommended_action: Freeze the wave to force the enemy to overextend for farm.

events.coach_claim: "Your reflex arc is a bit too long... walking straight to the opposite face."
events.gameplay_event: Zhen Ji walks directly into the enemy jungler in the river without using her ultimate or flash.
events.evidence: Video shows Zhen Ji walking into a bush without vision and reacting slowly to the enemy's appearance.
events.recommended_action: Use skills to check bushes or path through safer jungle routes.

events.coach_claim: "You're playing so thoughtfully... afraid there is no vision of you."
events.gameplay_event: Low HP Zhen Ji stays to clear a wave and throws a skill back at the enemy, revealing her location.
events.evidence: Zhen Ji is visible on the minimap; she throws a skill that confirms her exact position for Gan Jiang to snipe.
events.recommended_action: Recall immediately when low; do not reveal position by poking when vulnerable.

events.coach_claim: "How can I defend the blue zone for you?"
events.gameplay_event: Player focuses on clearing mid-minions while the enemy invades the team's blue buff.
events.evidence: Minimap shows the enemy jungler at the blue buff while Zhen Ji stays in lane.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize objective defense over non-critical minion waves.

events.coach_claim: "A mage group tops the front... beaten into blood."
events.gameplay_event: Zhen Ji initiates a teamfight by standing ahead of her tank (Xiang Yu).
events.evidence: Zhen Ji's character model is the furthest forward during the engagement.
events.recommended_action: Maintain backline positioning; wait for tanks to initiate.

events.coach_claim: "The intelligence is free, and none of them wins."
events.gameplay_event: Zhen Ji attempts to gank top lane but misses all her skill shots (1st and 2nd skills).
events.evidence: Video shows skills landing in empty space; enemy Li Xin counter-attacks easily.
events.recommended_action: Practice skill-shot lead times and wait for CC from teammates.

events.coach_claim: "This tower has to be guarded... really not worth it to die."
events.gameplay_event: Zhen Ji dies trying to defend the mid 2nd tower against four enemies while her team is dead.
events.evidence: Zhen Ji pokes from under tower, gets dove, and dies, leading to a total base loss.
events.recommended_action: Abandon undefendable towers to stay alive for high-ground defense.

events.coach_claim: Roaming to the jungler at the start is inefficient for a support like Sun Bin.
events.gameplay_event: Sun Bin follows Han Xin in the jungle at level 1.
events.evidence: Audio: "Is it helping Han Xin speed up?" sarcastically.
events.recommended_action: Support should help Mid clear or provide vision in river.

events.coach_claim: Skill dumping without baiting enemy defensive abilities is poor mechanics.
events.gameplay_event: Yi Xing uses all skills immediately upon seeing the enemy.
events.evidence: Visible: Yi Xing's skill icons all go on cooldown instantly.
events.recommended_action: Use one skill to bait movement/dashes before committing full combo.

events.coach_claim: Do not rotate to a "collapsed" lane; focus on lanes with an existing advantage.
events.gameplay_event: Yi Xing repeatedly rotates bottom to help a losing Gongsun Li.
events.evidence: Visible: Bottom lane pushed to 2nd tower; Top lane (Meng Tian) is winning.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize ganking for the winning Top lane to snowball the map.

events.coach_claim: Mages should avoid leeching gold/XP from the marksman unless they provide a massive advantage.
events.gameplay_event: Yi Xing stays in the bottom lane to clear waves with the shooter.
events.evidence: Visible: Yi Xing "rubbing the line" (sharing farm) in the development lane.
events.recommended_action: Clear Mid quickly and rotate back; leave lane farm to the carry.

events.coach_claim: Identify and attack the enemy's weak link rather than reacting to their pressure.
events.gameplay_event: Enemy focuses bottom; Yi Xing fails to pressure the enemy Top (Si Kongzhen).
events.evidence: Audio: "Why don't you work around... Si Kongzhen is also a flaw."
events.recommended_action: Counter-pressure by diving the enemy's vulnerable solo laner.

events.coach_claim: Sacrifice flow Athena must bring Smite to disrupt the enemy jungle.
events.gameplay_event: Athena enters the game with Teleport instead of Smite.
events.evidence: Visible: Summoner spell icon is Teleport.
events.recommended_action: Always take Smite to steal neutral resources while "sacrificing."

events.coach_claim: The core of the sacrifice flow is wave management; dying is okay, but losing the wave is a failure.
events.gameplay_event: Athena dies to Diao Chan but fails to clear the minion wave.
events.evidence: Visible: Athena dies; minions remain alive and reach the tower.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize skill usage on the wave before death to ensure it is cleared.

events.coach_claim: Utilize the "spirit" form to provide constant vision on the enemy jungler.
events.gameplay_event: Athena roams aimlessly after death.
events.evidence: Audio: "Follow Yuan Fang... reveal the jungler's vision."
events.recommended_action: Stick to the enemy jungler while dead to negate their gank potential.

events.coach_claim: Avoid getting kills to keep your own gold bounty low, making your deaths worth less to the enemy.
events.gameplay_event: Coach explains the gold logic of the sacrifice flow.
events.evidence: Audio: "If I die a few more times, I'm worthless (20 gold)."
events.recommended_action: Focus on tower damage and wave clear; avoid finishing off low-HP enemies.

events.coach_claim: Transition to standard side-lane play once the team advantage is secured.
events.gameplay_event: Athena continues to feed despite the team being ahead.
events.evidence: Visible: Team score is 8 vs 10, but Athena is 0-7.
