events.recommended_action: Once ahead, play safely to maintain pressure and stop giving away gold.

events.coach_claim: Lock onto the back-row minions to clear the wave faster.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao clearing the first wave.
events.evidence: Audio commentary; Xiao Qiao auto-attacking front minions first.
events.recommended_action: Use precise targeting to clear back-row minions while waiting for skill cooldowns.

events.coach_claim: Don't retreat under the tower unnecessarily; rotate to the side lanes to support.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao retreats when enemy Zhang Liang appears.
events.evidence: Audio commentary; Zhang Liang has no hard CC at level 2 to stop a rotation.
events.recommended_action: Rotate through the jungle to the bot lane to support the team.

events.coach_claim: Follow your jungler's rotation path to maintain pressure.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao pathing toward the bot lane.
events.evidence: Audio commentary; Jungler is clearing toward the bot lane.
events.recommended_action: Align rotation with the jungler's movement to facilitate ganks.

events.coach_claim: Flash was used too late to avoid the enemy's crowd control.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao dies to Daji after a late rotation.
events.evidence: Audio commentary; Xiao Qiao flashes after being locked by Daji's 2nd skill.
events.recommended_action: Use Flash reactively before the projectile hits or to maintain distance.

events.coach_claim: Observe the mini-map to track the enemy jungler's last known position.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao gets hooked by Xuance in the river.
events.evidence: Audio commentary; Xuance was spotted in the mid-lane right brush earlier.
events.recommended_action: Hug the left side of the lane when the enemy jungler is likely in the right brush.

events.coach_claim: Prioritize objectives like the Overlord over clearing a safe mid-wave.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao clearing mid while the jungler is nearby.
events.evidence: Audio commentary; Jungler is positioned to take the Overlord.
events.recommended_action: Move to assist the jungler with the objective instead of solo-clearing.

events.coach_claim: Avoid pushing towers without vision of the enemy jungler.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao gets hooked by Xuance while sieging mid.
events.evidence: Audio commentary; Xuance rushes from the fog of war.
events.recommended_action: Position behind tanks (like Xiahou Dun) and maintain distance from un-warded brushes.

events.coach_claim: Failure to use Flash to dodge a predictable skill-shot.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao hooked by Xuance again near the base.
events.evidence: Audio commentary; Xuance's hook connects before Flash is used.
events.recommended_action: Anticipate the hook animation and Flash perpendicular to the trajectory.

events.coach_claim: Do not stand in enemy area-of-effect skills that cause slow or damage.
events.gameplay_event: Shooter (Hou Yi) takes damage from Erin's skill circle.
events.evidence: Audio commentary; Player walks into the glowing circle.
events.recommended_action: Move out of the skill radius immediately to preserve health.

events.coach_claim: Advanced controls (three-finger) are useless if they don't improve accuracy.
events.gameplay_event: Shooter uses three-finger camera control while farming.
events.evidence: Audio commentary; Visual of the camera shifting rapidly.
events.recommended_action: Focus on basic positioning and accuracy before attempting advanced camera manipulation.

events.coach_claim: Avoid passive "three-point" farming when the team needs support.
events.gameplay_event: Shooter clears mid, then jungle, ignoring the map state.
events.evidence: Audio commentary; Player is isolated while teammates are nearby.
events.recommended_action: Transition from farming to teamfighting when enemies are out of position.

events.coach_claim: Low damage contribution in teamfights despite high gold.
events.gameplay_event: Shooter hits multiple targets but fails to secure kills.
events.evidence: Audio commentary; Coach counts hits (15 knives) with little impact.
events.recommended_action: Focus fire on high-priority squishy targets rather than hitting the nearest tank.

events.coach_claim: Solo invading piglets without Flash is dangerously overextended.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao invades enemy red side for small creeps alone.
events.evidence: Audio warning about missing Flash and enemy jungler location.
events.recommended_action: Stick with the jungler to clear friendly camps safely.

events.coach_claim: Entering bushes blindly when the enemy jungler is unaccounted for is a fatal error.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao rotates through the river bush without vision.
events.evidence: Coach highlights the enemy jungler's lack of presence on the map.
events.recommended_action: Take a wider, safer path through friendly territory.

events.coach_claim: Chasing a low-health target into tower range without a secure exit is poor execution.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao takes three tower shots and dies while chasing Gan Jiang.
events.evidence: Visible death to defensive tower fire.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize survival over a risky trade-kill.

events.coach_claim: Overstaying to push a tower at low health invites an easy counter-gank.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao stays to hit the bot tower after a dive and dies to Lan.
events.evidence: Audio critique of "lingering for minor damage."
events.recommended_action: Recall immediately after securing the kill/objective.

events.coach_claim: Walking through the river without minion vision is a basic anti-gank failure.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao gets caught by Sun Bin's bomb in the river.
events.evidence: Coach mentions "basic anti-gank awareness."
events.recommended_action: Path through the jungle or wait for teammates to scout.

events.coach_claim: Engaging without checking the minimap for enemy teleports leads to wasted resources.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao flashes into an arriving Xiang Yu and dies.
events.evidence: Coach points out Xiang Yu's visible teleport on the map.
events.recommended_action: Check the minimap before committing high-cooldown skills.

events.coach_claim: Holding an aggressive high-ground position alone is unnecessary and risky.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao dies on the high ground while teammates are respawning.
events.evidence: Visible isolation from the team during an enemy push.
events.recommended_action: Retreat to the fountain or behind the nexus to regroup.

events.coach_claim: Prioritizing a bush ambush over clearing a meeting wave loses map pressure.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao waits in a bush while the mid wave meets.
events.evidence: Map shows waves clashing while Xiao Qiao is idle.
events.recommended_action: Clear the mid wave to force the enemy to respond.

events.coach_claim: Zhuge Liang fits the "Pokémon" (weak/predictable) trait by not clearing waves under tower.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao bursts down Zhuge Liang in mid lane.
events.evidence: Audio: "Directly coaxed Zhuge Liang to fall asleep." Visual: 2-1 combo landing.
events.recommended_action: Punish mid-laners who overextend without clearing waves.

events.coach_claim: Don't be greedy when the enemy has teleport/fast rotations.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao tries to support top but gets caught by Kai and Zhuge Liang.
events.evidence: Audio: "This wave can't be greedy... Zhuge Liang and Kai sealed your way back."
events.recommended_action: Watch the mini-map for enemy rotations before committing to a deep push or support.

events.coach_claim: Zhuge Liang is defenseless when walking through river blindly.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao ambushes Zhuge Liang from the river bush.
events.evidence: Audio: "Completely defenseless... squatted down and hit a hanging point."
events.recommended_action: Utilize bushes to ambush mid-laners rotating without vision.

events.coach_claim: Don't walk through river without vision or backup.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao tries to steal blue buff from Kai and nearly dies.
events.evidence: Audio: "Try not to take the river channel if it is not ready-made."
events.recommended_action: Path through jungle or wait for teammates when vision is missing.

events.coach_claim: Clear waves yourself if the jungler is busy elsewhere to maintain economy.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao rotates to mid and top to clear waves while the jungler fights.
events.evidence: Audio: "Decisively come to the middle road and make up the line by yourself."
events.recommended_action: Prioritize lane farm when teammates are occupied to boost personal economy.

events.coach_claim: Use minion waves as bait to lure out enemies.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao waits in a bush near a dragon minion to burst Irene.
events.evidence: Audio: "Continue to use this line of soldiers as bait."
events.recommended_action: Position near high-value waves to catch enemies attempting to clear them.

events.coach_claim: Don't dive high ground towers recklessly; it leads to unnecessary deaths.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao dies under the enemy high ground tower, causing a team wipe.
events.evidence: Audio: "Run to the defense tower and send one to you... then your crazy iron also fell."
events.recommended_action: Wait for the full team and a proper opening before diving high ground.

events.coach_claim: Angela "thoughtfully" helped the enemy jungler by lowering the blue buff's HP and then donating 200 gold.
events.gameplay_event: Angela invades the enemy blue buff area, damages the buff, and is subsequently killed by the enemy Han Xin.
events.evidence: Visible gameplay of invade; Audio: "Daily god-making plan."
events.recommended_action: Prioritize safe farming or coordinated invades; do not gift gold to the enemy carry.

events.coach_claim: Rotating to a fight without Ultimate or Flash is useless and makes you a "breakthrough point" for the enemy.
events.gameplay_event: Angela clears mid, then attempts to fight the enemy Xiao Qiao without her key cooldowns, resulting in another death.
events.evidence: HUD shows Ult/Flash on cooldown; Audio: "You have no big move, no flash."
events.recommended_action: Play defensively and clear waves safely when key survival/combat spells are unavailable.

events.coach_claim: Angela stole jungle creeps that the ally Dian Wei specifically needed to stack his passive.
events.gameplay_event: Angela takes the "piglets" (small jungle creeps) while the ally Dian Wei is nearby.
events.evidence: Visible Angela taking jungle; Audio explanation of Dian Wei's passive requirements.
events.recommended_action: Leave specific jungle resources for teammates who rely on them for scaling passives.

events.coach_claim: Angela ignored multiple retreat signals to continue stealing resources from her own jungler.
events.gameplay_event: Angela takes piglets again despite visible retreat pings from Dian Wei and Cai Wenji.
events.evidence: Visible retreat pings on map; Audio: "The retreat signals are all broken [from over-use]."
events.recommended_action: Respect teammate pings and coordinate resource distribution to maximize team strength.

events.coach_claim: Prioritizing a health pack over defending a tower and "squatting" in a bush while already visible.
events.gameplay_event: Angela goes to the bottom tower for a health pack while the mid tower is destroyed. She then hides in a bush already scouted by the enemy.
events.evidence: Visible mid tower destruction; Enemy Da Yu attacks the bush Angela is hiding in.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize objective defense; do not attempt ambushes from positions where your vision is compromised.

events.coach_claim: Angela's movement is aimless, either following teammates or enemies without considering the map state.
events.gameplay_event: Angela rotates to the top lane where three teammates are already present, leaving the red buff area undefended.
events.evidence: Visible map showing 4 allies top; Audio: "No need for three people to guard."
events.recommended_action: Improve map awareness to identify where presence is actually required (e.g., clearing side waves).

events.coach_claim: "The most important thing about stress resistance is state-of-the-art [health]."
events.gameplay_event: Hou Yi (Shooter) takes unnecessary poke from Sun Shangxiang.
events.evidence: Hou Yi fights the opposing shooter while his support is away, losing half his health for no gain.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize health maintenance; avoid trading when at a disadvantage or alone.

events.coach_claim: "The wiring [wave management] detail is almost zero."
events.gameplay_event: Hou Yi fails to freeze the minion wave near his tower.
events.evidence: The minion wave is near the tower, but Hou Yi clears it immediately instead of letting it stay in a safe zone.
events.recommended_action: Learn to "freeze" waves near the tower to farm safely and force the enemy to overextend.

events.coach_claim: "You have no state and no flash... I don't know what Sun Shangxiang is thinking [not diving]."
events.gameplay_event: Hou Yi stays in lane with critical health and no escape tools.
events.evidence: Hou Yi is visible on the map with <10% HP; the enemy shooter fails to capitalize on a free dive.
events.recommended_action: Recall immediately when low on health and flash is down to prevent being dived.

events.coach_claim: "You end up spinning a meaningless line... the tower is gone."
events.gameplay_event: Hou Yi rotates to mid lane while his own top tower is under siege.
events.evidence: Hou Yi leaves his lane to clear a mid wave that was already handled, losing his primary tower.
events.recommended_action: Defend your primary lane objectives before rotating for secondary farm.

events.coach_claim: "You're afraid of Lan Ling Wang, why are you bringing Beheading [Execute]?"
events.gameplay_event: Xi Shi (Mage) picks the Execute summoner spell instead of Flash.
events.evidence: The loadout screen shows Xi Shi with Execute; the player admits fear of the enemy assassin.
events.recommended_action: Use Flash or Purify against assassins to increase survivability.

events.coach_claim: "You gave him [the jungler] the middle... then two people were in a daze."
events.gameplay_event: Xi Shi clears the mid wave while the jungler is rotating to take it, then steals jungle camps.
events.evidence: Xi Shi takes the mid wave right before Pangu arrives, then takes Pangu's jungle monsters.
events.recommended_action: Allow the jungler to take mid waves during rotations to maximize team gold efficiency.

events.coach_claim: "In your subconcious, you feel the shooter is about to be caught... so you dare not go."
events.gameplay_event: Xi Shi plays extremely far back, refusing to provide vision or support.
events.evidence: Xi Shi hides behind the inner tower while the team is fighting near the river.
events.recommended_action: Balance safety with presence; use skills to check bushes rather than hiding entirely.

events.coach_claim: "You go out to the highlands to watch... My mom is picking up the plane."
events.gameplay_event: Xi Shi remains at the high ground (base) while her team wins a 4v5 teamfight.
events.evidence: Team scores a triple kill while Xi Shi is standing still in the base looking at the scoreboard.
events.recommended_action: Trust team momentum and provide utility/CC even if fearful of an assassin.

events.coach_claim: Xishi lacks early lane priority against Mai Shiranui.
events.gameplay_event: Laning phase vs. Shiranui
events.evidence: Visible: Xishi taking poke while clearing. Audio: Coach advises hiding under tower.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize safe wave clearing under tower; avoid unnecessary poke to maintain HP for rotations.

events.coach_claim: Player is "sleepwalking," walking directly into the enemy's face without a plan.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi face-checks Shiranui in river/mid
events.evidence: Visible: Xishi walks into melee range of Shiranui, fails Skill 1, and dies.
events.recommended_action: Maintain maximum range; do not approach enemies without Flash or teammate backup.

events.coach_claim: Lingering at low HP instead of resetting or using teammate utility.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi stays in river with low HP/no skills
events.evidence: Visible: Xishi ignores Luban's chain and recall, gets caught by Gongsun Li.
events.recommended_action: Use teammate utility (Luban's chain) to escape; reset immediately when low on HP/Mana.

events.coach_claim: Face-checking a river bush against four enemies without Flash is suicidal.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi attempts to squat on 4 enemies alone
events.evidence: Visible: Xishi enters river bush with no vision of 4 enemies, dies instantly.
events.recommended_action: Check bushes with Skill 2; never contest river solo when enemy positions are unknown.

events.coach_claim: Itemization is too glass-cannon for the current threat level.
events.gameplay_event: Survival issues against dive heroes
events.evidence: Audio: Coach suggests building Splendor (Golden Body) as the first major item.
events.recommended_action: Rush Splendor (Golden Body) to counter Nezha and Shiranui's targeted dive/burst.

events.coach_claim: The player's fatal flaw is attempting to land pulls while fully visible.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi walks up to enemies to use Skill 1
events.evidence: Visible: Xishi repeatedly walks into vision to pull, getting intercepted.
events.recommended_action: Learn to "hide vision"; cast Skill 1 from bushes or fog of war to increase hit rate and safety.

events.coach_claim: Camping a bush without considering teammate positioning.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi solo camps mid bush while team is bot
events.evidence: Visible: Xishi tries to pull Shiranui while isolated; gets counter-poked and dies to Nezha.
events.recommended_action: Coordinate bush camps with the team; do not initiate alone if teammates cannot follow up.

events.coach_claim: Poor map awareness leads to repeated deaths immediately after respawning.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi dies to Yunying under tower, then fails a Flash-pull
events.evidence: Visible: Xishi dies to Yunying's dash; respawns and wastes Flash on a low-probability pull.
events.recommended_action: Play defensively after respawning; save Flash for guaranteed kills or essential escapes.

events.coach_claim: Knowing the enemy jungler's pathing and securing first blood makes the start very comfortable.
events.gameplay_event: Yi Xing helps Kai (jungler) invade/defend and gets first blood.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach mentions knowing wilderness route. Visible: Yi Xing secures first blood.
events.recommended_action: Maintain early-game communication to track enemy jungler.

events.coach_claim: Rotating to top lane because Hou Yi used Flash is a classic, effective move.
events.gameplay_event: Yi Xing rotates top after clearing mid to pressure Hou Yi.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach notes Hou Yi's missing flash. Visible: Yi Xing moves to top river.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize rotations to lanes where enemy summoner spells are on cooldown.

events.coach_claim: Using "Line Boxing" (wave priority) allows a utility mage like Yi Xing to pressure side lanes effectively.
events.gameplay_event: Yi Xing clears mid and immediately looks to rotate.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach explains "Line Boxing" (线权法). Visible: Yi Xing clears wave quickly.
events.recommended_action: Clear waves efficiently to create windows for side-lane influence.

events.coach_claim: Rotating back to mid after helping the jungler was purposeless; you should have stayed to ambush or pressure.
events.gameplay_event: Yi Xing helps Kai with Red buff, then walks back to mid through the river.
events.evidence: Audio: "What's the point of your passing?" Visible: Yi Xing ignores a potential side-lane ambush.
events.recommended_action: Use rotation time to zone or ambush rather than just walking back to a safe lane.

events.coach_claim: If you had stayed side instead of returning mid, the jungler might not have been caught in a 2v2.
events.gameplay_event: Kai gets caught and dies while Yi Xing is in mid.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach says Kai might not be "cooked" if Yi Xing was there. Visible: Kai dies in side jungle.
events.recommended_action: Support the jungler's aggressive plays when mid-lane is already pushed.

events.coach_claim: Standing in mid with your ultimate ready is a waste; you need to use it to zone or catch enemies.
events.gameplay_event: Yi Xing stands passively in mid-lane during a standoff.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach critiques passive ultimate holding. Visible: Yi Xing's ult is off cooldown but unused.
events.recommended_action: Use Yi Xing's ultimate to proactively segment the battlefield or trap key targets.

events.coach_claim: The team collapsed because of "interconnectedness"—one person's bad positioning led to everyone dying.
events.gameplay_event: A messy teamfight leads to multiple deaths on Yi Xing's team.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach mentions "mutual reliance" (互相连带). Visible: Team wipes after a failed engage.
events.recommended_action: Maintain better spacing to prevent a single enemy engage from catching the whole team.

events.coach_claim: Browsing the shop ("Taobao") while teammates are fighting is a major focus error.
events.gameplay_event: Yi Xing opens the item shop overlay while a skirmish is happening nearby.
events.evidence: Audio: "You come to see equipment and browse Taobao." Visible: Shop menu covers the screen.
events.recommended_action: Pre-order items or buy quickly during downtime, never during active combat or rotations.

events.coach_claim: Attempting to steal the enemy's jungle creep ("small pig") at 56-57 seconds is too late.
events.gameplay_event: Angela invades enemy jungle after clearing the first wave.
events.evidence: Jungler (Yun Ying) has already cleared the blue side and is rotating to the mid-lane/red-side river.
events.recommended_action: Invade earlier (around 35-40s) or stay in lane to maintain priority.

events.coach_claim: Walking directly into the enemy jungler's face without Flash or Ultimate is a "free gift."
events.gameplay_event: Angela walks into the river bush and meets Yun Ying.
events.evidence: Angela has no escape tools available; Yun Ying easily secures the kill.
events.recommended_action: Respect the fog of war when escape skills are on cooldown.

events.coach_claim: Standing still with the Ultimate active after missing the stun (Skill 2) makes you a sitting duck.
events.gameplay_event: Angela misses Skill 2 on Yun Ying but continues to channel her Ultimate.
events.evidence: Angela remains stationary while Yun Ying and the enemy team burst her down.
events.recommended_action: Manually cancel the Ultimate immediately if the target isn't stunned or is moving out of range.

events.coach_claim: Ignoring the jungler and tank right in front of you to chase a half-health mage is fatal tunnel vision.
events.gameplay_event: Angela focuses on Xiao Qiao while Yun Ying and Lian Po are clearly visible nearby.
events.evidence: Angela dies while ignoring the immediate threats of the enemy frontline.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize survival and peel over chasing kills in disadvantageous positions.

events.coach_claim: When surrounded in the enemy red jungle, pathing toward the empty enemy blue jungle is safer than running toward your own base.
events.gameplay_event: Angela is pinched in the red jungle and tries to run back through the river.
events.evidence: The enemy team is closing in from the river; the blue side of the map is empty.
events.recommended_action: Improve escape pathing by identifying where the enemy *isn't* located.

events.coach_claim: Typing or using voice-to-text during a teamfight leads to unnecessary deaths.
events.gameplay_event: Angela stands still to communicate while a fight breaks out.
events.evidence: The "voice-to-text" icon is active while Angela is being attacked.
events.recommended_action: Focus on gameplay during active engagements; communicate only when safe.

events.coach_claim: Trying to save a teammate (Zhang Fei) whom the carry has already declared "dead" results in a double loss.
events.gameplay_event: Angela rotates to "save" Zhang Fei despite Marco Polo saying he can't get out.
events.evidence: Audio: Marco Polo says "Zhang Fei can't get out." Angela enters the fight and dies immediately after.
events.recommended_action: Trust the shot-caller's assessment of a lost cause to avoid staggering deaths.

events.coach_claim: Don't take unnecessary damage; don't use your body to block the minion wave.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao takes poke from Yang Yuhuan and blocks minions with her HP.
events.evidence: Visual: Xiao Qiao's HP drops significantly while standing in the wave.
events.recommended_action: Clear waves from a safe distance using skills.

events.coach_claim: Avoid following enemy mid-laners blindly when low on health.
events.gameplay_event: Low HP Xiao Qiao follows Shen Mengxi into the river.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach warns about the "aircraft carrier" turning around.
events.recommended_action: Recall to base or rotate through safe jungle paths.

events.coach_claim: You can be killed by jungle creeps or minions when this low.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao attempts to hit Red Armor at critical HP and dies to it.
events.evidence: Visual: Red Armor's attack kills Xiao Qiao.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize survival and recall when HP is critical.

events.coach_claim: Standing in the river alone without Flash or Ultimate is suicidal.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao camps a river bush alone while enemies rotate.
events.evidence: Visual: Enemy team rotates mid; Xiao Qiao has no escape tools.
events.recommended_action: Stay near the tower or move with teammates.

events.coach_claim: Don't leave half-cleared waves to roam aimlessly.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao leaves mid-lane before the wave is fully cleared to "gank" bottom.
events.evidence: Visual: Minions are left alive while Xiao Qiao moves to bottom lane.
events.recommended_action: Fully clear the lane to maintain gold/XP and pressure.

events.coach_claim: Choosing defensive items over core damage is a mistake for this hero.
events.gameplay_event: Player pre-orders "Blazing Cape" (defensive) instead of "Echoing Staff".
events.evidence: Visual: Item shop shows defensive item selection.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize core burst damage items for Xiao Qiao.

events.coach_claim: Getting caught while wandering aimlessly in the river.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao is intercepted by A Ke in the river without vision.
events.evidence: Visual: A Ke jumps out of the fog and kills Xiao Qiao.
events.recommended_action: Use skills to check bushes and avoid un-warded river areas.

events.coach_claim: Skills are easily countered by enemy defensive abilities if timed poorly.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao's 1st skill is blocked by Gongsuli's 2nd skill.
events.evidence: Visual: Gongsuli's umbrella blocks the fan projectile.
events.recommended_action: Wait for enemy defensive cooldowns before committing skills.

events.coach_claim: Wasting the Ultimate on "air" and missing basic skill shots.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao activates Ultimate with no enemies nearby and misses 2nd skill.
events.evidence: Visual: Ultimate aura active with no targets; 2nd skill misses A Ke.
events.recommended_action: Save Ultimate for teamfights; improve skill-shot leading.

events.coach_claim: Total lack of positioning awareness during teamfights.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao stands in the middle of the enemy team and dies instantly.
events.evidence: Visual: Xiao Qiao is surrounded by four enemies and deleted.
events.recommended_action: Maintain backline positioning and use max range.

events.coach_claim: Refusing to surrender only to die immediately upon respawn.
events.gameplay_event: Player rejects surrender vote, respawns, and dies in the final base defense.
events.evidence: Visual: Surrender vote failed; Xiao Qiao dies immediately at base.
events.recommended_action: Focus on coordinated defense or recognize an unwinnable state.

events.coach_claim: Player is overly "gluttonous" for farm and takes unnecessary damage from the enemy Shen Mengxi.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao stands inside the minion wave, eating poke from Shen Mengxi's Skill 1, and dies shortly after reaching level 2.
events.evidence: Visible: Xiao Qiao takes full damage from bomb cat while trying to clear.
events.recommended_action: Improve positioning to avoid poke while clearing; respect enemy level spikes.

events.coach_claim: Instead of wasting time in mid, the player should help the jungler clear the blue zone to speed up their rotation.
events.gameplay_event: Miyamoto clears the mid wave for Xiao Qiao; Xiao Qiao stays in lane instead of assisting in the jungle.
events.evidence: Visible: Jungler is in mid; blue buff is up. Audio: Coach suggests assisting jungler.
events.recommended_action: Rotate to assist jungler with buffs when lane is cleared by others.

events.coach_claim: Roaming without vision is risky; in higher ranks (1,800+), this would lead to an immediate death.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao roams to the bottom lane through the river without any vision of the enemy jungler.
events.evidence: Visible: Xiao Qiao enters river bushes blindly.
events.recommended_action: Use skills to check bushes or wait for support to lead.

events.coach_claim: Player failed to help Charlotte push the lane after a kill, leaving the wave in a bad spot.
events.gameplay_event: After killing Yuan Ge, Xiao Qiao leaves the lane instead of helping a low-HP Charlotte push the minions into the tower.
events.evidence: Visible: Minion wave is stuck outside enemy tower.
events.recommended_action: Assist teammates in crashing waves after successful ganks.

events.coach_claim: "Game consciousness is like a baby brick"; player makes irrational decisions under pressure.
events.gameplay_event: Player cancels a teleport to "save" Charlotte (who dies anyway), then walks into six enemy minions and dies.
events.evidence: Visible: Teleport cancel followed by death to minions.
events.recommended_action: Commit to rotations or farm safely; do not chase lost causes.

events.coach_claim: Roaming to support is useless if all skills are missed.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao roams to a fight but misses both Skill 2 and Skill 1 on visible targets.
events.evidence: Visible: Skill indicators miss enemy heroes completely.
events.recommended_action: Practice skill shot leading and timing.

events.coach_claim: Roaming to the top lane after the shooter is already dead is "invalid support."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao roams top far too late, losing river vision and gaining nothing from the rotation.
events.evidence: Visible: Top laner dies before Xiao Qiao arrives.
events.recommended_action: Monitor map more closely to determine if a rotation is still viable.

events.coach_claim: Diving without skills or a plan is fatal.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao misses all skills in a counter-lane roam, then flashes under the enemy tower and dies.
events.evidence: Visible: Flash into tower range with no kill potential.
events.recommended_action: Do not dive without a significant health advantage or skill availability.

events.coach_claim: Player is "farming damage taken" rather than contributing to the fight.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao uses her Ultimate to dive into the enemy defense tower during a chaotic skirmish.
events.evidence: Visible: Xiao Qiao takes massive tower damage for no gain.
events.recommended_action: Stay at the edge of fights; use range to poke rather than diving.

events.coach_claim: Choosing to steal a buff with low HP instead of recalling is high-risk, low-reward.
events.gameplay_event: With sliver of health, Xiao Qiao invades the enemy blue buff, luckily kills Dong Huang, and escapes via Da Qiao's portal.
events.evidence: Visible: Low HP bar during invade.
events.recommended_action: Recall when low to reset and maintain map presence.

events.coach_claim: Entering the jungle alone without Flash is a death sentence.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao walks into the enemy red zone alone with no escape tools available and is immediately killed.
events.evidence: Visible: Death in enemy jungle.
events.recommended_action: Avoid deep invades without teammates or defensive spells.

events.coach_claim: Player ignores helpful itemization advice from teammates.
events.gameplay_event: Miyamoto suggests building resistance or armor shoes; player claims no money, then buys magic pen shoes instead.
events.evidence: Visible: Shop menu and chat log.
events.recommended_action: Listen to veteran teammates regarding survivability items.

events.coach_claim: Dying to minions while at low health shows a lack of basic awareness.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao attempts to clear a wave while at critical HP and is killed by the enemy minions.
events.evidence: Visible: Minion last-hit kills Xiao Qiao.
events.recommended_action: Respect minion damage when at low health; recall immediately.

events.coach_claim: "Never died so many times in 20 years."
events.gameplay_event: The game ends in defeat with Xiao Qiao dying once more as the crystal explodes.
events.evidence: Visible: "Defeat" screen with 5-14-6 KDA.
events.recommended_action: Review replays to identify recurring positioning errors.

events.coach_claim: Angela has a stronger level 1 clear than Shangguan Wan'er and should secure lane priority.
events.gameplay_event: Angela clears the first minion wave.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela uses S1 twice to clear minions quickly.
events.recommended_action: Aggressively clear the first wave to enable early roams.

events.coach_claim: Using S1 too early during a buff steal removes the "execute" potential, losing the secure.
events.gameplay_event: Angela attempts to steal the enemy blue buff but fails.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach notes lack of "kill line" (execute damage) because S1 was on cooldown.
events.recommended_action: Save high-damage skills for the final hit to secure objectives.

events.coach_claim: Pay attention to enemy movements; Wan'er is visibly roaming downwards.
events.gameplay_event: Wan'er moves toward the bottom lane.
events.evidence: Visual: Wan'er is seen on the minimap/screen moving to the river.
events.recommended_action: Ping missing enemies and warn side lanes immediately.

events.coach_claim: Ambushing an enemy jungler alone without an Ultimate is a high-risk, low-reward play.
events.gameplay_event: Angela tries to burst the enemy jungler in a bush but fails and flashes away.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela lacks her Level 4 Ultimate during the engage.
events.recommended_action: Only attempt solo ambushes when the full burst combo (including Ult) is available.

events.coach_claim: Do not attempt to save teammates who are already caught in a hopeless situation.
events.gameplay_event: Angela lingers to help a dying Yao, putting herself at risk.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach states this mindset is wrong; "decisively sell" teammates if they can't be saved.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize self-preservation and wave defense over doomed rescue missions.

events.coach_claim: The landing point of the teleportation portal must be safe; landing on enemies is fatal.
events.gameplay_event: Angela uses the portal and lands directly in front of Baili Xuance.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela teleports into enemy range and is immediately killed.
events.recommended_action: Aim portal exits toward safe zones or under friendly towers.

events.coach_claim: Lack of reaction to enemies passing directly in front of you indicates poor focus.
events.gameplay_event: Baili Xuance walks past Angela right after she respawns; she fails to react.
events.evidence: Visual: Xuance is clearly visible on screen near the mid lane.
events.recommended_action: Maintain constant map and screen awareness, especially after respawning.

events.coach_claim: When at critical HP with no healing resources, recall immediately instead of lingering.
events.gameplay_event: Angela stays in the river at 10% HP trying to find a fight.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela has no blood bags or lifesteal items but stays in the field.
events.recommended_action: Return to base immediately when low on HP to avoid giving away free kills.

events.coach_claim: Attempting an ambush after being spotted by enemy vision is a "suicide" play.
events.gameplay_event: Angela enters a bush that was likely warded or seen, then gets hooked and dies.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach notes she "missed her vision" (was revealed).
events.recommended_action: If you suspect you've been seen, abandon the ambush and reposition.

events.coach_claim: Mages should not stand at the very front of a teamfight; positioning is too aggressive.
events.gameplay_event: Angela stands ahead of her frontliners during a river engagement.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela is positioned between the enemy and her own tanks.
events.recommended_action: Stay behind the frontline and use the maximum range of skills to deal damage.

events.coach_claim: Do not waste high-cooldown Ultimates on waves that teammates can easily clear.
events.gameplay_event: Angela uses her Ult to clear a single mid wave while defending high ground.
events.evidence: Visual: Teammates were already present to clear the minions.
events.recommended_action: Save the Ultimate for teamfights or emergency wave clears when alone.

events.coach_claim: Acting as the frontline as a squishy mage leads to instant defeat in the final base defense.
events.gameplay_event: Angela stands at the very front of the base defense and is deleted.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela is the first to die, leading to the "Defeat" screen.
events.recommended_action: In base defense, stay behind the crystal/towers and poke from safety.

events.coach_claim: Use information about the enemy jungler's absence to play more aggressively.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao notices the enemy jungler isn't in the blue zone.
events.evidence: Audio: "Blue zone has no enemy jungler... 100% red start."
events.recommended_action: Track jungler starts to dictate early lane pressure.

events.coach_claim: Pressure the enemy mid-laner (Chang'e) when minions are low, especially with support help.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao moves forward to zone Chang'e from the front-line minions.
events.evidence: Visual: Xiao Qiao standing near enemy minions to poke.
events.recommended_action: Use minion health as a bait to force trades.

events.coach_claim: Critiques a failed mechanical execution of the 2-Skill + Flash combo.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao attempts a 2-Flash combo but misses the target.
events.evidence: Audio: "You also show me a 2-Flash... judged as Pokémon (insult)."
events.recommended_action: Practice the timing of skill-buffering with Flash in training mode.

events.coach_claim: Prioritize side-lane resource control after clearing mid if a 2v1 push is stalled.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao rotates to the side lane to contest a red armor minion.
events.evidence: Visual: Xiao Qiao moving to the river/side lane after clearing wave.
events.recommended_action: Rotate to neutral resources when mid-lane pressure is capped.

events.coach_claim: Praise for predicting and intercepting the enemy mid-laner's rotation path.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao waits in the river bush to ambush Chang'e returning to lane.
events.evidence: Audio: "Stuck the position of the opposite Chang'e loop."
events.recommended_action: Use river bushes to cut off enemy rotations instead of just following them.

events.coach_claim: Recover lost lane economy by taking jungle camps if a wave is missed.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao farms small jungle creeps after losing a minion wave.
events.evidence: Audio: "Missed a minion, must make it up... brush the wild Ono."
events.recommended_action: Supplement lane income with jungle camps during downtime.

events.coach_claim: Maintain vision control in the river when side-lane teammates are weak.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao clears the wave and immediately checks river vision.
events.evidence: Audio: "Control the walnut (river) vision every time."
events.recommended_action: Don't just farm; use the time between waves to secure vision for the team.

events.coach_claim: Critiques failing to secure a kill on a low-health target due to poor skill follow-up.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao hits a combo but fails to kill Chang'e, then misses a 2-skill.
events.evidence: Visual: Chang'e escapes with sliver of health; Xiao Qiao misses follow-up.
events.recommended_action: Calmly aim follow-up skills rather than panic-casting on low-health targets.

events.coach_claim: Decisively abandon a mid-wave to punish overextended enemies in side lanes.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao ignores the mid-wave to wrap around and kill the enemy marksman.
events.evidence: Audio: "Mid line... must be decisively let go... wrap up opposite combination."
events.recommended_action: Recognize when a kill/objective in a side lane is worth more than one mid-wave.

events.coach_claim: Praise for high efficiency in farming while maintaining map presence.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao reaches a high gold lead through continuous rotation and farming.
events.evidence: Audio: "Xiao Qiao's economic ability is still very good... 90 points."
events.recommended_action: Maintain a high farm-per-minute (GPM) to reach power spikes early.

events.coach_claim: Mentality check: Give up lost towers to avoid unnecessary deaths when outnumbered.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao retreats and lets a tower fall instead of defending 1v3.
events.evidence: Audio: "Put away the tower that should be put away... don't get knocked out again."
events.recommended_action: Avoid "hero plays" when defending a lost objective; stay alive for the next fight.

events.coach_claim: Use "hidden vision" to set up ambushes in high-traffic jungle areas.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao hides in a bush near the blue buff to catch the enemy jungler.
events.evidence: Visual: Xiao Qiao waiting in fog of war for the enemy to face-check.
events.recommended_action: Predict enemy farm paths and wait in fog to initiate.

events.coach_claim: Praise for resource management: Giving farm to teammates who need to catch up.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao leaves a top-lane wave for the struggling Sun Quan.
events.evidence: Audio: "Directly give up the route to Sun Quan... he needs to develop."
events.recommended_action: Share resources with behind teammates once you have reached your core items.

events.coach_claim: Critiques a "bad trade": Trading your life for an enemy when you are the team's carry.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao flashes in to kill a low-health Chang'e but dies in the process.
events.evidence: Audio: "You are the highest level... cannot be dropping... trade definitely not worth."
events.recommended_action: As the primary carry, your survival is more important than a 1-for-1 trade.

events.coach_claim: Game-losing mistake: Attempting a solo ambush against four enemies while the jungler is dead.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao tries to bush-camp 4 enemies in the river, dies, and the game ends.
events.evidence: Visual: Xiao Qiao 1v4 in river; Audio: "One person squats to four people... then you find you can't beat it."
events.recommended_action: Play defensively and wait for teammates to respawn rather than taking high-risk solo fights.

events.coach_claim: Player shows good basic skills by checking hero attributes and the scoreboard early.
events.gameplay_event: Jungler checks the scoreboard and hero stats while moving to the first buff.
events.evidence: Visual: Screen flickers to the scoreboard and attribute panels.
events.recommended_action: Maintain this habit to track enemy items and power spikes.

events.coach_claim: Jungler is "rubbing" (sharing) the mid-lane wave unnecessarily instead of clearing his own jungle.
events.gameplay_event: Jungler helps Xi Shi clear the mid wave at level 2, then lingers.
events.evidence: Audio: "What kind of behavior is it?" Visual: Jungler shares gold/XP with mid.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize individual jungle clear to reach Level 4 faster.

events.coach_claim: By 1:25, the red buff is still not cleared, which is inefficient for a jungler.
events.gameplay_event: Jungler is still level 3 and hasn't touched his red buff while side lanes are pressured.
events.evidence: Visual: Red buff icon is visible on the mini-map; timer shows 1:25.
events.recommended_action: Optimize pathing to ensure buffs are taken immediately upon spawn.

events.coach_claim: Jungler's constant presence in mid reveals his position, allowing the enemy to gank side lanes safely.
events.gameplay_event: Jungler stays in mid-lane vision; enemy Zhuge Liang ganks the bottom lane (Mad Iron).
events.evidence: Audio: "In the other person's perspective... you are still in the middle."
events.recommended_action: Stay in the "fog of war" to maintain pressure on all lanes.

events.coach_claim: Jungler is following a "formulaic" playstyle that doesn't account for the current rank's skill level.
events.gameplay_event: Jungler continues to prioritize mid waves over jungle camps or counter-ganking.
events.evidence: Audio: "This is a typical formulaic play."
events.recommended_action: Adapt strategy based on teammate performance and lane pressure.

events.coach_claim: Jungler is Level 4 while the enemy jungler (Zhuge Liang) is nearly Level 8 due to better farm.
events.gameplay_event: Scoreboard shows a massive level and gold gap between the two junglers.
events.evidence: Visual: Level 4 Yun Zhong Jun vs Level 7/8 Zhuge Liang.
events.recommended_action: Stop sharing waves when behind; focus on catching up in levels through jungle.

events.coach_claim: Jungler fails to signal teammates to help defend his jungle when it's being invaded.
events.gameplay_event: Enemy invades the red zone; Jungler doesn't ping for assistance from Xi Shi.
events.evidence: Audio: "I didn't see your signal." Visual: No pings on the mini-map.
events.recommended_action: Use the ping system to coordinate defense during invades.

events.coach_claim: Jungler blames the "confrontation road" (Mad Iron) despite the jungler's own poor macro.
events.gameplay_event: Jungler types/complains about teammates while he is under-leveled and ineffective.
events.evidence: Audio: "You're blaming your teammates?" Visual: Mad Iron is 0/1/0 but pressured.
events.recommended_action: Focus on self-improvement and pathing rather than teammate mistakes.

events.coach_claim: Opening the Tyrant while the red jungle is full of monsters is a poor conversion choice.
events.gameplay_event: Jungler starts the Tyrant while his own jungle camps are up and he is behind.
events.evidence: Visual: Jungler attacks Tyrant; red zone camps are visible on mini-map.
events.recommended_action: Clear jungle camps to secure a gold lead before contesting major objectives.

events.coach_claim: Jungler's "addiction" to rubbing mid waves leads to a team wipe.
events.gameplay_event: Jungler returns to mid to share a wave, gets caught, and the team loses the fight.
events.evidence: Audio: "You really are a thread-rubbing freak." Visual: Jungler dies in mid-lane.
events.recommended_action: Only share waves if it helps secure a tower or if the laner is absent.

events.coach_claim: The game "turned around" due to enemy mistakes and Xi Shi's play, not the jungler's "adjustment."
events.gameplay_event: Enemy Zhuge Liang throws his lead; Xi Shi makes several key plays/kills.
events.evidence: Audio: "It's the rhythm of the opposite delivery." Visual: Xi Shi gets double kills.
events.recommended_action: Acknowledge teammate contributions and recognize when a win is a "carry."

events.coach_claim: Final Verdict: Jungler is "sentenced" to a week without jungling for poor macro and blaming others.
events.gameplay_event: Coach summarizes the jungler's failures in pathing and resource management.
events.evidence: Audio: "Stripped of jungling rights for a week."
events.recommended_action: Study high-level jungle pathing and prioritize map presence over mid-lane gold.

events.coach_claim: Level 1 priority should be providing vision for the jungler in the opposite jungle quadrant.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi goes straight to the mid-lane wave at the start of the match.
events.evidence: Audio: "help the jungle see the vision of another wild area."
events.recommended_action: Move to the river or jungle entrance early to scout for enemy invades.

events.coach_claim: Xishi lacks awareness of the enemy jungler's high mobility and buff-stealing potential.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi uses Skill 2 on the wave immediately without checking surroundings.
events.evidence: Audio: Mentions enemy jungler's mobility and ability to steal buffs.
events.recommended_action: Play cautiously early and track the enemy jungler's likely start to prevent steals.

events.coach_claim: Poor positioning leads to taking unnecessary splash damage from minions and enemy passives.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi stands inside the minion wave and takes significant poke from Diaochan.
events.evidence: Video: Xishi's health drops to critical levels while clearing the first wave.
events.recommended_action: Stand outside the minion wave to avoid splash damage from Diaochan's passive.

events.coach_claim: Attempting to force an engagement with Flash but without an Ultimate is ineffective.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi flashes forward for a pick but lacks the CC duration to secure it.
events.evidence: Audio: "You have no big idea... one paragraph is not enough."
events.recommended_action: Save Flash for guaranteed kills or when the Ultimate is available for a double pull.

events.coach_claim: Do not waste core CC skills on guaranteed objectives; keep them to maintain lane initiative.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi uses Skill 1 to help secure a red buff that was already safe.
events.evidence: Audio: "Initiative is always yours [if you keep the skill]."
events.recommended_action: Hold Skill 1 for enemy heroes to maintain pressure and threat.

events.coach_claim: Respawning and rotating to the wrong area despite having information on the map.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi moves to the bottom lane while the team needs help elsewhere.
events.evidence: Audio: "You do it the other way around... no information collected."
events.recommended_action: Check the mini-map and teammate pings immediately upon respawning to identify the priority lane.

events.coach_claim: Prioritize clearing available minion waves to maintain gold and XP, especially with an AP build.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi wanders in the jungle while a mid-lane wave is left uncollected.
events.evidence: Audio: "Why don't you eat the line of arms? What are you thinking?"
events.recommended_action: Ensure waves are cleared before rotating to maximize resource gain.

events.coach_claim: Failure to track enemy summoner skill cooldowns leads to wasted engagement attempts.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi engages Diaochan, who immediately uses Purify to escape.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach calculates the exact timing (7:20) for the next Purify.
events.recommended_action: Note the timestamp when enemies use major spells to time the next successful engage.

events.coach_claim: Using core defensive skills for wave clear leaves the hero vulnerable to being rushed.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi uses Skill 1 on minions and is immediately pressured by Hou Yi.
events.evidence: Audio: "You've lost a skill... the opposite side is rushing casually."
events.recommended_action: Use Skill 2 for wave clear; save Skill 1 for self-defense or catching out-of-position enemies.

events.coach_claim: Carries must maintain spacing to avoid being hit by the same crowd control ability.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi and the ADC stand together and are both hit by Hou Yi's Ultimate.
events.evidence: Audio: "Double C cannot stand together."
events.recommended_action: Maintain a distance from other high-priority teammates to prevent multi-man CC hits.

events.coach_claim: Identify the win condition: late game Xishi should peel for the fed ADC rather than initiating.
events.gameplay_event: Xishi attempts to flash-initiate instead of staying back to protect the shooter.
events.evidence: Audio: "Keep the shooter... don't need to play a big role."
events.recommended_action: Adjust playstyle from "initiator" to "peeler" based on which teammate is the primary damage source.

events.coach_claim: "You don't take Guan Yu seriously at all in this position."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao stands in the mid-lane river bush at level 1.
events.evidence: Guan Yu is on the enemy team; Xiao Qiao is vulnerable to a level 1 roam.
events.recommended_action: Respect Guan Yu's potential level 1 roam and position more safely.

events.coach_claim: "The risk of returning [invading] is too great."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao invades the enemy blue buff area and is intercepted by Guan Yu.
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao dies to Guan Yu and the enemy jungler.
events.recommended_action: Use lane priority to secure neutral resources or vision rather than high-risk invades.

events.coach_claim: "The economy has fallen behind... missed a front row soldier."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao misses minion gold/XP due to the previous death.
events.evidence: Minions die to the tower while the player is respawning.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize lane farm to maintain economic parity.

events.coach_claim: "Ineffective support... Daji easily returns to the middle road."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao abandons mid-lane to chase Daji, missing another wave.
events.evidence: Daji escapes safely; Xiao Qiao loses a front-row minion.
events.recommended_action: Stay in mid-lane to pressure the enemy's return path and secure the wave.

events.coach_claim: "Run up to... supplement output, controlled by Daji's reflection."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao moves into Daji's range after a combo and gets CC'd.
events.evidence: Daji uses CC and the enemy jungler follows up for a kill.
events.recommended_action: Retreat immediately after casting spells to maintain a safe distance.

events.coach_claim: "You're not a big deal, why are you here on the red back?"
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao lingers near the enemy red buff without Flash or Ultimate available.
events.evidence: Player is forced to burn Flash to survive an ambush.
events.recommended_action: Stay in a safe, defended position when high-cooldown survival tools are down.

events.coach_claim: "Xiao Qiao's only weakness is... afraid of [getting flanked]."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao pushes forward without knowing Guan Yu's location.
events.evidence: Guan Yu flanks from the fog of war and kills Xiao Qiao.
events.recommended_action: Wait for the primary enemy threat (Guan Yu) to show on the map before advancing.

events.coach_claim: "No suspense... second point again."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao is caught by Di Renjie's ultimate during a base defense.
events.evidence: Di Renjie hits Xiao Qiao with a yellow card (ult), leading to death.
events.recommended_action: Maintain maximum range and stay behind the frontline during high-ground defense.

events.coach_claim: The "Card 3-1" technique at level 1 is perfect for early pressure.
events.gameplay_event: Haiyue pre-casts skills to hit Xiao Qiao immediately upon laning.
events.evidence: Visible skill cooldowns and successful poke on enemy mage.
events.recommended_action: Continue utilizing pre-casting to secure early lane priority.

events.coach_claim: Don't be greedy for small jungle creeps and lose health.
events.gameplay_event: Haiyue attempts to steal a small monster and gets poked by the enemy.
events.evidence: Haiyue's HP drops significantly for a minor gold gain.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize health maintenance over low-value enemy jungle steals.

events.coach_claim: Prioritizing neutral monsters over mid-lane vision and waves is a mistake.
events.gameplay_event: Haiyue rotates for "Red Armor" and misses a full mid-lane wave.
events.evidence: Haiyue is top while minions die in the mid lane; mid bush vision is lost.
events.recommended_action: Hold mid-lane bush vision to secure waves and track enemy rotations.

events.coach_claim: Teleport arrays don't work if the Space Spirit isn't killed first.
events.gameplay_event: Haiyue stands on the teleport circle, but nothing happens.
events.evidence: The teleport animation fails to trigger; the Space Spirit is still alive.
events.recommended_action: Confirm objective requirements are met before attempting map-wide rotations.

events.coach_claim: Greed leads to unnecessary deaths under the enemy tower.
events.gameplay_event: Haiyue flashes under the tower to chase a low-HP Xiao Qiao and dies.
events.evidence: Haiyue takes multiple tower shots and is executed.
events.recommended_action: Avoid high-risk tower dives; prioritize staying alive to maintain pressure.

events.coach_claim: Hiding vision significantly increases the success rate of the ultimate.
events.gameplay_event: Haiyue waits in a bush and successfully pulls the enemy mage into her realm.
events.evidence: Haiyue is invisible to the enemy until the ultimate is cast.
events.recommended_action: Use the fog of war and bushes to catch enemies off-guard.

events.coach_claim: Jungle invade priority is higher than aimless side-lane roaming.
events.gameplay_event: Haiyue roams top while the jungler is invading the enemy blue buff alone.
events.evidence: Map shows a 2v1 opportunity in the jungle that Haiyue ignores.
events.recommended_action: Assist junglers in invades to secure buffs and disrupt enemy economy.

events.coach_claim: The essence of the ultimate is kiting, not standing still.
events.gameplay_event: Haiyue pulls a target into her ultimate but fails to dodge and dies.
events.evidence: Haiyue takes full damage from the trapped target inside the realm.
events.recommended_action: Use the increased mobility/range in the ultimate to kite the opponent.

events.coach_claim: Clear side waves instead of wandering in front of enemy towers.
events.gameplay_event: Haiyue wanders near the enemy tower and gets caught by Xiang Yu.
events.evidence: Haiyue is killed while side-lane minions are left uncollected.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize clearing side waves to maintain gold lead and map pressure.

events.coach_claim: Playing without an ultimate is like playing a different, weaker hero.
events.gameplay_event: Haiyue engages aggressively while her ultimate is on cooldown and dies.
events.evidence: Haiyue has no self-protection tools available when Nezha engages.
events.recommended_action: Play defensively and focus on safe wave clear when the ultimate is down.

events.coach_claim: "Why go against a Ying Zheng [with basic attacks]?"
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao uses Skill 1 then stays to basic attack Ying Zheng, losing the trade.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach questions the trade. Visual: Xiao Qiao takes unnecessary damage from Ying Zheng's superior basic attacks.
events.recommended_action: Use Skill 1 for poke and immediately retreat to avoid counter-poke.

events.coach_claim: "Your damage calculation ability is comparable to an adult brick."
events.gameplay_event: Failed Flash-Skill combo on low-HP Ying Zheng; Xiao Qiao dies to minion aggro.
events.evidence: Visual: Xiao Qiao Flashes in but fails the kill and dies to tower/minions.
events.recommended_action: Account for minion damage and enemy defensive options before committing Flash.

events.coach_claim: "A small bridge [Xiao Qiao] without Flash treats the river as their home."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao roams through the river without Flash and gets caught by the enemy jungler.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach mocks the lack of safety awareness. Visual: Xiao Qiao is isolated in the river and dies.
events.recommended_action: Avoid deep river roams when Flash is on cooldown, especially without vision of the enemy jungler.

events.coach_claim: "It is still a Flash to pull the grave... maximum loss."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao walks into Su Lie's range, gets CC'd, and wastes Flash right before dying.
events.evidence: Visual: Su Lie hits a 3-hit CC chain; Xiao Qiao Flashes too late to escape death.
events.recommended_action: Use Flash earlier to avoid the initial CC or hold it if death is certain to save the cooldown.

events.coach_claim: "You Flash and run to the [enemy] Red zone... no difference between letting it go and not."
events.gameplay_event: During a skirmish, Xiao Qiao Flashes deeper into the enemy jungle instead of toward safety.
events.evidence: Visual: Xiao Qiao dies at the enemy Red buff after a panicked Flash.
events.recommended_action: Practice directional Flashing under pressure to ensure escape toward towers or allies.

events.coach_claim: "You are really brave... saved by Shao Siyuan's limit big move."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao attempts to flank the enemy shooter alone and is nearly burst down.
events.evidence: Visual: Shao Siyuan uses her Ultimate to keep Xiao Qiao alive during a reckless flank.
events.recommended_action: Only attempt solo flanks if you have a significant gold lead or the enemy's key CC is down.

events.coach_claim: "Flash hit the wall... if you crossed, you'd be melted."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao fails a Flash over a wall during a teamfight, then walks back in and dies.
events.evidence: Visual: The Flash fails to clear the terrain; Xiao Qiao re-engages with low HP and dies.
events.recommended_action: Practice terrain-crossing Flashes in training mode; prioritize survival over re-engaging with no HP.

events.coach_claim: "Why do you keep walking towards the opposite face? ... Flash and Golden Body not released."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao walks into the frontline during a high-ground defense and dies with active items available.
events.evidence: Visual: Xiao Qiao dies in the middle of the enemy team; UI shows Flash and Golden Body were ready.
events.recommended_action: Stay at maximum ability range; use Golden Body (Zhonya-effect) to bait enemy ultimates.

events.coach_claim: "No Flash, no big move... what have you been doing here?"
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao lingers near Lanling Wang without cooldowns and gets picked off.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach criticizes "waving" (loitering) without resources. Visual: Xiao Qiao is caught and killed instantly.
events.recommended_action: Retreat to a safe position or farm when Ultimate and Flash are both on cooldown.

events.coach_claim: "Skill weight but no damage... hit 3 for 1."
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao lands abilities but lacks the burst to kill, resulting in a 3-for-1 trade favoring the enemy.
events.evidence: Visual: Xiao Qiao's full combo fails to secure a kill before she is eliminated.
events.recommended_action: Coordinate focus-fire with the jungler (Xuan Ce) rather than dumping all spells on tanks.

events.coach_claim: Standing with minions makes you an easy target for poke.
events.gameplay_event: Nuwa hit by Daji's S1 twice while clearing the first wave.
events.evidence: Nuwa stands directly inside the minion wave; Daji hits both.
events.recommended_action: Stand away from minions to force the enemy to choose between poking or clearing.

events.coach_claim: Nuwa must learn to save her blocks (Skill 2).
events.gameplay_event: Nuwa uses all available blocks for no reason.
events.evidence: Skill 2 charges are depleted without an engagement or wave-clear need.
events.recommended_action: Always keep at least two blocks in reserve for self-defense or combos.

events.coach_claim: Do not contest river vision without skills available.
events.gameplay_event: Nuwa walks into river after using skills and gets chunked to half HP by Daji.
events.evidence: Nuwa enters the brush with no skills ready; Daji is waiting.
events.recommended_action: Stay under tower or in safe zones when skills are on cooldown.

events.coach_claim: Return to mid-lane immediately after a rotation to preserve economy.
events.gameplay_event: Nuwa stays in top lane to poke after a gank, losing mid-lane gold.
events.evidence: Two mid-lane minions die to the tower while Nuwa is top.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize mid-lane wave cycles over unnecessary pokes in side lanes.

events.coach_claim: Do not use S3 to dive low-HP enemies without sufficient resources.
events.gameplay_event: Nuwa S3s onto a low-HP Daji, has only one block, and gets counter-burst killed.
events.evidence: Nuwa lands S3, fails to secure kill, and dies to Daji's full combo.
events.recommended_action: Only use S3 for aggressive plays if you have the skills/HP to survive the counter.

events.coach_claim: Repeatedly feeding the same enemy due to "tunnel vision" on low HP.
events.gameplay_event: Nuwa S3s into the bottom lane, gets CC'd by Di Renjie, and dies again.
events.evidence: Nuwa lands in the middle of three enemies; dies to CC chain.
events.recommended_action: Check enemy CC and positioning before committing to a global teleport.

events.coach_claim: Poor map awareness leads to getting picked off in the jungle.
events.gameplay_event: Nuwa wanders into the jungle while behind and gets killed by the enemy jungler.
events.evidence: Nuwa is caught alone in the river/jungle area without vision.
events.recommended_action: Stick to high-ground defense and safe rotations when significantly behind.

events.coach_claim: Pinging enemy economy is useless when you are the source of their lead.
events.gameplay_event: Nuwa pings Daji's high gold lead while sitting in base.
events.evidence: Scoreboard shows Daji is fed; Nuwa's KDA is 1-8.
events.recommended_action: Focus on personal positioning errors rather than teammate or enemy gold.

events.coach_claim: Failure to utilize Nuwa's range advantage during high-ground defense.
events.gameplay_event: Nuwa gets caught by Crazy Iron's flash-engage at the high ground.
events.evidence: Nuwa stands too close to the edge of the high ground; gets initiated on.
events.recommended_action: Maximize Nuwa's long-range poke; never stand within flash-engage distance.

events.coach_claim: Tai Yi's missed skill and Xi Shi's lack of direction led to an early death.
events.gameplay_event: Early mid-lane skirmish; Xi Shi gets lost and dies to Guan Yu.
events.evidence: Visual: Tai Yi misses S1; Xi Shi flashes into Guan Yu's face.
events.recommended_action: Coordinate CC with support; maintain better spatial awareness of enemy flankers.

events.coach_claim: Without flash or line priority against Wu Zetian, stay under the tower.
events.gameplay_event: Xi Shi laning against Wu Zetian; Nezha rotates to help.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach advises hiding under tower. Visual: Xi Shi stays safe while waiting for rotation.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize survival over poke when vulnerable to ganks.

events.coach_claim: Avoid walking through the river without line priority or vision.
events.gameplay_event: Xi Shi rotates to bot lane through the river and is nearly caught.
events.evidence: Visual: Xi Shi face-checks river brush without vision.
events.recommended_action: Use safer rotation paths through the jungle when the enemy has mid-lane control.

events.coach_claim: Help the jungler clear buffs to maximize team economy when skills are on cooldown.
events.gameplay_event: Xi Shi helps the jungler clear the blue zone after a bot lane rotation.
events.evidence: Visual: Xi Shi uses skills to speed up jungler's farm.
events.recommended_action: Actively assist jungler in downtime to increase overall team tempo.

events.coach_claim: Capitalize on Wu Zetian's long skill post-cast delays if she lacks flash.
events.gameplay_event: Skirmish near mid; Wu Zetian uses skills, creating a window for engagement.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach notes Wu Zetian's long "back-swing." Visual: Xi Shi considers flashing in.
events.recommended_action: Track enemy flash cooldowns to aggressively punish immobile mages.

events.coach_claim: Use the "fishing" strategy: relax enemy vigilance in the first wave to catch them in the second.
events.gameplay_event: Successful gank on Lanling King after a failed initial attempt.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach explains "fishing" (relaxing vigilance). Visual: Lanling King is caught out.
events.recommended_action: Bait enemy confidence by showing presence without committing, then strike when they overextend.

events.coach_claim: Do not assume the mid-lane is safe just because it appears empty.
events.gameplay_event: Xi Shi nearly dies to a four-man ambush in mid-lane; uses flash to escape.
events.evidence: Visual: Enemy team (Yu Ji, Wu Zetian, Wukong, Dun Shan) appears simultaneously.
events.recommended_action: Treat "missing" enemies as a threat; wait for vision before stepping past the river line.

events.coach_claim: Use skills to zone enemies and force them away from towers during a siege.
events.gameplay_event: Mid-lane tower push; Xi Shi uses S1 to pressure enemy positioning.
events.evidence: Visual: Xi Shi uses S1 to force enemies back, allowing teammates to hit the tower.
events.recommended_action: Focus on zoning and area denial during sieges rather than just fish-hooking.

events.coach_claim: Teamfights are lost when the primary damage dealer (shooter) fails to follow up.
events.gameplay_event: Dragon fight fails; Tai Yi zones but the shooter doesn't move to take the objective.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach criticizes shooter's lack of movement. Visual: Tai Yi is isolated and killed.
events.recommended_action: Ping objectives clearly; if the carry doesn't follow, retreat rather than committing to a lost cause.

events.coach_claim: Aggressive flash-pulls can turn a defensive situation into an advantage.
events.gameplay_event: Red buff defense; Xi Shi flashes to pull Lanling King.
events.evidence: Visual: Flash-S1 combo on Lanling King; subsequent death to Wu Zetian/Dun Shan CC chain.
events.recommended_action: Ensure follow-up damage is available before committing flash for a pick.

events.coach_claim: Precise two-stage pulls are essential for securing kills on mobile heroes.
events.gameplay_event: Late-game high ground defense; Xi Shi pulls Guan Yu twice.
events.evidence: Visual: Xi Shi successfully executes the two-stage S1 pull on Guan Yu.
events.recommended_action: Practice the timing of the second pull to maximize displacement duration.

events.coach_claim: High gold lead (12k at 15m) is wasted if waves aren't pushed.
events.gameplay_event: Xuance takes Overlord but ignores the bot wave and mid tower.
events.evidence: Audio: "15 minutes, 12,000 gold... teammates are muggles." Visual: Scoreboard showing Xuance's gold lead.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize clearing side waves and pushing mid tower after taking major objectives.

events.coach_claim: Xuance is "inexplicably" wandering instead of dismantling towers.
events.gameplay_event: Xuance hooks a bush near the river while the bot wave is pushed in.
events.evidence: Audio: "Can't you just dismantle it? Or disconnect the wave in advance?"
events.recommended_action: Use the gold lead to force tower sieges or cut waves behind enemy lines.

events.coach_claim: Xuance's long-range hook (2nd skill) should be used for tower pressure.
events.gameplay_event: Teamfight near mid tower; Xuance pulls an enemy but the tower remains standing.
events.evidence: Audio: "Xuance's hand speed is very long, you can click the tower button."
events.recommended_action: Focus on basic attacking towers during the displacement of enemies.

events.coach_claim: At 9 minutes, an 8k vs 5k gold lead should result in a "one-dozen" stomp.
events.gameplay_event: Xuance clears top wave while two enemies are visible mid.
events.evidence: Audio: "You 8,000, others 5,000... find a group, one dozen."
events.recommended_action: Group with the team to force a 5v5 while the gold disparity is at its peak.

events.coach_claim: Do not hook the Overlord (Master) if the team cannot follow up.
events.gameplay_event: Xuance attempts to hook the Overlord while low on health/mana.
events.evidence: Audio: "Please don't tick this... you are like a fool."
events.recommended_action: Reset and wait for teammates before engaging major neutral objectives.

events.coach_claim: "European/American" playstyle involves stealing jungle based on lane priority.
events.gameplay_event: Xuance invades the enemy blue buff at Level 1.
events.evidence: Audio: "Xuance out of the gate to study medicine and steal wild."
events.recommended_action: Invade only when the opposing laner is forced to clear under their tower.

events.coach_claim: Vision control is lost because the support (Cat) is forced to defend.
events.gameplay_event: Xuance squats in a mid-bush while the enemy Miyamoto clears red.
events.evidence: Audio: "I have no one to do anything... Cat come and guard the basket."
events.recommended_action: Coordinate with the support to deep-ward the enemy jungle rather than passive squatting.

events.coach_claim: Logic dictates an immediate engage when enemies are low in their own jungle.
events.gameplay_event: Xuance hesitates to use his 1st skill to dash and hook Miyamoto.
events.evidence: Audio: "You should stand up... 1st skill should immediately rush through."
events.recommended_action: Use mobility skills proactively to close the gap on vulnerable targets.

events.coach_claim: Jungle timers (70s) should dictate the pathing for the next invade.
events.gameplay_event: Xuance invades the blue side at 2:25, knowing the buff was cleared at 1:15.
events.evidence: Audio: "I didn't know which buff Miyamoto hit... I knew later he was at blue."
events.recommended_action: Track the initial clear to predict buff respawns and set up ambushes.

events.coach_claim: High-level play requires "three-finger" screen panning to track enemy health.
events.gameplay_event: Xuance misses a kill on Mad Iron because he didn't see the enemy's HP.
events.evidence: Audio: "This board with five kills... you didn't type it out."
events.recommended_action: Practice panning the camera to targets outside the immediate character view.

events.coach_claim: Daji played aggressively at level 1 due to bringing "Execute," but used it on the wrong target.
events.gameplay_event: Daji fights Mai Shiranui, uses Execute on a stealthed Lanling Wang.
events.evidence: Visual: Execute animation hits Lanling Wang instead of the low-HP Shiranui.
events.recommended_action: Aim summoner spells carefully; prioritize the primary target in lane.

events.coach_claim: Player was completely oblivious to their own low HP and died to a tower dive.
events.gameplay_event: Daji walks into enemy tower range while low and dies to Shiranui's fan.
events.evidence: Audio: "You are completely oblivious to your own blood volume."
events.recommended_action: Monitor self-HP; avoid tower diving when one hit from the enemy will kill you.

events.coach_claim: The player's last-hitting (tail knife) technique is poor, leading to lost gold.
events.gameplay_event: Daji misses several minion last-hits after returning to lane.
events.evidence: Audio: "This tail knife... I'm really going to suffer."
events.recommended_action: Practice last-hitting minions to maximize gold income (50% bonus).

events.coach_claim: Player ignored the enemy jungler's position visible on the mini-map and got caught.
events.gameplay_event: Daji roams through the river without vision and is ambushed by Cao Cao.
events.evidence: Visual: Cao Cao was briefly visible near the bottom lane before the roam.
events.recommended_action: Check the mini-map constantly; avoid high-risk river paths when the jungler is missing.

events.coach_claim: Missing last-hits significantly stunts Daji's economy, which is vital for a burst mage.
events.gameplay_event: Daji uses an ultimate on minions but fails to secure the last-hits.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach explains the 50% extra gold mechanic for last-hits.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize last-hits over fast-clearing with high-cooldown skills if it misses gold.

events.coach_claim: Daji wasted all skills on the Tyrant and arrived at the top lane fight with no impact.
events.gameplay_event: Daji uses full combo on Tyrant, then arrives late to a teamfight.
events.evidence: Visual: Daji skills are on cooldown as she enters the top lane skirmish.
events.recommended_action: Save burst combos for enemy heroes during rotations; prioritize teamfight arrival over neutral camps.

events.coach_claim: Building Echo's Staff was a mistake; the player should have prioritized "Nightmare" for anti-heal.
events.gameplay_event: Daji continues building Echo's Staff despite enemy healing (Cao Cao, Sang Qi).
events.evidence: Visual: Item shop shows Echo's Staff pre-ordered against a high-sustain lineup.
events.recommended_action: Adapt item builds to the enemy team; buy anti-heal early against heavy sustain.

events.coach_claim: Attempting to ambush while significantly behind in economy and damage is futile.
events.gameplay_event: Daji tries to burst Mai Shiranui but is countered and killed instantly.
events.evidence: Visual: Daji's damage is insufficient to kill, leading to her own death.
events.recommended_action: Play defensively when behind; wait for teammates to initiate or for the enemy to overextend.

events.coach_claim: A full-HP Daji was solo-killed by a low-HP Yuan Song due to poor skill execution.
events.gameplay_event: Daji misses her combo/timing and dies to a retreating, low-health Yuan Song.
events.evidence: Visual: Daji's HP bar disappears rapidly despite having the health advantage.
events.recommended_action: Improve skill accuracy and timing; do not underestimate "low" enemies with high outplay potential.

events.coach_claim: Buying the "Nightmare" anti-heal item at the very end of the game was useless.
events.gameplay_event: Daji finally purchases Nightmare as the enemy is pushing the crystal.
events.evidence: Visual: Daji buys the item just seconds before the "Defeat" screen.
events.recommended_action: Identify necessary utility items in the early-to-mid game, not as a last resort.

events.coach_claim: Dian Wei is likely starting Blue buff based on his failed invade attempt and subsequent retreat.
events.gameplay_event: Angela clears the first wave and observes the enemy jungler's movement on the minimap.
events.evidence: Minimap shows Dian Wei retreating from the allied Red buff area.
events.recommended_action: Invade the enemy's small jungle camps (piglets) to delay their level 4.

events.coach_claim: Angela invades the Blue buff area without lane priority, leading to a dangerous chase.
events.gameplay_event: Angela moves deep into the enemy Blue jungle after clearing piglets, getting cornered by Si Kongzhen and Yi Xing.
events.evidence: Angela is seen running through the river while two enemies converge on her.
events.recommended_action: Retreat to mid-lane immediately after taking the piglets if the side lanes lack priority.

events.coach_claim: Using a 2nd skill and Flash just to clear a single minion is "gluttonous" and wasteful.
events.gameplay_event: Angela uses her CC skill and displacement spell to secure one minion kill while retreating.
events.evidence: Angela's Flash goes on cooldown for a low-value minion kill.
events.recommended_action: Save Flash for escaping ganks or securing kills on enemy heroes.

events.coach_claim: Angela is "shopping on Taobao" (browsing the item shop) while a kill opportunity on Yi Xing is right in front of her.
events.gameplay_event: Angela stands still in a bush with the item shop open while Yi Xing passes by within range of a full combo.
