events.evidence: The item shop UI covers the screen while an enemy hero is visible nearby.
events.recommended_action: Pre-order items and only open the shop when in a safe, recalled position.

events.coach_claim: The bot-lane fight was a mistake by the jungler and tank, forcing a 2v3 engagement that Angela couldn't support in time.
events.gameplay_event: Bai Qi and Sima Yi engage a 2v3 at the bot river and die; Angela arrives late and only clears a minion.
events.evidence: Bai Qi and Sima Yi's health bars disappear before Angela reaches the fight.
events.recommended_action: Jungler should prioritize farming over disadvantaged skirmishes when the mid-laner is out of position.

events.coach_claim: Angela completely ignored Golden Cicada entering the bush right in front of her, leading to an easy death.
events.gameplay_event: Golden Cicada walks into a bush near Angela; she walks toward him, gets CC'd, and dies without using her Ult or Flash effectively.
events.evidence: Golden Cicada is visible on screen entering the bush before Angela approaches.
events.recommended_action: Use skills to check bushes before face-checking, especially against high-CC mages.

events.coach_claim: The player lacks "three-finger" camera control, leading to blind skill shots and another death.
events.gameplay_event: Angela attempts to fight in the Blue jungle but misses her skills and gets caught out.
events.evidence: Angela's camera remains centered on herself, failing to track enemy movement off-center.
events.recommended_action: Practice using a third finger to pan the camera to improve skill-shot accuracy.

events.coach_claim: Angela wanders into the bottom river alone despite three enemies being visible mid, resulting in a predictable death.
events.gameplay_event: Angela clears piglets with her Ult but then walks down the river alone and gets picked off.
events.evidence: Angela is isolated on the minimap while the enemy team collapses on her.
events.recommended_action: Move toward the top half of the map to stay near teammates and maintain safety.

events.coach_claim: The team loses the river vision and the mid tower because Angela and Bai Qi are caught out of position.
events.gameplay_event: Bai Qi misses an engage; Angela is caught by Dian Wei and dies. The enemy then takes the mid tower.
events.evidence: The mid-lane tower is destroyed shortly after the failed skirmish.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize defending the mid-tower over risky jungle invades when behind.

events.coach_claim: Angela misses her entire combo on Lanling King, showing a total lack of focus in the late game.
events.gameplay_event: During the final base defense, Angela fires all her skills into empty space while Lanling King is nearby.
events.evidence: Angela's 2-1-3 combo misses the target completely.
events.recommended_action: Stay calm during high-pressure defenses and wait for CC to land before committing the Ultimate.

events.coach_claim: Use lane priority to roam rather than dueling a stronger early-game hero.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao duels Ying Zheng in mid lane instead of roaming.
events.evidence: Audio: Mention of "middle lane priority" vs "dueling."
events.recommended_action: Clear waves and immediately rotate to side lanes to secure resources.

events.coach_claim: Standing in the river without Flash is suicidal when the enemy jungler is nearby.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao is caught in the river by the enemy jungler and dies.
events.evidence: Visual: Flash is on cooldown; Jungler appears from fog.
events.recommended_action: Stay under tower or in safe zones when Flash is down and enemy location is unknown.

events.coach_claim: Ignoring teammate pings and vision leads to avoidable deaths.
events.gameplay_event: Player walks into a brush previously pinged by the support (Niu Mo).
events.evidence: Visual: Map pings on the brush; Xiao Qiao enters and dies.
events.recommended_action: Trust teammate signals and avoid unwarded brushes when enemies are missing.

events.coach_claim: Aggressive Flashing when significantly behind in economy is a waste of a defensive tool.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao flashes over a wall to chase Ying Zheng while under-farmed.
events.evidence: Audio: "Economy doesn't support you"; Visual: Failed chase/death.
events.recommended_action: Reserve Flash for survival, especially when trailing in gold.

events.coach_claim: Poor pathing and "hitting walls" prevents securing easy kills.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao fails to finish a low-HP Hou Yi due to bumping into terrain.
events.evidence: Visual: Character model stuttering against jungle walls.
events.recommended_action: Practice precise movement and pathing during high-pressure chases.

events.coach_claim: Do not waste crowd control on enemies in CC-immune states.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao flashes to stun Hua Mulan while she is in Heavy Sword state.
events.evidence: Visual: Mulan's "Unstoppable" (CC immune) state active during stun.
events.recommended_action: Learn enemy hero mechanics, specifically CC-immunity windows.

events.coach_claim: Defending the high ground is more important than farming small jungle monsters.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao farms jungle while the base is being sieged, then dies.
events.evidence: Visual: Enemy pushing high ground while player is at a jungle camp.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize wave clear and base defense over minor gold gains in the late game.

events.coach_claim: Item switching speed is too slow for high-level play.
events.gameplay_event: Player takes several seconds to navigate the shop for Resurrection Armor.
events.evidence: Visual: Lengthy shop interface dwell time during a fight.
events.recommended_action: Practice quick-buy presets and rapid shop navigation for item swapping.

events.coach_claim: Don't take the enemy personally; focus on lane priority and wave clearing.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao clears the first wave against Zhen Ji and gains lane priority.
events.evidence: Player ignores Zhen Ji to secure the wave quickly, then rotates to the enemy blue buff.
events.recommended_action: Maintain focus on wave priority to enable rotations.

events.coach_claim: The intention to steal the buff was too obvious; poor vision awareness led to a wasted flash and death.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao attempts to steal the enemy blue buff, gets caught by the enemy team, and uses a "flash thousand fans" (Flicker + S1) unsuccessfully before dying.
events.evidence: Player lingers in the enemy jungle without vision of the enemy mid/bot rotations.
events.recommended_action: Abandon the steal if the enemy jungler is present and teammates aren't rotating to support.

events.coach_claim: Stop playing like an ADC; relying on basic attacks instead of skill rotations is inefficient for a mage.
events.gameplay_event: During a bot lane skirmish, Xiao Qiao stands still and basic attacks the enemy Lanling King instead of kiting or using skills.
events.evidence: Visible animation of Xiao Qiao standing in place basic-attacking while skills are available.
events.recommended_action: Focus on skill-based burst and repositioning between cooldowns.

events.coach_claim: Staying in the river at low health is reckless, especially when healing resources are available.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao remains in the river with very low HP/Mana instead of using the blood pack behind the bot lane tower.
events.evidence: The map shows a blood pack available behind the tower, but the player stays in the brush to ambush.
events.recommended_action: Utilize map resources (blood packs) to maintain sustain without needing to recall.

events.coach_claim: Wasting the ultimate on a tanky Heino is pointless; he will just heal back the damage.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao uses her ultimate on Heino near the mid tower, but he sustains through it easily.
events.evidence: Heino's health bar barely moves/recovers quickly despite the ultimate being active.
events.recommended_action: Save high-impact ultimates for squishy targets or confirmed kills.

events.coach_claim: Unnecessarily revealing position on the map; should have stayed hidden to maintain pressure.
events.gameplay_event: After a successful gank on Heino, Xiao Qiao walks into the top lane wave, revealing her location to the enemy.
events.evidence: Player icon appears on the minimap in the top lane instead of staying in the fog of war with the jungler.
events.recommended_action: Stay in the fog of war after a gank to keep the enemy guessing about your next rotation.

events.coach_claim: "Taking a bath" in the enemy's ultimate; poor positioning led to an avoidable death.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao stands directly inside Zhen Ji's ultimate during a mid-lane teamfight and dies.
events.evidence: Visible ice field from Zhen Ji's ultimate with Xiao Qiao standing in the center.
events.recommended_action: Improve spatial awareness and avoid standing in persistent AOE crowd control.

events.coach_claim: The "2-flash" (S2 + Flicker) was purely decorative and served no tactical purpose.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao uses Flicker during her Skill 2 animation against an isolated shooter, which didn't change the outcome of the kill.
events.evidence: Player uses Flicker during the knock-up animation when the target was already within range.
events.recommended_action: Use Flicker only when necessary to extend range or dodge; don't waste it for "style."

events.coach_claim: Invading the enemy blue buff without mid-lane priority is a recipe for heavy losses.
events.gameplay_event: Donghuang and Dian Wei invade the enemy blue zone early while the mid lane is pushed in.
events.evidence: Visual/Audio
events.recommended_action: Coordinate invades only when mid-lane priority is secured to ensure backup.

events.coach_claim: Using the 2nd skill directly onto the enemy's face during a tower dive leads to unnecessary deaths.
events.gameplay_event: Diao Chan teleports bottom, ganks, but dives the tower recklessly, taking 4 hits and dying for a trade.
events.evidence: Visual/Audio
events.recommended_action: Use the 2nd skill to dodge tower shots or reposition rather than just for point-blank damage during dives.

events.coach_claim: Questioning a level 3 jungler's ultimate shows a lack of game awareness and toxic mentality.
events.gameplay_event: Player pings "Where is your big move?" to a level 3 Dian Wei who hasn't unlocked his ultimate yet.
events.evidence: Visual/Audio
events.recommended_action: Monitor teammate levels before flaming; focus on your own positioning rather than blaming under-leveled allies.

events.coach_claim: Diao Chan must prioritize survival and farming until core items (Holy Grail/CD Boots) are completed.
events.gameplay_event: Player repeatedly jumps into 3+ enemies and dies before finishing basic core items.
events.evidence: Visual/Audio
events.recommended_action: Play defensively and farm safely until reaching the power spike provided by core cooldown reduction items.

events.coach_claim: Stealing jungle camps from a stack-dependent hero like Dian Wei cripples your own team's scaling.
events.gameplay_event: Low-health Diao Chan clears Dian Wei's "pig" camp instead of recalling to base.
events.evidence: Visual/Audio
events.recommended_action: Leave jungle camps for the jungler, especially heroes who need them for passive stacks; recall when low.

events.coach_claim: Reckless 1v5 jumps under enemy towers while significantly behind in gold is "brainless" play.
events.gameplay_event: Diao Chan (0-5-0) teleports mid and immediately jumps into the entire enemy team under their tower.
events.evidence: Visual/Audio
events.recommended_action: Stop seeking aggressive trades when behind; focus on wave clear and defensive positioning to stall the game.

events.coach_claim: Blaming the team composition while having a 1-12 record indicates a complete lack of self-reflection.
events.gameplay_event: After losing with a 1-12-6 score, the player claims the "lineup can't be played at all."
events.evidence: Visual/Audio
events.recommended_action: Acknowledge individual mistakes (12 deaths) instead of scapegoating the team composition for a loss.

events.coach_claim: Early vision check was good, but the level 2 tower dive resulted in a poor trade.
events.gameplay_event: Mai Shiranui dives Xishi under tower at level 2.
events.evidence: Mai Shiranui kicks into tower, takes damage, and dies for a 1-for-1 trade.
events.recommended_action: Avoid diving early without a significant health advantage or escape.

events.coach_claim: Harassing the hero instead of clearing the wave loses lane priority.
events.gameplay_event: Mai Shiranui uses all skills on Xishi, ignoring the minion wave.
events.evidence: Xishi clears the wave and roams while Mai Shiranui is still in lane.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize wave clear to secure roam opportunities or prevent enemy roams.

events.coach_claim: Repeatedly engaging in 1-for-1 trades under tower is inefficient.
events.gameplay_event: Roam to top lane; dives Xishi under tower again.
events.evidence: Mai Shiranui kills Xishi but dies to tower shots immediately after.
events.recommended_action: Focus on survival and farm; avoid low-value trades that halt momentum.

events.coach_claim: Chasing a higher-level enemy without support leads to unnecessary deaths.
events.gameplay_event: Level 3 Mai Shiranui chases a level 4 Xishi into the river.
events.evidence: Xishi uses CC to pull Mai Shiranui into a trap; Mai Shiranui dies.
events.recommended_action: Respect level power spikes (especially level 4) and avoid blind chasing.

events.coach_claim: Minions can block skill-shots, ruining high-damage combos.
events.gameplay_event: Mai Shiranui attempts to burst Irene, but her Skill 2 hits a minion.
events.evidence: The fan (Skill 2) is clearly blocked by a lane minion, preventing the kill.
events.recommended_action: Position carefully or wait for a clear line of sight before committing skills.

events.coach_claim: Failing to dodge CC near towers leads to easy picks for the enemy.
events.gameplay_event: Mai Shiranui is pulled twice by Xishi's Skill 1 into the tower.
events.evidence: Visible "hook" and pull animation from Xishi leading to tower death.
events.recommended_action: Stay outside of CC range or prioritize dodging when near enemy towers.

events.coach_claim: Dodging a teammate's healing abilities reduces team sustain.
events.gameplay_event: Mai Shiranui uses her passive to move away from Cai Wenji's heal.
events.evidence: Mai Shiranui is at low HP but actively moves out of the healing circle.
events.recommended_action: Coordinate with support; stay within range of heals during downtime.

events.coach_claim: Engaging a group without an Ultimate is a high-risk, low-reward play.
events.gameplay_event: Mai Shiranui kicks into three enemies while her Ultimate is on cooldown.
events.evidence: Mai Shiranui dies instantly without dealing significant damage.
events.recommended_action: Track key cooldowns before initiating or following up on fights.

events.coach_claim: Leaking vision before a flash-engage alerts the enemy to your intentions.
events.gameplay_event: Mai Shiranui enters a bush visibly before attempting a flash-engage.
events.evidence: Coach notes she is "leaking vision" before the flash; enemy reacts.
events.recommended_action: Ensure you are fully hidden/out of vision before using Flash to engage.

events.coach_claim: Attempting to ambush at low health against full-health targets is suicidal.
events.gameplay_event: Low HP Mai Shiranui tries to burst a full-health Irene.
events.evidence: Mai Shiranui fails the burst and is quickly killed by Irene.
events.recommended_action: Recall to heal when low; do not take unfavorable 1v1s without an advantage.

events.coach_claim: Poor positioning at the edge of a bush allows the enemy to poke you out.
events.gameplay_event: Mai Shiranui hides at the very edge of a bush and is poked by Irene.
events.evidence: Irene lands hits on Mai Shiranui despite her being "hidden" in the bush.
events.recommended_action: Sit deeper in the bush or move unpredictably to avoid being spotted.

events.coach_claim: Attempting a 1v5 engage when the team is dead is a game-ending mistake.
events.gameplay_event: Mai Shiranui flashes into the entire enemy team alone.
events.evidence: Scoreboard shows three teammates dead; Mai Shiranui dies instantly.
events.recommended_action: Play defensively and focus on wave clear when outnumbered.

events.coach_claim: Both players lacked detail; it was a primitive trade. No one used Flash.
events.gameplay_event: Level 1 mid-lane trade results in a double kill (both die).
events.evidence: Visual: Angela and Xiao Qiao stand still and trade until both die.
events.recommended_action: Use Flash to dodge lethal skillshots or reposition during early trades.

events.coach_claim: Xiao Qiao is smarter, hiding behind minions while Angela just attacks blindly.
events.gameplay_event: Angela repeatedly takes poke damage while trying to land Skill 2 on a shielded target.
events.evidence: Visual: Xiao Qiao uses minion wave as a meat shield; Angela takes full "fan" damage.
events.recommended_action: Position relative to the minion wave to avoid predictable poke.

events.coach_claim: Angela has tunnel vision on Xiao Qiao and ignores the tank in her face.
events.gameplay_event: Angela ignores Cheng Yaojin (tank) right next to her to chase Xiao Qiao.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach notes she "doesn't even look at Cheng Yaojin."
events.recommended_action: Prioritize targets based on immediate threat vs. killability.

events.coach_claim: Roaming from mid to bot took only 6 seconds due to passive, but the execution was poor.
events.gameplay_event: Angela roams bot, misses Skill 2, and trades 1-for-1 with Yu Ji.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela misses the stun but uses Ult to secure a kill before dying.
events.recommended_action: Improve Skill 2 leading to ensure the burst combo connects safely.

events.coach_claim: Angela ignores map information showing the enemy Lanling Wang mid.
events.gameplay_event: Angela walks toward mid-lane despite Lanling Wang being visible and dies.
events.evidence: Visual: Lanling Wang is visible on the mini-map/lane before the kill.
events.recommended_action: Check mini-map before entering transition zones (river/choke points).

events.coach_claim: The player isn't serious; they are dazed in the fountain and bumping into walls.
events.gameplay_event: Angela stays in the fountain for several seconds and fails to navigate around a wall.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela pathing directly into the fountain wall repeatedly.
events.recommended_action: Maintain focus on pathing and shop efficiency to minimize downtime.

events.coach_claim: Crossing the river without lane priority is a death sentence.
events.gameplay_event: Angela enters the river bush without vision or priority and gets ambushed.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela face-checks a bush and is forced to be saved by Doria.
events.recommended_action: Do not enter the river if the enemy has cleared the wave first.

events.coach_claim: Toggling voice settings while enemies are on top of you is a major distraction.
events.gameplay_event: Angela opens the voice menu to change to a "Loli" voice while in the jungle.
events.evidence: Visual: Voice setting UI obscures the screen during active gameplay.
events.recommended_action: Do not adjust non-essential settings outside of the fountain.

events.coach_claim: Standing still like a "wooden stake" during Ult makes you an easy target.
events.gameplay_event: Angela uses Ult while stationary in a bad position and dies immediately after.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela is stationary for the full duration of Ult while being collapsed on.
events.recommended_action: Cancel Ult early if the target moves or if you are being flanked.

events.coach_claim: Priority should be pressing the mid tower before taking the dragon.
events.gameplay_event: The team has a numbers advantage but hesitates between the tower and the pit.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach emphasizes "Tower > Dragon" for profit maximization.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize structural damage when the enemy mid-laner is dead.

events.coach_claim: Angela ignores the support's retreat signals and wastes Flash.
events.gameplay_event: Angela ignores Doria's pings, stays too deep, and uses Flash pointlessly.
events.evidence: Visual: Multiple "Retreat" pings on screen; Angela Flashes into a wall/dead end.
events.recommended_action: Follow shot-caller/support pings, especially when lacking mobility.

events.coach_claim: Angela mistakes Sun Ce for Sun Quan in chat and wastes Ult on air.
events.gameplay_event: Angela praises "Sun Quan" (Sun Ce) while accidentally firing Ult into a wall.
events.evidence: Visual: Angela types in chat while misfiring her ultimate ability.
events.recommended_action: Focus on ability uptime during the final push rather than typing.

events.coach_claim: Change your build to half-meat, half-AP for better survivability and impact.
events.gameplay_event: Introduction to the review.
events.evidence: Audio commentary suggesting build change.
events.recommended_action: Switch from pure AP to a bruiser-mage build.

events.coach_claim: Xi Shi is weak at level 1; trading HP with Xiao Qiao is a losing move.
events.gameplay_event: Xi Shi takes significant damage from Xiao Qiao's fan while trying to poke.
events.evidence: Visible HP bar drop; audio critique of the trade.
events.recommended_action: Play safely at level 1; wait for level 2 or support assistance.

events.coach_claim: Good job not rushing into the mid-lane bush without knowing where the enemy is.
events.gameplay_event: Xi Shi waits for Xiao Qiao to appear on the map before moving forward.
events.evidence: Visible patient movement; audio praise for caution.
events.recommended_action: Continue prioritizing safety and information before rotating.

events.coach_claim: Don't let "bloodlust" cloud your judgment; flashing for a low-HP support led to a team wipe.
events.gameplay_event: Xi Shi flashes to kill Liu Chan but is caught by reinforcements, leading to three deaths.
events.evidence: Visible overextension; audio critique of greed.
events.recommended_action: Assess enemy backup before committing high-value spells like Flash.

events.coach_claim: You pulled the enemy too early; teammates were too far to follow up with damage.
events.gameplay_event: Xi Shi pulls Sun Ce from a bush, but teammates are out of range to secure the kill.
events.evidence: Visible distance between teammates; audio critique of timing.
events.recommended_action: Wait for teammates to be in striking distance before initiating the pull.

events.coach_claim: You're hiding in a bush but ignoring the mini-map; the enemy jungler walked right into you.
events.gameplay_event: Xi Shi stays in a bush while the enemy jungler moves towards her position on the map.
events.evidence: Visible mini-map movement; audio critique of map awareness.
events.recommended_action: Watch the mini-map constantly, even when stationary or "hidden."

events.coach_claim: Poor pathing and lack of urgency caused the loss of the bottom tower.
events.gameplay_event: Xi Shi takes a long route to defend bot, allowing Sun Ce to take the tower and kill her.
events.evidence: Visible slow rotation; audio critique of decision-making.
events.recommended_action: Identify threatened objectives earlier and take the most direct, safe path.

events.coach_claim: Stop revealing your position for no reason; you gave the enemy your coordinates.
events.gameplay_event: Xi Shi walks out of a safe bush, revealing herself, and is immediately killed.
events.evidence: Visible unnecessary movement; audio critique of "showing vision."
events.recommended_action: Stay hidden until you have a clear objective or initiation opportunity.

events.coach_claim: Minor inefficiency in wave clearing at Level 1.
events.gameplay_event: Level 1 Mid-lane clear
events.evidence: Used 3 skills instead of 2 to clear the first wave.
events.recommended_action: Practice skill placement to clear waves with exactly two Skill 1 casts.

events.coach_claim: Stealing the shooter's Level 2 experience hinders their early game.
events.gameplay_event: Roam to bottom lane
events.evidence: Heino stands in range of the shooter's minions, hitting Level 2 first.
events.recommended_action: Avoid soaking side-lane XP unless the teammate is absent or needs help pushing.

events.coach_claim: Good proactive resource denial by stealing enemy jungle creeps.
events.gameplay_event: Jungle invade (Barefoot)
events.evidence: Uses Skill 1 to last-hit the enemy's barefoot resource.
events.recommended_action: Continue prioritizing neutral/enemy resources when the team has a numbers advantage.

events.coach_claim: Mages with priority should roam to control side-lane resources.
events.gameplay_event: Side-lane roaming
events.evidence: Heino moves to side lanes immediately after clearing mid.
events.recommended_action: Maintain this high-tempo roaming to expand economic lead.

events.coach_claim: Poor positioning and lack of reaction when the jungler (Ake) appears.
events.gameplay_event: Near-tower skirmish
events.evidence: Heino uses Skill 2 to gap-close/distance but then stands stationary while taking damage.
events.recommended_action: Always maintain movement between auto-attacks and skills, especially when an assassin is visible.

events.coach_claim: Ultimate wasted for no tactical gain.
events.gameplay_event: Ultimate usage
events.evidence: Heino casts Ultimate at Level 4 with no enemies nearby and high health.
events.recommended_action: Save the Ultimate for survival or resetting a dive; never use it randomly.

events.coach_claim: Overextending without a safety net (Ultimate) leads to an avoidable death.
events.gameplay_event: Death to Ake
events.evidence: Heino harasses a low-health Wan'er but is caught by Ake because his Ult is on cooldown.
events.recommended_action: Check Ultimate availability before committing to deep harassment in the river.

events.coach_claim: "Eating three lines" (hogging all resources) starves teammates.
events.gameplay_event: Resource distribution
events.evidence: Heino teleports between all three lanes to clear every minion wave, leaving the shooter (Hou Yi) with no farm.
events.recommended_action: Allow carries to take their own lane farm; focus on invading enemy jungle instead of taking teammate waves.

events.coach_claim: Failure to utilize available healing leads to death.
events.gameplay_event: Death near tower
events.evidence: Heino ignores the health pack behind the tower and turns back to fight, dying to the enemy.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize health packs and tower safety when low on HP rather than looking for "hero" plays.

events.coach_claim: Deflecting blame to teammates (Xi Shi) for personal errors.
events.gameplay_event: Post-death chat
events.evidence: Heino pings/blames Xi Shi's skill miss for his own death.
events.recommended_action: Focus on personal positioning and resource usage (like the health pack) instead of teammate mistakes.

events.coach_claim: Poor mechanical execution in a 1v1 against a shooter.
events.gameplay_event: Death to Luban
events.evidence: Heino is outplayed and killed by Luban in a direct confrontation.
events.recommended_action: Improve skill accuracy and kiting; Heino should not lose a 1v1 with such a massive gold lead.

events.coach_claim: Late communication regarding enemy movements.
events.gameplay_event: Enemy Sun Ce Ult
events.evidence: Heino pings Sun Ce's ultimate only after the teammate (Xi Shi) has already been hit and killed.
events.recommended_action: Ping enemy ultimates/roams the moment they are spotted, not after the engagement.

events.coach_claim: Repeatedly wasting Ultimate during tower sieges.
events.gameplay_event: Siege at 2nd tower
events.evidence: Ultimate is cast while pushing a tower with no immediate threat present.
events.recommended_action: Keep the Ultimate as a defensive tool during sieges to counter-initiate if the enemy dives.

events.coach_claim: Toxicity and taunting despite mediocre performance.
events.gameplay_event: End-game taunting
events.evidence: Heino taunts enemies/teammates and teleports back to base repeatedly.
events.recommended_action: Maintain professional behavior; a gold lead at low ranks does not justify toxicity.

events.coach_claim: Coach praises the Flash-Skill 1 combo to kill Lanling Wang but notes the subsequent death to tower damage.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao kills Lanling Wang with Flash-Skill 1, then dies to tower.
events.evidence: Audio: "Beautiful flash... ate three mouthfuls of tower damage."
events.recommended_action: Avoid taking unnecessary tower shots after securing a kill.

events.coach_claim: Coach critiques staying in mid lane to fight instead of rotating to help the jungler.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao stays mid to poke Angela after clearing the wave.
events.evidence: Audio: "Do not choose to go... to help the jungler... choose to continue in the middle."
events.recommended_action: Rotate to assist the jungler with objectives or buffs after clearing waves.

events.coach_claim: Coach points out poor positioning (walking into Angela's face) and failing to use health packs when low.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao takes free damage from Angela and stays at low HP.
events.evidence: Audio: "Why are you walking across Angela's face?... Don't go back to the tower to eat blood packs."
events.recommended_action: Maintain safe distance from burst mages and utilize tower health packs for sustain.

events.coach_claim: Coach mentions the "hypothetical principle" for river movement and letting the support scout.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao follows the support directly through the river without checking bushes.
events.evidence: Audio: "Assume there's somebody in the grass... let the assistant explore the field of vision first."
events.recommended_action: Use skills to check bushes or wait for the support to gain vision before entering the river.

events.coach_claim: Coach highlights the risk of staying at low HP without health packs instead of recalling.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao stays in lane at critical HP despite having no health packs.
events.evidence: Audio: "This state is very uncomfortable... you have to go back to the city."
events.recommended_action: Recall to base when low on HP/Mana and no local sustain is available.

events.coach_claim: Coach critiques clearing waves too far forward without Flash, leading to a death.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao dies to the enemy shooter while clearing too far from the tower.
events.evidence: Audio: "You didn't run away from the tower to tilt the line... a little too arrogant."
events.recommended_action: Play more defensively when Flash is on cooldown, especially against mobile enemies.

events.coach_claim: Coach notes Xiao Qiao's tendency to walk directly into Angela's crowd control.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao gets hit by Angela's 2-1 combo and dies while wandering.
events.evidence: Audio: "Still walking to the skill of Angela 2... That's no two."
events.recommended_action: Focus on dodging key enemy skillshots, particularly high-impact CC like Angela's stun.

events.coach_claim: Coach points out the failed Flash attempt and poor positioning on the enemy high ground.
events.gameplay_event: Xiao Qiao fails to escape Angela on the high ground and dies.
events.evidence: Audio: "Flash back and fail again... Feed yourself into the opposite mouth."
events.recommended_action: Use Flash proactively to escape rather than as a last-ditch effort when already caught.

events.coach_claim: Diaochan is at a disadvantage at level 1 but clears the wave too deep.
events.gameplay_event: Diaochan pushes to the enemy tower at level 1 and takes heavy poke.
events.evidence: Visual: Diaochan at low health near enemy T1 tower.
events.recommended_action: Play safely near your own tower at level 1 against Xiao Qiao.

events.coach_claim: The player gets solo killed in a 2v1 situation while teammates are busy elsewhere.
events.gameplay_event: Diaochan and Zhang Liang fail to kill Xiao Qiao; Diaochan dies solo.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach mentions being solo killed despite support presence.
events.recommended_action: Respect enemy burst damage; don't overcommit without a clear advantage.

events.coach_claim: Teleporting bot causes the player to lose a full mid wave for no gain.
events.gameplay_event: Diaochan TPs bot, misses the mid wave, and fails to secure a kill.
events.evidence: Visual: Mid wave dying to tower while Diaochan is bot.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize clearing mid lane before rotating or using Teleport.

events.coach_claim: Jumping into multiple enemies without an ultimate is a suicide play.
events.gameplay_event: Diaochan dives two enemies top without her ultimate active and dies.
events.evidence: Visual: Diaochan jumps into Miyamoto/Li Xin without ult circle.
events.recommended_action: Wait for ultimate cooldown before engaging in aggressive dives.

events.coach_claim: The player wanders aimlessly instead of taking available farm.
events.gameplay_event: Diaochan revives and walks bot instead of taking the crashing mid wave.
events.evidence: Visual: Diaochan walking through jungle while waves are in lane.
events.recommended_action: Always take the closest, safest farm (mid lane) after reviving.

events.coach_claim: Fighting enemies with a significant level lead is a major macro error.
events.gameplay_event: Level 5 Diaochan attempts to solo fight a Level 7 Miyamoto.
events.evidence: Visual: Level indicators (5 vs 7) above health bars.
events.recommended_action: Avoid 1v1s when down in levels; focus on catching up through farm.

events.coach_claim: Poor positioning leads to jumping into the middle of three enemies.
events.gameplay_event: Diaochan jumps directly into a 1v3 situation and is instantly deleted.
events.evidence: Visual: Diaochan surrounded by three enemy icons.
events.recommended_action: Position on the edge of fights and use mobility to kite, not dive.

events.coach_claim: Mismanaging the ultimate by jumping outside of its beneficial range.
events.gameplay_event: Diaochan casts ultimate but immediately jumps out of the circle.
events.evidence: Visual: Ultimate circle left behind as Diaochan jumps away.
events.recommended_action: Stay within the ultimate circle to maximize cooldown reduction.

events.coach_claim: Buying a sapphire at level 1 provides zero benefit for laning or trading.
events.gameplay_event: Level 1 item purchase.
events.evidence: Visible item shop showing Sapphire purchase.
events.recommended_action: Buy a Spellbook or boots for better early pressure.

events.coach_claim: Trying to steal the enemy's red jungle pig with a high-kill line spell but failing.
events.gameplay_event: Jungle steal attempt.
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao uses Skill 1 on enemy jungle monsters.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize clearing mid wave first to maintain priority.

events.coach_claim: Invading the enemy jungle alone to steal monsters is extremely risky and unsuccessful.
events.gameplay_event: Solo jungle invade.
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao enters enemy jungle near the monkey camp.
events.recommended_action: Only invade with team support or when enemy jungler is visible elsewhere.

events.coach_claim: Using Flash randomly for no apparent reason; no one can understand this move.
events.gameplay_event: Unnecessary Flash usage.
events.evidence: Flash animation triggers in the river with no enemies nearby.
events.recommended_action: Save Flash for escaping ganks or securing kills.

events.coach_claim: Taking a bad fight against the enemy support and getting caught, leading to a death.
events.gameplay_event: Bad skirmish engagement.
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao fights enemy support near the river and dies.
events.recommended_action: Avoid 1v1s as a mage against supports with CC when you have no escape.

events.coach_claim: Missing nearly two full waves of minions because of a poorly timed death and lack of jungle cover.
events.gameplay_event: Loss of minion resources.
events.evidence: Mid lane minions die to tower while Xiao Qiao is dead.
events.recommended_action: Time recalls and rotations to ensure you don't miss waves.

events.coach_claim: Buying magic penetration shoes early only to arrive in lane and miss most of the wave.
events.gameplay_event: Poor itemization and wave management.
events.evidence: Item bar shows magic pen boots; minions die before she reaches them.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize wave clear speed over early penetration if you're behind.

events.coach_claim: Treating the river as your own home and ignoring the enemy jungler's position leads to repeated deaths.
events.gameplay_event: Overextending in the river.
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao lingers in the river without vision and gets collapsed on.
events.recommended_action: Stay behind the frontline and use bushes for safety.

events.coach_claim: Repeatedly trying to steal jungle monsters while missing mid-lane waves is a net loss in gold and XP.
events.gameplay_event: Misplaced priorities.
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao misses two front-line minions to chase a jungle monster.
events.recommended_action: Minions are the most reliable source of income; don't trade them for jungle RNG.

events.coach_claim: Bad positioning in a teamfight leads to an easy death by Miyamoto Musashi.
events.gameplay_event: Poor teamfight positioning.
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao walks into Miyamoto's face and is instantly killed.
events.recommended_action: Maintain maximum range and wait for enemy gap-closers to be used.

events.coach_claim: Losing a massive amount of gold and XP from mid-lane waves entering the tower.
events.gameplay_event: Significant resource loss.
events.evidence: Four minions die to the mid tower while Xiao Qiao is dead.
events.recommended_action: Dying is the biggest setback for a carry; play more conservatively.

events.coach_claim: Using all skills and Flash on a small jungle monster instead of saving them for the teamfight.
events.gameplay_event: Poor skill and resource management.
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao flashes and uses full combo on a red armor monster.
events.recommended_action: Save high-cooldown abilities for enemy heroes.

events.coach_claim: Dying to the Overlord (PVE) because of bad positioning and lack of health awareness.
events.gameplay_event: Death to neutral objective.
events.evidence: The Overlord's slam attack kills the low-health Xiao Qiao.
events.recommended_action: Don't tank objectives as a squishy mage; let the tank take the hits.

events.coach_claim: Recalling in the middle of the river with low health is an invitation to be killed.
events.gameplay_event: Unsafe recall.
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao starts recall animation in the open river and is killed by Miyamoto.
events.recommended_action: Always recall under a tower or deep within a safe bush.

events.coach_claim: Buying core items like Echo and Hat far too late (9 minutes) due to poor farming.
events.gameplay_event: Delayed power spike.
events.evidence: Item shop shows Echo and Hat completed at the 9-minute mark.
events.recommended_action: Focus on consistent farming to hit power spikes earlier.

events.coach_claim: Getting caught by Miyamoto again while trying to split push alone without vision.
events.gameplay_event: Caught out while split pushing.
events.evidence: Miyamoto jumps on Xiao Qiao in the side lane.
events.recommended_action: Mages should rarely split push alone, especially against assassins.

events.coach_claim: Final death due to poor positioning, though the team manages to win the game regardless.
events.gameplay_event: Late game death.
events.evidence: Xiao Qiao dies in a chaotic teamfight near the enemy base.
events.recommended_action: Stay close to the support and peel for yourself.

events.coach_claim: Teleporting to side lanes early steals crucial farm from teammates.
events.gameplay_event: Heino teleports to bot lane after clearing the first mid wave, taking farm from Sikong Zhen.
events.evidence: Audio commentary; Heino visible clearing bot minions under tower.
events.recommended_action: Roam to support without staying to soak up solo-lane gold/XP.

events.coach_claim: Abandoning teammates after taking their resources leads to their death.
events.gameplay_event: Heino leaves Sikong Zhen in a 2v3 situation to return mid after clearing his wave.
events.evidence: Sikong Zhen dies on the map while Heino walks away.
events.recommended_action: Commit to the fight if you have already committed to the lane.

events.coach_claim: Prioritizing side lane farm over advantageous teamfights is a major error.
events.gameplay_event: Heino teleports to top lane to clear minions during a 4v3 teamfight in the river.
events.evidence: Map shows teammates engaging while Heino is isolated top.
events.recommended_action: Join nearby skirmishes, especially when the team has a numbers advantage.

events.coach_claim: Stealing jungle buffs and camps starves the jungler, hindering the whole team.
events.gameplay_event: Heino clears the blue buff and small jungle camps (birds).
events.evidence: Visual of Heino killing jungle creeps; coach notes economic impact.
events.recommended_action: Leave jungle resources for the jungler unless they are being counter-jungled.

events.coach_claim: Leaving the mid lane undefended to farm side lanes loses towers.
events.gameplay_event: Heino teleports top to farm, forcing the support (Bian Que) to defend mid.
events.evidence: Mid tower takes significant damage/falls while Heino is top.
events.recommended_action: As a mid-laner, prioritize defending the central axis tower.

events.coach_claim: Wasting the ultimate ability on non-lethal poke removes your safety net.
events.gameplay_event: Heino uses ultimate to recover health after minor damage from Su Lie.
events.evidence: Ultimate animation triggers with no enemy follow-up threat.
events.recommended_action: Save the ultimate for repositioning during high-stakes teamfights.

events.coach_claim: Poor positioning against CC-heavy comps leads to unnecessary deaths.
events.gameplay_event: Heino engages without ultimate and is caught by enemy crowd control.
events.evidence: Heino dies in mid lane; coach notes 6-minute tower loss.
events.recommended_action: Track enemy CC cooldowns and your own ultimate status before engaging.

events.coach_claim: Blaming teammates while hoarding resources and failing to impact fights is toxic.
events.gameplay_event: Heino complains about "low scores" in chat while the base is being destroyed.
events.evidence: Chat log visible; Heino dies again after a failed teleport.
events.recommended_action: Focus on personal macro improvements rather than teammate statistics.

events.coach_claim: Do not waste basic attacks on monsters that will already die to jungle item burn damage.
events.gameplay_event: Miyamoto attacks a pig monster that is nearly dead from burn.
events.evidence: Audio: "Don't need you to make up for this knife." Visual: Jungle item burn effect.
events.recommended_action: Move toward the next camp while burn damage finishes off the current monster.

events.coach_claim: Skill 2 (dash) should hit targets to trigger cooldown reduction; avoid using it for empty movement.
events.gameplay_event: Miyamoto dashes through the air without hitting any units.
events.evidence: Audio: "Miyamoto's two skills... hits enemy units and picks them up [reduces CD]."
events.recommended_action: Aim Skill 2 to hit monsters or heroes to maximize dash frequency.

events.coach_claim: Slower jungle clearing results in a level disadvantage compared to the enemy jungler.
events.gameplay_event: Miyamoto reaches level 4 at 1:20, behind the opponent.
events.evidence: Visual: Game timer vs. level 4 milestone; enemy jungler is already active.
events.recommended_action: Optimize jungle pathing and skill usage to hit level 4 as fast as possible.

events.coach_claim: Avoid leeching mid-lane economy from the mage; utilize teleport arrays for better map presence.
events.gameplay_event: Miyamoto clears mid-lane waves instead of jungling or ganking.
events.evidence: Audio: "You come to the middle... and eat half of the hot pot."
events.recommended_action: Prioritize jungle camps and use the teleport array to rotate without stealing mid gold.

events.coach_claim: Execute the 2A1A-Ult combo correctly to ensure maximum damage and crowd control.
events.gameplay_event: Miyamoto fails a gank due to inefficient skill sequencing.
events.evidence: Audio: "2A1A big trick... will you come up with a [follow up]?"
events.recommended_action: Practice the 2-Basic Attack-1-Basic Attack-Ultimate combo in training mode.

events.coach_claim: Leaving individual monsters in a camp ruins respawn timers and reduces overall efficiency.
events.gameplay_event: Miyamoto leaves one lizard and one pig alive in their respective camps.
events.evidence: Audio: "I have a red flag cow and a blue zone cow [left behind]."
events.recommended_action: Ensure every monster in a camp is killed so the entire camp respawns together.

events.coach_claim: Aim for a gold benchmark of 3,000 by 4 minutes to maintain carry potential as a jungler.
events.gameplay_event: Scoreboard shows Miyamoto has only 2,300 gold at the 4-minute mark.
events.evidence: Audio: "4 minutes... can brush out 3,000 bucks... is the first step."
events.recommended_action: Focus on high-efficiency farming to meet gold-per-minute targets.

events.coach_claim: Use bushes to hide your approach when attempting to split-push or steal towers.
events.gameplay_event: Miyamoto stands directly in front of the enemy tower while trying to take it.
events.evidence: Audio: "You don't have to stand at the door... go into the grass and steal it."
events.recommended_action: Position in nearby bushes to stay off the minimap while waiting for minions.

events.coach_claim: Consistent practice of fundamental jungle clears and combos is necessary to climb ranks.
events.gameplay_event: Final summary of the player's 4.7 performance rating.
events.evidence: Audio: "Basic skills company... can you brush it ten times?"
events.recommended_action: Run jungle clear drills and combo practice 10+ times daily to build muscle memory.

events.coach_claim: The red-to-blue pathing towards the top lane is highly efficient for early-game Ma Chao.
events.gameplay_event: Ma Chao completes a full clear starting from red, ending at the top lane for a potential gank.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach praises the "spiritual" play and clearing speed. Visual: Pathing shown on minimap.
events.recommended_action: Maintain this pathing to maximize early-game pressure on the side lanes.

events.coach_claim: Clearing the top minion wave at 1:46 is a macro error as it delays the second jungle spawn rotation.
events.gameplay_event: Ma Chao stays to clear the top wave, causing the second red-side spawn to sit idle for several seconds.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach calls it "stagnant jungle economy." Visual: Red creeps spawn while Ma Chao is still top.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize returning to the jungle exactly as creeps spawn to maintain a gold lead.

events.coach_claim: Inefficient rotation timing prevents clearing small creeps before the blue buff spawns.
events.gameplay_event: Ma Chao arrives at the blue buff at 2:00 but hasn't cleared the adjacent small creeps.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach notes the missed opportunity to clear small creeps then buff. Visual: Blue buff spawns at 2:00.
events.recommended_action: Adjust rotation speed by 3-5 seconds to clear small camps before major buffs spawn.

events.coach_claim: Ganking the opposite side of the enemy mid-laner's position is an excellent macro choice.
events.gameplay_event: Ma Chao ganks bottom lane while the enemy Nuwa is visible on the top side of the map.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach labels this "top-tier macro." Visual: Enemy Nuwa visible top; Ma Chao ganks bottom.
events.recommended_action: Continue to track enemy mid-lane rotations to find uncontested gank opportunities.

events.coach_claim: Wasting Smite on a non-essential jungle creep loses objective control.
events.gameplay_event: Ma Chao uses Smite on a small creep; the enemy Luna subsequently takes the Tyrant and steals the blue buff.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach highlights the lost contest due to Smite cooldown. Visual: Smite on cooldown during the Tyrant fight.
events.recommended_action: Reserve Smite strictly for major objectives or contested buff secures.

events.coach_claim: Lack of "fake vision" usage allows the enemy Yang Jian to react and escape.
events.gameplay_event: Ma Chao approaches Yang Jian directly from the river; Yang Jian uses Flicker to escape.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach explains how to use minions to bait. Visual: Ma Chao's direct pathing is visible to the enemy.
events.recommended_action: Use minion waves to hide your approach and bait enemy defensive cooldowns before committing.

events.coach_claim: "Selfish" wave clearing in the late game starves the team's primary damage dealers.
events.gameplay_event: Ma Chao clears waves in all three lanes, significantly out-farming his own marksman and mage.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach criticizes the lack of gold for teammates. Visual: Significant gold disparity between Ma Chao and teammates.
events.recommended_action: Allow marksmen and mages to take lane farm in the late game to ensure team-wide item parity.

events.coach_claim: Prioritizing a kill over an objective secure leads to a major team setback.
events.gameplay_event: Ma Chao dives for a kill during a Tyrant contest; the enemy secures the dragon and wipes the team.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach notes the "thrown" game state. Visual: Ma Chao dying while the enemy secures the Tyrant.
events.recommended_action: Focus on securing the objective first during contests, especially when the enemy jungler is present.

events.coach_claim: Failure to transition from a solo-carry to a team-oriented playstyle results in a loss.
events.gameplay_event: Ma Chao continues to hog resources; the under-geared mage is unable to defend the base against the final push.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach discusses the "low-dimensional" vs "high-dimensional" play. Visual: The base falling while teammates are weak.
events.recommended_action: In the ultra-late game, prioritize team utility and resource sharing over individual stat padding.

events.coach_claim: Early mid-lane vision is crucial; if the support isn't there, the mage must check the left bush to prevent invades.
events.gameplay_event: Zhuge Liang moves to the mid-left bush at the start of the game.
events.evidence: Audio: "中左防守视野上线" (Mid-left defensive vision online).
events.recommended_action: Scout side bushes if the support is occupied elsewhere.

events.coach_claim: Use the teleportation spell to create immediate numerical advantages in side lanes.
events.gameplay_event: Zhuge Liang teleports to the bottom lane to assist in a gank.
events.evidence: Visual: Teleport effect; Audio: "无脑传边形成2打1" (Teleport to side to form 2v1).
events.recommended_action: Use teleport to turn even side-lane matchups into ganks.

events.coach_claim: It is strategically sound to take side-lane minions after a gank to accelerate your own gold lead.
events.gameplay_event: Zhuge Liang clears the bottom lane wave after a successful engagement.
events.evidence: Audio: "蹭一个兵或者蹭两个兵" (Taking one or two minions).
events.recommended_action: Share side lane gold after a gank to reach power spikes faster.

events.coach_claim: Defer mid-lane resources to the jungler if clearing the wave doesn't result in a level or item spike for you.
events.gameplay_event: Zhuge Liang leaves the mid wave for Zhao Yun (jungler).
events.evidence: Audio: "留给赵云吃" (Leave it for Zhao Yun to eat).
events.recommended_action: Optimize team economy by letting the most impactful player take the wave.

events.coach_claim: Anticipate enemy jungler rotations based on their starting buff and clear speed to avoid ambushes.
events.gameplay_event: Zhuge Liang positions cautiously near the mid-left wall.
events.evidence: Audio: "贴着中左在打" (Fighting close to mid-left).
events.recommended_action: Adjust positioning based on the predicted location of the enemy jungler.

events.coach_claim: Prioritize teleporting into major objective contests like the Tyrant or Overlord.
events.gameplay_event: Zhuge Liang teleports into the Tyrant pit during a teamfight.
events.evidence: Visual: Zhuge Liang entering the pit; Audio: "敢越我就传" (If they cross, I teleport).
events.recommended_action: Reserve teleport for high-impact objective teamfights.

events.coach_claim: Maintaining a high gold-per-minute (GPM) through constant farming is the core of the "Mage Core" strategy.
events.gameplay_event: Zhuge Liang clears neutral jungle camps and side waves.
events.evidence: Audio: "这游戏值钱的只有兵线" (Only minions are worth money).
events.recommended_action: Focus on clearing every available resource to maintain a lead.

events.coach_claim: When holding a significant lead, the enemy's jungle becomes your primary source of income.
events.gameplay_event: Zhuge Liang invades and steals the enemy's red buff.
events.evidence: Visual: Red buff steal; Audio: "敌方野区就是钱" (Enemy jungle is money).
events.recommended_action: Aggressively invade enemy territory to snowball the gold gap.

events.coach_claim: Practice "anti-gank" awareness by assuming every unchecked bush contains an enemy.
events.gameplay_event: Zhuge Liang uses skills to check bushes before rotating.
events.evidence: Audio: "假设每个草丛都有人" (Assume every bush has someone).
events.recommended_action: Use abilities to scout bushes instead of walking into them blindly.

events.coach_claim: Use teleport for late-game cleanup to secure kills and end the game.
events.gameplay_event: Zhuge Liang teleports into a late-game fight, securing a triple kill.
events.evidence: Visual: Triple kill announcement; Audio: "传送下来立马就秒" (Teleport and burst immediately).
events.recommended_action: Use mobility to enter fights late and clean up low-health targets.

events.coach_claim: Proactive play at low base health turned the game around.
events.gameplay_event: Hou Yi initiates a pick-off outside the base despite being behind.
events.evidence: Audio: "水晶一絲血的情況下，居然主動出來蹲人找節奏"
events.recommended_action: Maintain confidence and look for high-impact picks even when defending.

events.coach_claim: Early aggression with support leads to First Blood.
events.gameplay_event: Hou Yi and Shao Si Yuan engage the enemy early.
events.evidence: Video: Hou Yi secures the kill on the enemy ADC.
events.recommended_action: Capitalize on support's early pressure to gain a lane advantage.

events.coach_claim: Overstaying in lane leads to an avoidable death from a gank.
events.gameplay_event: Hou Yi stays to farm/poke and is killed by Hai Nuo and Shao Si Yuan.
events.evidence: Video: Enemy jungle/support rotate to bottom lane; Hou Yi has no escape.
events.recommended_action: Improve map awareness; retreat when enemies are missing from other lanes.

events.coach_claim: Hou Yi counters mobile ADCs like Ge Ya due to auto-lock basic attacks.
events.gameplay_event: Hou Yi trades effectively with Ge Ya.
events.evidence: Audio: "后羿的普攻是自動鎖定的"
events.recommended_action: Use Hou Yi against high-mobility heroes who rely on dodging skillshots.

events.coach_claim: Overextending after a successful pick results in losing objective control.
events.gameplay_event: Team gets a kill but stays too long; jungle dies.
events.evidence: Video: Team loses the Overlord after a failed chase.
events.recommended_action: Reset after securing a kill or objective; don't over-chase into enemy territory.

events.coach_claim: Farming side lanes instead of assisting the jungle reduces gank success.
events.gameplay_event: Hou Yi clears small jungle camps while a fight happens nearby.
events.evidence: Audio: "打完小野之後可以幫打野提個速"
events.recommended_action: Prioritize team rotations and ganks over marginal farm in the mid-game.

events.coach_claim: Chasing a single enemy while losing key structures is poor macro.
events.gameplay_event: Team chases Dian Wei while the enemy pushes the mid tower.
events.evidence: Video: Mid-lane tower falls while four players are in the jungle.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize wave management and tower defense over low-value kills.

events.coach_claim: Defending the high ground tower at the cost of one's life is a desperate "Mid-lane" mentality.
events.gameplay_event: Hou Yi dies while clearing a wave under the high ground tower.
events.evidence: Video: Hou Yi uses all skills to clear the wave but is dived and killed.
events.recommended_action: Coordinate with teammates to clear waves safely; avoid standing too far forward.

events.coach_claim: Precise ultimate usage can create comeback opportunities.
events.gameplay_event: Hou Yi hits a long-range ultimate on the enemy Hai Nuo.
events.evidence: Video: The ultimate stuns the target, leading to a quick kill and a teamfight win.
events.recommended_action: Practice leading targets with global ultimates to initiate fights from afar.

events.coach_claim: Proactive initiation when the enemy is regrouping secures the victory.
events.gameplay_event: Hou Yi catches the enemy off-guard outside their base for the final push.
events.evidence: Video: Hou Yi's team wipes the enemy and destroys the crystal.
events.recommended_action: In the late game, look for decisive picks to end the game immediately.

events.coach_claim: Wu Zetian's playstyle is simple: once level 4, roam to side lanes to control the pace.
events.gameplay_event: Early game laning and movement.
events.evidence: Audio commentary; visual of level 4 ultimate icon.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize reaching level 4 quickly to unlock global map pressure.

events.coach_claim: Facing Shao Siming and Daji, focus on clearing waves first due to their annoying poke.
events.gameplay_event: Laning against Shao Siming and Daji.
events.evidence: Audio mentioning the matchup; visual of clearing minions.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize wave clear to minimize poke damage from the enemy mid duo.

events.coach_claim: Immediately head to the bottom lane to support after clearing the mid wave.
events.gameplay_event: Rotation from mid to bot lane.
events.evidence: Visual of Wu Zetian moving through the river towards bot.
events.recommended_action: Maintain high map awareness and rotate immediately after securing lane priority.

events.coach_claim: Admits to early-game mechanical mistakes, specifically missing Skill 1 and the Ultimate.
events.gameplay_event: Failed gank where key skills missed.
events.evidence: Audio confession; visual of missed skill indicators.
events.recommended_action: Practice the timing and lead of skill shots, especially the delayed ultimate.

events.coach_claim: The death was a direct result of missed skills; it was a personal mechanical error.
events.gameplay_event: Wu Zetian dies in a skirmish.
events.evidence: Audio taking responsibility for the death.
events.recommended_action: Analyze deaths to distinguish between poor positioning and mechanical failure.

events.coach_claim: Prioritize "Wuxiang Shenqi" (CD/Utility item) to significantly reduce ultimate cooldown.
events.gameplay_event: Item purchase in the shop.
events.evidence: Audio explaining item choice; visual of shop menu.
events.recommended_action: Build for maximum cooldown reduction early to increase ultimate frequency.

events.coach_claim: Use brushes to hide vision and wait for enemy mispositioning for a surprise attack.
events.gameplay_event: Hiding in the bot lane river brush.
events.evidence: Visual of Wu Zetian waiting in brush near enemies.
events.recommended_action: Utilize the fog of war and brushes to set up unexpected ganks.

events.coach_claim: Execute the Skill 1 into Ultimate into Skill 2 combo for effective lockdown and burst.
events.gameplay_event: Successful skirmish in bot lane.
events.evidence: Visual of the skill combo and resulting kill.
events.recommended_action: Master the standard burst/CC combo to maximize impact during ganks.

events.coach_claim: Monitor ultimate cooldown; look to initiate or follow up once it is ready.
events.gameplay_event: Positioning for a fight with Ult coming off CD.
events.evidence: Audio mentioning Ult CD; visual of CD timer.
events.recommended_action: Coordinate with teammates by signaling ultimate status before engaging.

events.coach_claim: A well-timed ultimate can turn a skirmish into a favorable trade, even if some skills miss.
events.gameplay_event: Teamfight resulting in a 0-for-1 trade.
events.evidence: Visual of the fight and kill notification.
events.recommended_action: Use the global ultimate to influence distant fights even when not directly present.

events.coach_claim: Criticizes teammate passivity; push for tower damage when an advantage is secured.
events.gameplay_event: Siege on mid tower.
events.evidence: Audio criticizing marksman; visual of the siege.
events.recommended_action: Capitalize on won fights by immediately pressuring the nearest objective.

events.coach_claim: Transition from kills to major objectives like Tyrant and towers to solidify the lead.
events.gameplay_event: Killing Tyrant and destroying mid T1.
events.evidence: Visual of Tyrant death and tower destruction.
events.recommended_action: Follow a strict priority: Kills -> Towers -> Neutral Objectives.

events.coach_claim: Adapt boot choice based on the game state, such as switching for mana regeneration.
events.gameplay_event: Selling and buying different boots.
events.evidence: Audio explaining the switch; visual of item swap.
events.recommended_action: Be flexible with itemization (especially boots) to address immediate resource needs.

events.coach_claim: Use the ultimate to disrupt the entire enemy team during the final base siege.
events.gameplay_event: Final teamfight in the enemy base.
events.evidence: Visual of the final fight and ultimate usage.
events.recommended_action: Save high-impact, wide-area CC for critical moments in base defense or sieges.

events.coach_claim: Lu Ya Na is weak early against marksmen who rely on passive damage (Huang Zhong, Di Renjie, Luban).
events.gameplay_event: Matchup analysis at loading screen.
events.evidence: Audio commentary; visual icons of heroes.
events.recommended_action: Play defensively in lane against high-passive-damage marksmen early.

events.coach_claim: Lock onto backline minions first to ensure you don't miss last hits.
events.gameplay_event: Laning phase; player targets ranged minions.
events.evidence: Visual: Targeting cursor on backline minion.
events.recommended_action: Use manual targeting to secure backline minion gold first.

events.coach_claim: If you have lane priority, you must rotate to support your jungler during invasions.
events.gameplay_event: Enemy invades red jungle; Lu Ya Na leaves lane to assist.
events.evidence: Visual: Map movement toward jungle skirmish.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize jungle defense rotations when lane is pushed.

events.coach_claim: Use Skill 1 for speed and wall-climbing, then Skill 2 + Flash to lock down targets.
events.gameplay_event: Jungle skirmish; Lu Ya Na catches enemy for First Blood.
events.evidence: Visual: Skill 1 speed buff and Skill 2-Flash combo.
events.recommended_action: Combine mobility skills with Flash to secure early kills.

events.coach_claim: The core early damage comes from using Skill 1 followed by Skill 2 to trigger the "Ring Blade" combo.
events.gameplay_event: Explanation of damage structure; player executes combo on enemies.
events.evidence: Audio: "Ring Blade" explanation; Visual: Multi-hit damage numbers.
events.recommended_action: Always use Skill 1 before Skill 2 in early trades to maximize damage.

events.coach_claim: Skill 2 provides a "grounding" effect that can interrupt channeled ultimates like Zhang Liang or Mozi.
events.gameplay_event: Skill description overlay showing CC effects.
events.evidence: Visual: Skill description text; Audio: Mention of specific hero counters.
events.recommended_action: Save Skill 2 to interrupt critical enemy channeled abilities.

events.coach_claim: In jungle fights, use terrain to your advantage by outputting damage from behind walls for safety.
events.gameplay_event: Tyrant pit fight; Lu Ya Na kites around the wall.
events.evidence: Visual: Player using Skill 1 to hop walls while attacking.
events.recommended_action: Position behind thick walls in jungle chokepoints to safely harass.

events.coach_claim: To clear waves quickly, use Skill 1 -> Skill 2 -> Basic Attack on the backline minions.
events.gameplay_event: Wave clearing in mid-game.
events.evidence: Visual: Rapid wave clear using the Ring Blade combo.
events.recommended_action: Optimize wave clear speed by proccing Ring Blades on the entire wave.

events.coach_claim: Use 1-2-3 or 3-1-2 combos for teamfights; never start with Skill 2 as it loses a passive proc.
events.gameplay_event: Teamfight at 6:20; double kill achieved.
events.evidence: Visual: Skill sequence icons; Audio: Warning against starting with Skill 2.
events.recommended_action: Sequence spells to ensure every "Ring Blade" passive is triggered.

events.coach_claim: After the initial burst, maintain a safe distance and act like a traditional marksman with basic attacks.
events.gameplay_event: Late game teamfight; Lu Ya Na stays at max range.
events.evidence: Visual: Positioning behind frontline while basic attacking.
events.recommended_action: Transition to kiting with basic attacks once main cooldowns are spent.

events.coach_claim: Coordinate a three-lane push using the Overlord to overwhelm enemy defense.
events.gameplay_event: Team prepares for final push with dragon buffs.
events.evidence: Visual: Map showing waves pushed in all three lanes.
events.recommended_action: Sync minion waves across all lanes before attempting to break high ground.

events.coach_claim: When all teammates are dead and the enemy is at the high ground, the only way to survive is to cut minion waves.
events.gameplay_event: Da Qiao moves past the enemy front line to intercept the bottom lane minion wave.
events.evidence: Audio: "You can only go to the disconnection and drag the later stage." Visible: Teammates are dead; enemy is pushing high ground.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize clearing minion waves far from the base to prevent the enemy from having tower-siege capability.

events.coach_claim: Use bushes to hide the teleportation circle for safe retreats after cutting waves.
events.gameplay_event: Da Qiao places her 2nd skill in a bush before clearing a wave, then teleports back to base.
events.evidence: Audio: "Because we turned over the grass... it was in the grass when it was delivered back." Visible: Blue circle placed in brush.
events.recommended_action: Always place Da Qiao's 2nd skill in a location without enemy vision to ensure a safe escape.

events.coach_claim: Coordinated sideline pressure forces the enemy to split up, preventing a five-man push.
events.gameplay_event: Da Qiao cuts the bottom lane while Gongsun Li cuts the top lane simultaneously.
events.evidence: Audio: "I'm offline... Ali is also very tacit. I broke the bottom line, she broke the top." Visible: Mini-map shows two heroes in separate side lanes.
events.recommended_action: Coordinate with teammates to pressure opposite lanes to dilute the enemy's offensive power.

events.coach_claim: Use the ultimate ability to rescue teammates who are caught out while pressuring lanes.
events.gameplay_event: Da Qiao uses her ultimate to bring Gongsun Li back to safety after she is ambushed.
events.evidence: Audio: "Gongsun Li... may be caught, we shook it up and got him back." Visible: Da Qiao's ultimate (large circle) cast near the fountain.
events.recommended_action: Save the ultimate for emergency extractions or rapid rotations when teammates are overextended.

events.coach_claim: Breaking waves forces specific enemy heroes to respond, creating a temporary numbers advantage elsewhere.
events.gameplay_event: By cutting the bottom wave, the enemy Dragonborn is forced to clear it, allowing the team to fight 5v4.
events.evidence: Audio: "Dragon man... he must pipeline first... you can find an opportunity to fight a wave of 5v4." Visible: Enemy Dragonborn appears on mini-map clearing minions.
events.recommended_action: Monitor enemy positions and initiate teamfights when an enemy core is busy clearing pushed-in waves.

events.coach_claim: Defending the high ground requires rapid wave clear and utilizing the fountain for quick resets.
events.gameplay_event: The team uses high-damage skills to clear mid-lane minions, then resets at the fountain using Da Qiao's 2nd skill.
events.evidence: Audio: "First make sure the opposite side can't get in... back to carry mineral water and play with them." Visible: Rapid health/mana regeneration after teleporting.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize clearing minions over chasing kills when defending high ground; use Da Qiao for fast sustain resets.

events.coach_claim: Wait for the teleport circle's cooldown to be nearly finished before revealing yourself to clear a wave.
events.gameplay_event: Da Qiao waits in a bush until her 2nd skill is almost ready, then steps out to clear the wave and instantly teleports.
events.evidence: Audio: "Wait for 2 seconds left in the circle before the CD goes out to reproduce." Visible: Da Qiao stays hidden until the last moment.
events.recommended_action: Minimize exposure time when cutting waves by timing your movement with the teleportation window.

events.coach_claim: Staggering the arrival of minion waves (dislocation method) makes the Storm Dragon King's buff less effective.
events.gameplay_event: Da Qiao ensures the three lane waves do not reach the crystal at the same time, allowing the team to clear them one by one.
events.evidence: Audio: "Line dislocation method... let the three lines not enter at the same time." Visible: Minion waves are at different distances from the crystal.
events.recommended_action: Intentionally slow down or speed up specific waves to prevent a synchronized multi-lane push by the enemy.

events.coach_claim: Use "luring the tiger from the mountain" tactics to secure major objectives.
events.gameplay_event: Zhao Yun feints a push on the high ground to draw the enemy away, allowing the rest of the team to take the Storm Dragon King.
events.evidence: Audio: "A big wave to turn the tiger away from the mountain... Zhao Yun fast delivery." Visible: Enemy team rotates toward their base while Da Qiao's team starts the Dragon.
events.recommended_action: Use a split-pusher as bait to force enemy rotations away from critical objectives like the Storm Dragon King.

events.coach_claim: Mindlessly following the marksman is a fatal mistake; Sun Bin’s value is in rotation and tempo.
events.gameplay_event: Sun Bin roaming to assist jungle/mid instead of staying in lane.
events.evidence: Audio: "Sun Bin's value lies in... fast support to jungle and mid."
events.recommended_action: Prioritize roaming to create local numerical advantages using Skill 2 speed.

events.coach_claim: Synergy is composition-dependent; follow aggressive marksmen or strong early-game bruisers.
events.gameplay_event: Visual icons of Ali, Lao Fuzi, and Miyamoto shown as ideal partners.
events.evidence: Visual: Hero icons categorized by synergy level.
events.recommended_action: Draft Sun Bin with frontline bruisers (e.g., Cao Cao, Zhao Yun) rather than squishy assassins.

events.coach_claim: Track the enemy jungler’s starting buff to predict their rotation and gank timing.
events.gameplay_event: Sun Bin scouting the enemy blue buff area.
events.evidence: Audio: "Check what buff Miyamoto is starting."
events.recommended_action: Use early mobility to scout enemy jungle pathing and communicate to the team.

events.coach_claim: Maximize team economy by sharing waves across mid and side lanes during rotations.
events.gameplay_event: Sun Bin, Xiao Qiao, and Zhuge Liang clearing mid and side waves together.
events.evidence: Audio: "Sharing two lanes of economy is higher than one person eating one lane."
events.recommended_action: Rotate as a mid-support duo/trio to clear multiple lanes, accelerating team gold.

events.coach_claim: Sun Bin reaches a critical power spike at Level 11 when Skill 2 is maxed and CDR reaches 40%.
events.gameplay_event: Sun Bin reaching Level 11 and initiating large-scale rotations.
events.evidence: Audio: "Sun Bin's first power spike... 40% cooldown reduction."
events.recommended_action: Transition from defensive play to aggressive map-wide pressure once CDR is capped.

events.coach_claim: Prioritize neutral objectives and scout for flankers immediately after winning a teamfight.
events.gameplay_event: Team taking Tyrant; Sun Bin scouting and stopping Guan Yu’s flank.
events.evidence: Visual: Sun Bin using Ultimate to silence Guan Yu near the dragon pit.
events.recommended_action: Use the post-fight window to secure Tyrant/Overlord and maintain vision on potential flankers.

events.coach_claim: In extreme deficits without support help, marksman positioning and awareness are paramount.
events.gameplay_event: Defending high ground at a 10k gold deficit.
events.evidence: Scoreboard shows 2-17; Yao (support) is not tethered to Di Renjie.
events.recommended_action: Focus on safe wave clear and avoid isolation.

events.coach_claim: Maintain a positive mentality; defensive play can bridge the gold gap.
events.gameplay_event: Da Siming suggests surrendering; Di Renjie encourages the team.
events.evidence: Voice chat/text overlay shows surrender discussion and encouragement.
events.recommended_action: Mute toxic players and focus on defensive win conditions.

events.coach_claim: When clearing waves, track the enemy jungler (Wukong) to avoid being picked off.
events.gameplay_event: Di Renjie clears top and mid waves while monitoring Wukong's icons.
events.evidence: Mini-map shows enemy icons; coach mentions Hou Yi's ultimate.
events.recommended_action: Use Skill 1 to scout bushes before approaching waves.

events.coach_claim: Don't over-commit to fights when significantly behind in items, even if a teammate engages.
events.gameplay_event: Sun Ce engages; Di Renjie joins but retreats using Skill 2 and Flash when damage is insufficient.
events.evidence: Di Renjie's health bar drops rapidly; uses defensive cooldowns to escape.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize survival over low-probability kills when behind.

events.coach_claim: Focus high-priority targets with CC and coordinate with teammates for jungle resources.
events.gameplay_event: Team picks off Ming Shiyin; Di Renjie uses yellow card on Hou Yi. Assists with Blue buff.
events.evidence: Yellow card animation on Hou Yi; assists Da Siming with buff but lets Xiao Qiao take it.
events.recommended_action: Use CC to peel for yourself or lock down the enemy carry.

events.coach_claim: In teamfights, stay away from burst threats and save cleanse skills for critical CC.
events.gameplay_event: Teamfight near mid; Di Renjie avoids Wukong/Xiao Qiao and cleanses Hou Yi's bird.
events.evidence: Skill 2 used immediately after being hit by Hou Yi's ultimate.
events.recommended_action: Maintain maximum attack range from assassins.

events.coach_claim: Use map pressure to force the enemy to react, but maintain awareness of flankers.
events.gameplay_event: Pushing mid tower; coach highlights Daji's flanking position.
events.evidence: Red arrows on mini-map indicate Daji's movement.
events.recommended_action: Wait for frontline to provide vision before committing to a tower push.

events.coach_claim: Prioritize wave management to prevent backdoors, especially when the enemy has the Overlord.
events.gameplay_event: Di Renjie clears top wave and recalls to defend against a potential backdoor.
events.evidence: Enemy has Overlord buff; Di Renjie clears minions near high ground.
events.recommended_action: Always clear side waves before contesting neutral objectives.

events.coach_claim: Capitalize on teammate's CC but be wary of extremely tanky targets.
events.gameplay_event: Sun Ce hits a 4-man knockup; Di Renjie follows up but struggles against Si Kongzhen.
events.evidence: Visual of Sun Ce's ultimate landing; Si Kongzhen remains high health despite focus.
events.recommended_action: Build armor penetration (e.g., Daybreaker) earlier against tanky lineups.

events.coach_claim: Use skills to scout bushes when vision is missing, especially near high-value buffs.
events.gameplay_event: Di Renjie checks Red buff bush with Skill 1, revealing Hou Yi.
events.evidence: Skill 1 projectile reveals Hou Yi's position in the bush.
events.recommended_action: Never face-check bushes as a marksman.

events.coach_claim: Late-game item swaps are crucial for survival during high-ground sieges.
events.gameplay_event: Intense defense; Di Renjie swaps to Blade of Eternity (Mingshao).
events.evidence: Item shop interface shown; defensive item icon appears in inventory.
events.recommended_action: Practice quick-selling and buying active items (e.g., Resurrection Armor to Mingshao).

events.coach_claim: In 1v1 marksman duels, use the tower for protection and focus on clearing the minions first.
events.gameplay_event: Hou Yi tries to solo push mid; Di Renjie defends under tower.
events.evidence: Di Renjie stays tethered to tower range while kiting Hou Yi.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize the "Vanguard" (dragon minion) to disable the enemy's push.

events.coach_claim: Avoid over-aggressive dives when the team is staggered; one death can end the game.
events.gameplay_event: Sun Ce fails a dive on Xiao Qiao; Di Renjie dies trying to defend the final push.
events.evidence: Sun Ce dies in enemy base; Di Renjie is caught by enemy CC during the final defense.
events.recommended_action: Stay grouped for the final defense; don't chase kills outside the base.

events.coach_claim: Pull the minion wave to the right to avoid being poked by Jia Luo from the bush.
events.gameplay_event: Laning Phase Start
events.evidence: Visual: Sun moves to the right side of the lane; Audio: Coach explains avoiding Jia Luo's range.
events.recommended_action: Position away from enemy-controlled bushes during early laning.

events.coach_claim: Position in the bush when contesting the red bird to surprise the enemy.
events.gameplay_event: Resource Contest
events.evidence: Visual: Sun waits in the bush while attacking the bird.
events.recommended_action: Use brush for vision denial when securing neutral resources.

events.coach_claim: Freeze the lane (carding the wave) to pressure the enemy marksman.
events.gameplay_event: Wave Management
events.evidence: Visual: Sun holds the wave near her tower without clearing.
events.recommended_action: Freeze waves to deny gold/exp when you have a lane advantage.

events.coach_claim: Roll forward to zone the enemy when minions are low to prevent them from clearing.
events.gameplay_event: Aggressive Laning
events.evidence: Visual: Sun rolls forward as minions die to poke Jia Luo.
events.recommended_action: Use mobility skills to aggressively zone enemies during wave transitions.

events.coach_claim: Push the wave quickly and rotate to the dragon; control vision first.
events.gameplay_event: Objective Rotation
events.evidence: Visual: Sun clears wave and moves toward the dragon pit.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize wave clear before rotating to neutral objectives.

events.coach_claim: Mid-game strategy: Rotate between mid and side lanes to maintain pressure.
events.gameplay_event: Mid-game Macro
