events.evidence: Visual: Sun moves from side lane to mid to clear and rotate.
events.recommended_action: Utilize high-mobility heroes to clear mid and support side lanes frequently.

events.coach_claim: Use the passive speed boost from Skill 1 to detect enemies in bushes.
events.gameplay_event: Bush Checking
events.evidence: Visual: Sun's movement speed increases near a bush containing Mai.
events.recommended_action: Monitor passive triggers to avoid face-checking dangerous bushes.

events.coach_claim: Conserve mana by not using Skill 2 on jungle creeps if mana is low.
events.gameplay_event: Resource Management
events.evidence: Visual: Sun uses only basic attacks and Skill 1 on jungle.
events.recommended_action: Optimize ability usage to maintain mana for potential teamfights.

events.coach_claim: Switch to Resolute Boots (CC reduction) before major objective teamfights.
events.gameplay_event: Itemization
events.evidence: Visual: Shop menu shows purchase of Resolute Boots.
events.recommended_action: Adapt boots based on enemy CC threats during the transition to late game.

events.coach_claim: Choose Bloodlust (lifesteal) over Doomsday against squishy, burst-heavy teams.
events.gameplay_event: Itemization
events.evidence: Visual: Sun completes Bloodlust; Audio: Coach explains the choice.
events.recommended_action: Select lifesteal items that provide survivability against burst rather than tank-shredding.

events.coach_claim: Enable "Target Lock" to see enemy icons even when they are off-screen.
events.gameplay_event: UI/Mechanics
events.evidence: Visual: Han Xin's icon appears on the UI before he is visible on screen.
events.recommended_action: Utilize HUD elements like hero icons to react to flankers before they appear.

events.coach_claim: Wait for Luban to finish his passive before using skill 2 to trade.
events.gameplay_event: Yu Ji laning against Luban.
events.evidence: Audio commentary; visual of Yu Ji using skill 2 early.
events.recommended_action: Time defensive abilities to specifically counter high-damage enemy passives.

events.coach_claim: Good map awareness; didn't chase Luban because Sang Qi was coming.
events.gameplay_event: Luban flashes away; Yu Ji retreats.
events.evidence: Audio praise; mini-map shows Sang Qi approaching.
events.recommended_action: Always check the mini-map for enemy rotations before committing to a chase.

events.coach_claim: Missed opportunity to pull the wave under the tower while the enemy was busy.
events.gameplay_event: Enemy team doing red buff; Yu Ji clears wave normally.
events.evidence: Audio critique; visual of wave position.
events.recommended_action: Pull the wave to the tower to freeze it and deny enemy farm when they are absent.

events.coach_claim: Support should not touch the wave in a losing matchup to avoid pushing it out.
events.gameplay_event: Yao (support) hits the minion wave.
events.evidence: Audio explanation of wave mechanics; visual of Yao hitting minions.
events.recommended_action: Supports should avoid hitting minions in losing lanes to prevent the wave from pushing toward the enemy.

events.coach_claim: Sending the support to roam is a high-IQ move when the lane is lost.
events.gameplay_event: Yu Ji tells Yao to help the jungler.
events.evidence: Audio commentary; chat log shows Yu Ji's request.
events.recommended_action: If a lane cannot be won, send the support to create pressure elsewhere while the shooter solo-defends.

events.coach_claim: Use jungle creeps for "infinite blood return" to sustain in lane.
events.gameplay_event: Yu Ji pulls a jungle creep toward the lane to lifesteal.
events.evidence: Visual of Yu Ji attacking jungle creep without killing it.
events.recommended_action: Kite nearby jungle creeps to trigger lifesteal/sustain without leaving the lane.

events.coach_claim: First item "End of the World" is chosen for health and sustain under pressure.
events.gameplay_event: Yu Ji completes "End of the World" (末世).
events.evidence: Visual of item build; audio explanation of why it's chosen.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize items with sustain (lifesteal/HP) when facing heavy lane pressure.

events.coach_claim: Cutting the mid-lane wave is the best way to stall when behind.
events.gameplay_event: Yu Ji clears the mid wave deep in the lane.
events.evidence: Visual of Yu Ji roaming to mid to clear; audio praise.
events.recommended_action: Focus on clearing the most critical wave (usually mid) to prevent enemy sieges.

events.coach_claim: High ground defense requires a "mid-laner's mindset" of prioritizing wave clear.
events.gameplay_event: Enemy team sieges high ground.
events.evidence: Audio commentary on Yu Ji's defensive positioning.
events.recommended_action: During high ground defense, prioritize clearing minions over chasing kills.

events.coach_claim: Strategically ignoring one wave to focus on defending the crystal from others.
events.gameplay_event: Yu Ji manages multiple lane waves during a siege.
events.evidence: Visual of Yu Ji letting a side minion pass to clear the main threat.
events.recommended_action: Calculate which waves pose the greatest threat to the crystal and prioritize accordingly.

events.coach_claim: "Good movement, dodged a skill."
events.gameplay_event: Sun Shangxiang (SSX) dodges an enemy ability while laning.
events.evidence: Visual: SSX sidesteps a skillshot.
events.recommended_action: Maintain high focus on enemy skill cooldowns to dodge effectively.

events.coach_claim: Support starting top is common in low ranks; analyze the lineup.
events.gameplay_event: SSX is solo bot while Xiang Yu is top.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach notes Charlotte is weak at level 1.
events.recommended_action: Play aggressively if the enemy laner is weak early and you have a range advantage.

events.coach_claim: Use Skill 1 to ensure last hits under tower if needed.
events.gameplay_event: SSX misses the final hit on a creep under tower.
events.evidence: Visual: Creep dies to tower shot.
events.recommended_action: Use abilities to secure gold from creeps that are about to die to tower.

events.coach_claim: Vision of jungler starting blue allows for more aggressive play.
events.gameplay_event: SSX gets vision of Han Xin at his blue buff.
events.evidence: Visual: Mini-map shows enemy jungler location.
events.recommended_action: Use information of enemy jungler's position to pressure lane or steal farm.

events.coach_claim: Don't wait for Skill 1; use Flash immediately to follow up.
events.gameplay_event: SSX baits Luban and Flashes to secure the kill after Xiang Yu's flank.
events.evidence: Visual: SSX Flashes forward to finish Luban.
events.recommended_action: Commit resources (Flash) instantly when a kill opportunity is guaranteed by a teammate's CC.

events.coach_claim: Steal the buff after tracking the jungler.
events.gameplay_event: SSX and Angela steal the enemy red buff.
events.evidence: Visual: SSX takes the red buff from Han Xin.
events.recommended_action: Invade enemy jungle when you have lane priority and vision of the enemy jungler.

events.coach_claim: Avoid ineffective grouping; focus on development.
events.gameplay_event: SSX retreats from a potential mid-lane skirmish where enemies have Flash.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach mentions "ineffective grouping" (无效团).
events.recommended_action: Prioritize farming and tower pressure over coin-flip teamfights in the early-mid game.

events.coach_claim: Wait for vision before pushing tower when enemies are missing.
events.gameplay_event: SSX pauses in a bush while 5 enemies are off-map before finishing a tower.
events.evidence: Visual: SSX waits for enemy icons to reappear on the map.
events.recommended_action: Check the mini-map before committing to a deep push; if enemies are missing, play cautiously.

events.coach_claim: Change boots/items before a specific duel for an advantage.
events.gameplay_event: SSX switches to physical defense boots before fighting Han Xin.
events.evidence: Visual: Shop menu opened to buy Ninja Tabi.
events.recommended_action: Adapt your build reactively to the specific threat you are about to face.

events.coach_claim: Don't pressure high ground before 10 minutes (high-rank logic).
events.gameplay_event: SSX clears waves and rotates instead of forcing a high-ground siege.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach explains not pressing high ground before 10 mins.
events.recommended_action: Focus on outer towers and jungle control before attempting a high-ground break in the early game.

events.coach_claim: "Diamond mentality": Enemies will target the fed player regardless of the win.
events.gameplay_event: Han Xin repeatedly targets SSX despite being behind in gold.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach discusses the "Eternal Diamond" (永恒钻石) mindset.
events.recommended_action: Expect to be focused if you are the primary carry; adjust positioning to bait enemies into bad trades.

events.coach_claim: Enemies don't care about buffs; they only want the "superstar" kill.
events.gameplay_event: Han Xin ignores his own blue buff to hunt SSX.
events.evidence: Visual: Han Xin jumps past farm to engage SSX.
events.recommended_action: In lower ranks, anticipate irrational aggression from players looking to shut down a fed opponent.

events.coach_claim: Players often blame lack of support for deaths caused by their own over-aggression.
events.gameplay_event: Lu Bu dies repeatedly while pushing deep; Hou Yi fan expresses frustration at rank plateau.
events.evidence: Audio: Lu Bu asks for "a sign" while dying. Visual: Intro shows fan's 70-mastery rank struggle.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize map awareness over blaming teammates; focus on game-winning macro, not just mastery.

events.coach_claim: Level 1 skill choice should be reactive to the lane matchup.
events.gameplay_event: Hou Yi waits to reach the lane before upgrading a skill.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach explains Skill 1 is better for wave clear speed vs. Skill 2 for poke.
events.recommended_action: Delay skill upgrades at Level 1 until the enemy's positioning and intent are clear.

events.coach_claim: Top laners must respect predictable jungler gank timings.
events.gameplay_event: Lu Bu is caught out at the 1:15 mark while fighting deep.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach identifies 1:15, 2:40, and 3:05 as key danger nodes. Visual: Mini-map shows Lu Bu's exposed position.
events.recommended_action: Retreat to safety near the 1:15, 2:40, and 3:05 marks if the enemy jungler is not visible.

events.coach_claim: Precise wave management (freezing) forces the enemy into vulnerable positions.
events.gameplay_event: Hou Yi uses Skill 2 edges to thin the wave and "cards the line" against Marco Polo.
events.evidence: Visual: Hou Yi secures a kill by forcing Marco Polo to step up for farm.
events.recommended_action: Use "edge hits" with abilities to manage minion health without breaking a freeze.

events.coach_claim: Pushing without vision leads to "giving" kills rather than being "caught."
events.gameplay_event: Lu Bu dies again at 2:50 while ignoring the missing enemy mid/jungle.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach calls this "sending" (inting) rather than being ganked. Visual: Lu Bu dies under tower.
events.recommended_action: Check the mini-map before every wave push; if enemies are missing, do not cross the river.

events.coach_claim: When other lanes collapse, the marksman must prioritize personal gold over risky rotations.
events.gameplay_event: Hou Yi focuses on "selfish" farming and taking jungle crabs as the team falls behind.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach advises "eating crabs alone" and "not being soft-hearted" with resources.
events.recommended_action: Transition to a "carry" mindset by vacuuming up safe resources when the team's early rhythm is lost.

events.coach_claim: Strategic tower abandonment is necessary to avoid multi-man dives.
events.gameplay_event: Hou Yi retreats from a full-health bottom tower despite no immediate threat.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach explains Wukong's proximity and Zhuge Liang's teleport threat.
events.recommended_action: Value survival over a doomed tower; recognize when the enemy has the numbers to dive.

events.coach_claim: Front-liners must transition from solo pushing to peeling for the fed carry.
events.gameplay_event: Lu Bu continues solo farming and fails to use his ultimate to protect Hou Yi from Wukong.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach criticizes Lu Bu for farming "small wild" instead of grouping. Visual: Hou Yi dies while Lu Bu is nearby.
events.recommended_action: Once outer towers fall, the solo laner must act as a meat shield/peel for the marksman.

events.coach_claim: A "silky" development rhythm and stable mentality are key to long-term ranking.
events.gameplay_event: Game ends in defeat; Hou Yi's efficient farm and calm demeanor are highlighted.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach praises the "good attitude" despite the loss. Visual: Final scoreboard shows Hou Yi's high gold.
events.recommended_action: Maintain a consistent farming rhythm and positive mindset even when teammates perform poorly.

events.coach_claim: Luban doesn't need defensive items if he can burst enemies before they reach him.
events.gameplay_event: Luban engages in high-damage trades without defensive gear.
events.evidence: Audio: "Luban doesn't need a defensive suit... just drop them in seconds."
events.recommended_action: Prioritize pure damage items (e.g., Bow of Destruction) if positioning is perfect.

events.coach_claim: Clearing waves without support vision is a major mistake; enemy support could be lurking.
events.gameplay_event: Luban clears the first wave while his support is absent and enemy support is missing.
events.evidence: Visual: Luban is alone in lane; Audio: "The opposite support did not miss... That's a pretty big thing."
events.recommended_action: Hug the tower or wait for support vision before stepping past the midpoint of the lane.

events.coach_claim: Jiang Ziya is not a direct counter to Milady; wave clear speed is the priority.
events.gameplay_event: Discussion on hero matchups while Luban continues laning.
events.evidence: Audio: "Jiang Ziya is really not restrained by Milady... must choose the second limit [wave clear]."
events.recommended_action: Pick high-burst wave clear heroes against Milady rather than relying on specific "counters."

events.coach_claim: Luban's 2nd skill explosion damage can be used to steal jungle creeps.
events.gameplay_event: Luban successfully steals an enemy small jungle creep using his 2nd skill.
events.evidence: Visual: 2nd skill projectile hits the creep; Audio: "Luban 2nd skill's... can be used to grab it."
events.recommended_action: Practice timing the 2nd skill projectile for long-range objective/creep steals.

events.coach_claim: Overextending for waves when abandoned by the team leads to wasted resources (Flash).
events.gameplay_event: Luban tries to contest a wave, gets poked, and is forced to use Flash to survive.
events.evidence: Visual: Luban uses Flash defensively; Audio: "The flash is gone... problem is very big."
events.recommended_action: Accept lost waves when outnumbered; preserving Flash is more valuable than one minion wave.

events.coach_claim: Poor laning decisions (greed for waves) cause a "butterfly effect" of deaths and lost pressure.
events.gameplay_event: Luban overextends again and is killed by Su Lie.
events.evidence: Visual: Luban dies near the enemy tower; Audio: "It causes a lot of butterfly effects... like being tower-dived."
events.recommended_action: Improve map awareness; do not push past the river if the enemy jungler/support is missing.

events.coach_claim: Small mechanical details, like interrupting enemy health packs, show high hero proficiency.
events.gameplay_event: Luban uses his 2nd skill to interrupt an enemy's attempt to use a health pack.
events.evidence: Visual: Projectile hits enemy near tower; Audio: "2nd skill aim to interrupt directly."
events.recommended_action: Use long-range skills to harass enemies trying to sustain under their own tower.

events.coach_claim: Choosing attack speed/on-hit items (Electric Knife/Endless) early accelerates farming.
events.gameplay_event: Luban builds attack speed items instead of raw crit early on.
events.evidence: Visual: Item shop shows current build; Audio: "This set of shipment orders is basically the fastest growing."
events.recommended_action: Adapt item builds to the game state; prioritize farm speed if the team is behind.

events.coach_claim: Engaging in river fights without Flash is extremely risky for a squishy marksman.
events.gameplay_event: Luban crosses the river without Flash available and is caught.
events.evidence: Visual: Luban is caught in the river; Audio: "I didn't flash across the river and took the initiative to play a group."
events.recommended_action: Play extremely conservatively when Flash is on cooldown; do not cross the river line.

events.coach_claim: Marksmen should look to take the Red Buff as early as 5 minutes if they are confident.
events.gameplay_event: Luban takes his first Red Buff significantly later than the optimal time (7-8 mins).
events.evidence: Visual: Luban taking red; Audio: "7-8 minutes to get red is actually very late... 5 minutes may take over."
events.recommended_action: Communicate with the jungler to secure Red Buff earlier to increase lane pressure.

events.coach_claim: Using the 2nd skill to check bushes/vision is essential for late-game survival.
events.gameplay_event: Luban fires his 2nd skill into a bush to check for enemies before moving forward.
events.evidence: Visual: 2nd skill reveals enemy; Audio: "2nd skill to find the master... Su Lie is here."
events.recommended_action: Never enter an un-warded bush late game without using a skill to check it first.

events.coach_claim: Late-game teamfighting requires waiting for key enemy cooldowns before committing Flash.
events.gameplay_event: Luban waits for the engage, deals damage, then Flashes to avoid a dive and wipes the team.
events.evidence: Visual: Luban gets a 0-for-4 team wipe; Audio: "This team battle is really beautiful... 0 for 4."
events.recommended_action: Focus on positioning behind the frontline and save movement spells for repositioning, not engaging.

events.coach_claim: Good adaptation to enemy support by rolling into lane.
events.gameplay_event: Li Yuanfang uses Skill 2 to clear wave early instead of starting jungle.
events.evidence: Visible use of Skill 2 to roll through minions; coach mentions Guiguzi support.
events.recommended_action: Continue adapting start based on enemy support threats.

events.coach_claim: Pre-ordering specific boots is a high-level detail.
events.gameplay_event: Player pre-orders Boots of Swiftness (Jibu).
events.evidence: Shop interface shows pre-order of speed boots.
events.recommended_action: Maintain habit of pre-ordering items to save time in shop.

events.coach_claim: Efficient resource stealing before clearing own jungle.
events.gameplay_event: Li Yuanfang takes enemy small jungle creep then returns to own side.
events.evidence: Minimap and player view show taking enemy Red Armor creep.
events.recommended_action: Continue aggressive counter-jungling when safe to snowball.

events.coach_claim: Successful wave freezing led to a decisive First Blood.
events.gameplay_event: Li Yuanfang freezes wave, then uses 2-Flash combo to kill enemy.
events.evidence: Wave is held near tower; Flash-Skill 2 used for kill.
events.recommended_action: Practice 2-Flash timing for unexpected executes.

events.coach_claim: Even experts make low-level mistakes by ignoring known threats.
events.gameplay_event: Li Yuanfang dies to enemy jungler (Yun Ying) despite seeing her earlier.
events.evidence: Yun Ying was visible at blue; Li Yuanfang stays overextended and dies.
events.recommended_action: Improve map awareness; respect jungler position even after a kill.

events.coach_claim: High-level rotation involves taking all available resources.
events.gameplay_event: Li Yuanfang clears wave and immediately rotates to mid with speed boots.
events.evidence: Player uses boots and Skill 2 to quickly clear mid wave after side lane.
events.recommended_action: Maximize gold income by catching waves in multiple lanes during rotations.

events.coach_claim: Mid tower is more valuable than chasing kills.
events.gameplay_event: Team ignores low-health enemies to secure the mid-lane inner tower.
events.evidence: Tower destroyed while enemies retreat; coach emphasizes tower importance.
events.recommended_action: Always prioritize central towers to open up the map.

events.coach_claim: Jungler has high gold but zero team participation.
events.gameplay_event: Ukyo Tachibana has highest gold but hasn't joined teamfights.
events.evidence: Scoreboard shows high gold but 1/2/2 KDA compared to Li Yuanfang's 6/2/0.
events.recommended_action: Junglers must convert farm into pressure, not just passive gold.

events.coach_claim: Poor decision to trade dragon instead of fighting 5v4.
events.gameplay_event: Team gives up a fight opportunity despite having a numbers advantage.
events.evidence: Team rotates to dragon while enemy is scattered; coach criticizes the passivity.
events.recommended_action: Recognize power spikes and numerical advantages to force winning fights.

events.coach_claim: Individual strength can cause teammate overconfidence.
events.gameplay_event: Li Yuanfang's carry performance led teammates to play recklessly.
events.evidence: Coach notes teammates (Mi Yue) died repeatedly thinking they were safe.
events.recommended_action: Communicate clearly to teammates when you cannot cover their mistakes.

events.coach_claim: Clear waves quickly when the enemy support is invading elsewhere.
events.gameplay_event: Early laning phase against Ai Lin.
events.evidence: Audio: "咱们就赶紧清线" (Let's quickly clear the line).
events.recommended_action: Prioritize wave clear to gain priority when the enemy is distracted.

events.coach_claim: Identify key threats based on enemy composition (Mu Lan and Yuan Ge).
events.gameplay_event: Analyzing enemy lineup.
events.evidence: Audio: "这一把咱们要提防的就是木兰与元歌" (What we need to watch out for this game is Mu Lan and Yuan Ge).
events.recommended_action: Adjust playstyle to account for high-threat enemy assassins.

events.coach_claim: Focus on last-hitting minions to maximize gold when the enemy is passive.
events.gameplay_event: Laning phase, enemy playing safe.
events.evidence: Audio: "注意补好尾刀" (Pay attention to last-hitting).
events.recommended_action: Practice last-hitting to ensure maximum gold income.

events.coach_claim: Use skill 2 for safe last-hitting under tower when the support is absent.
events.gameplay_event: Farming under tower.
events.evidence: Visual: Jia Luo uses skill 2 to hit minions from range.
events.recommended_action: Use long-range skills to secure farm safely when vulnerable.

events.coach_claim: Share jungle camps with the jungler to accelerate farm, provided they don't mind.
events.gameplay_event: Rotating to jungle camps.
events.evidence: Audio: "刷一组小野或者帮打野提个速蹭一下" (Farm a small camp or help the jungler speed up and share).
events.recommended_action: Efficiently rotate between lane and jungle to maximize gold.

events.coach_claim: Use range advantage to poke enemies while staying near teammates.
events.gameplay_event: Poking Ai Lin with Dong Huang nearby.
events.evidence: Visual: Jia Luo pokes from max range.
events.recommended_action: Maximize range advantage to harass without overextending.

events.coach_claim: Follow up on teammate's crowd control with Flash to secure kills.
events.gameplay_event: Skirmish near river.
events.evidence: Visual: Flash used after Dong Huang ult.
events.recommended_action: Be ready to commit resources (Flash) to secure high-value kills.

events.coach_claim: Prioritize survival over minion gold when the enemy jungler's position is unknown.
events.gameplay_event: Backing off from a potential gank.
events.evidence: Audio: "线能不能吃到都是次要的" (Whether you get the wave is secondary).
events.recommended_action: Play defensively when missing vision of enemy threats.

events.coach_claim: Defense of the tower is a team effort; don't die trying to save it alone.
events.gameplay_event: Abandoning a tier-1 tower.
events.evidence: Audio: "防御塔是大家的，不是咱们射手一个人的" (The tower belongs to everyone, not just the archer).
events.recommended_action: Value life over structures in disadvantageous situations.

events.coach_claim: Walking ahead of teammates as an archer is a fatal mistake.
events.gameplay_event: Jia Luo leading the team into a fight.
events.evidence: Audio: "犯了一个射手很致命的错误，那就是走在了队友的前面" (Made a fatal archer mistake: walking in front of teammates).
events.recommended_action: Always position behind tanks and supports during rotations.

events.coach_claim: Check bushes with skills and don't cross the river without core items (Po Xiao).
events.gameplay_event: Vision checking and cautious movement.
events.evidence: Audio: "逢草必探... 破晓没好之前绝不过河道" (Check every bush... never cross the river before Po Xiao is ready).
events.recommended_action: Use skills to scout vision and play conservatively until power spikes.

events.coach_claim: Jia Luo's strength lies in high-ground defense; wait for enemy mistakes to turn the game.
events.gameplay_event: Defending high ground.
events.evidence: Audio: "伽罗的节奏就是守家" (Jia Luo's rhythm is defending the base).
events.recommended_action: Stay patient in losing games and focus on wave clear and defense.

events.coach_claim: Capitalize on a single major enemy mistake to initiate a comeback.
events.gameplay_event: Winning a decisive teamfight.
events.evidence: Audio: "只要你能抓住对方一次大的失误，那就直接翻盘" (As long as you catch one big mistake, you can flip the game).
events.recommended_action: Maintain focus for late-game opportunities to punish enemy overextensions.

events.coach_claim: Good use of lane freezing to pressure the opponent.
events.gameplay_event: Luban freezes the wave, forcing Marco Polo to take damage while clearing.
events.evidence: Visual: Luban stands near his tower, only last-hitting. Marco Polo's HP drops to half.
events.recommended_action: Continue utilizing lane freezing when you have a range advantage.

events.coach_claim: Efficient resource collection in the early game.
events.gameplay_event: Luban takes the red bird and the river crab.
events.evidence: Visual: Luban clears side camps between waves.
events.recommended_action: Maintain high farm per minute (GPM) by taking neutral resources.

events.coach_claim: Poor anti-gank awareness led to a lost flash and a teammate's death.
events.gameplay_event: Luban stays pushed up after his mid-laner is killed; gets ganked by enemy support/mid.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach mentions lack of "anti-gank muscle memory." Visual: Su Lie dies trying to save Luban.
events.recommended_action: Retract to safety immediately when mid-lane is compromised or jungler is missing.

events.coach_claim: The "tower abandonment" rotation is a high-level macro play but risky in this rank.
events.gameplay_event: Luban leaves the bottom lane at 2 minutes to farm mid and top lanes.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach calls it a "1900-2000 point" strategy. Visual: Luban clearing three lanes of farm.
events.recommended_action: Ensure team coordination before abandoning a lane to avoid teammate tilt.

events.coach_claim: Mechanics were solid during the solo outplay.
events.gameplay_event: Luban uses Skill 2 to push back the enemy jungler and secures a solo kill.
events.evidence: Visual: Skill 2 knockback followed by passive procs to kill the enemy.
events.recommended_action: Practice the timing of Skill 2 to peel for yourself against divers.

events.coach_claim: Greed for the enemy red buff was unnecessary and led to a death.
events.gameplay_event: Luban attempts to steal red buff while low on HP and without vision, getting caught.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach notes Luban's "arrogance" in stealing buffs while 1-2. Visual: Enemy mid/support collapse.
events.recommended_action: Prioritize survival and safe farm over high-risk buff steals when behind.

events.coach_claim: Smart choice to prioritize farming "Dawn" (core item) over early teamfights.
events.gameplay_event: Luban avoids mid-lane skirmishes to clear waves and reach his power spike.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach mentions not joining fights before "Dawn" is finished. Visual: Luban hits 9:50 Dawn timing.
events.recommended_action: Communicate to your team to play safe until you reach your core item spikes.

events.coach_claim: The win was largely enabled by Ji Xiaoman's mid-game pressure, not just Luban.
events.gameplay_event: Ji Xiaoman wins a 1v3, creating space for Luban to farm and push.
events.evidence: Audio: Coach credits Ji Xiaoman for breaking the enemy rhythm. Visual: Ji Xiaoman killing Zhuge Liang.
events.recommended_action: Acknowledge teammate contributions; your scaling depends on their space-making.
